primary_link.title: Towards Robust Tool Use in Agents via Experience-Driven Adaptive Guidance

recommendations.summary: The performance bottleneck of agents is increasingly shifting from model capability to the robustness of their execution processes. Tools play a central role as the primary interface through which agents interact with external environments, yet existing methods rarely focus on ensuring robust tool use across diverse runtime conditions. To address this problem, we propose ExpG, a mechanism that builds and refines adaptive guidance capturing each tool's capability boundaries and best practices, th
recommendations.summary_zh: 本文針對大型語言模型（LLM）代理在真實環境中使用工具時面臨的穩健性挑戰，提出了一種名為ExpG的機制。作者指出，代理性能的瓶頸正從模型能力轉向執行過程的穩健性，而現有工具使用方法多假設工具調用可預測且失敗訊號明確，但在實際環境中，工具行為可能受環境動態影響而漂移，且錯誤回饋往往粗糙或具有誤導性。ExpG透過三個階段來解決此問題：經驗獲取（experience acquisition）、經驗蒸餾（experience distillation）與經驗重用（experience reuse）。在獲取階段，系統使用LLM-as-a-Judge方法，對歷史執行軌跡中的每次工具調用進行多方面評估，產生結構化的經驗，包含二進位評分向量與自然語言解釋，並透過等價類劃分將經驗分類。蒸餾階段則過濾無用經驗、選擇具代表性的經驗，並由LLM總結出概括性的工具使用指引，涵蓋核心功能、成功模式、常見問題與最佳實務。重用階段則根據指引的穩定性，將其作為動態提示或穩定的工具綱要約束，以引導代理未來行為。實驗涵蓋MetaTool、API-Bank與BFCL-V3三個基準，分別對應工具選擇、工具呼叫與回應生成等階段。結果顯示ExpG在多個模型上（如GPT-5 nano、DeepSeek-V3、Qwen3系列）均一致優於基線方法，包含Few-shot、DRAFT與Mem0，並使較小模型能超越未使用ExpG的較大模型。在具有干擾工具或資訊不完整的挑戰性設定中，ExpG尤其有效。消融研究證實每個階段均有貢獻，且經驗數量存在最適值。作者也討論了方法侷限，例如未見過情境、難以分析的軌跡、歸因錯誤與過度反應等。整體而言，ExpG提供了一種透過經驗驅動、可持續改進的工具使用引導機制，有助於提升代理系統在動態環境中的穩健性，並為「可訓練工具」的概念鋪路。

primary_link.title: From Profiling to Synthesis: Benchmarking Implicit Behavioral Alignment in Personalized LLM Agents

recommendations.summary: Large Language Models have enabled increasingly capable autonomous agents, yet personalization remains critical for making such agents practically useful. Recent benchmarks have begun evaluating personalization in agents, but they largely rely on static preference snapshots, fixed interaction logs, or question answering over predefined user profiles. Such designs fail to capture the complexity of evolving user preferences and neglect preference-conditioned task execution-a discrepancy we term as
recommendations.summary_zh: 本文提出「知識到行動落差」（knowledge-to-action gap）此一關鍵問題：現有個人化 Agent 的評測多依賴靜態偏好設定、固定互動紀錄，或針對預先定義使用者輪廓的問答，忽略了使用者偏好會隨時間動態演變，且常以隱性方式存在於長篇互動歷史中，導致 Agent 即便具備相關知識，也未能於任務執行時落實。為填補此落差，作者建構了 IBA-Bench 基準，模擬真實情境中的雜訊、隱性線索與時間不一致性，並要求 Agent 在執行具體任務（如產生文字或呼叫 API）時，滿足從歷史互動中推斷出的隱性約束。IBA-Bench 包含 6,962 個任務實例，涵蓋九大應用領域，並刻意設計多數實例具有三項以上偏好約束及多筆行為證據，增加任務複雜度。作者進一步提出 IBA-Agent 框架，結合深度檢索（Deep Retrieval）與廣域思考與深度對齊（Broad Thinking & Deep Alignment）兩大模組，先從龐大互動歷史中篩選與任務相關的偏好證據，再將之綜合為具體行動計畫，以產生符合使用者隱性偏好的輸出。實驗結果顯示，即使如 GPT-5.1、DeepSeek-V3.2 等先進 LLM，或 Claude Code、Hermes Agent 等通用 Agent 系統，在 IBA-Bench 上的表現皆不理想，驗證了知識到行動落差的普遍存在。相比之下，IBA-Agent 能顯著提升行為對齊表現，尤其在動態偏好情境下，較最強基線高出 12.7 個百分點。消融研究亦指出深度檢索為最關鍵元件，移除後整體分數下降 8.3。本文的限制包括資料集為合成資料，可能含有不一致或幻覺內容，且評估僅限於離線任務執行，未涵蓋線上互動或修正訊號。此研究凸顯個人化 Agent 研究應從靜態偏好刻畫轉向動態綜合，為未來發展能真正適應使用者需求的 Agent 提供了重要基準與方法。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM methodology paper squarely on-topic: agentic pipelines, interpretability tool evaluation (SAEs, activation oracles, NLAs), counterfactual simulatability, CoT faithfulness, and AI-safety auditing. Novel contribution is CHIVE, which moves counterfactual explanation evaluation from planted-hint settings to naturally-occurring behaviors at scale. Rigor is high: two-three target models, three predictor families, hyperparameter sweeps (Table 4), bootstrap CIs, filter ablations on the unfiltered dataset (Appendix F), a self-vs-cross privileged-access control (D.4), and a KL-regularization control (D.5). Evidence is quantitative and mostly in-text (e.g., baseline AUROC 0.814 vs tool 0.808-0.812 in C.3; unfiltered deltas +0.015/+0.033 with CIs). Limitations are honestly discussed, including the proxy argument that anyone with sampling access can run the counterfactual directly, and the read-only ceiling. Main weaknesses: some headline results live in figures without full numeric tables, LLM-judge dependence for screening/filters (mitigated by labels coming from resampling, not judge judgment), and the interpretability null result may partially reflect tool design rather than inherent limits. Reproducibility is strong with released code, models, datasets, costs, and verbatim formats.

recommendations.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討一個根本問題:什麼才算對語言模型行為的「好解釋」?作者採用反事實可模擬性(counterfactual simulatability)的觀點:好的解釋應能幫助預測模型在相關反事實輸入上的行為。他們提出 CHIVE,一個代理式流程,自動在真實對話(WildChat)中取樣數萬個提示詞、篩選非預期行為,以反事實提示詞編輯調查並驗證成因,產生數千筆附反事實證據的行為解釋。這些資料有兩種應用。第一,評估三種讀取激活值的可解釋性工具(activation oracles、自然語言自動編碼器、稀疏自動編碼器)能否提升預測代理判斷反事實結果的能力;在兩個目標模型與三個預測模型家族上,皆無工具優於僅讀對話紀錄的基線,主因是工具輸出鮮少明確陳述因果關係。第二,以 CHIVE 資料訓練模型預測自身行為,能泛化到 held-out 的植入線索情境(MMLU 線索、AITA 諂媚測試)與分布外的 PETRI 來源,表現接近 Opus 參考基準;但訓練開放式自我解釋成效好壞參半,常出錯的自信陳述反而誤導強大的模擬器。此外未見自我訓練優於交叉訓練的特權存取證據。主要限制在於:能取樣目標模型者本可直接執行反事實實驗,故此評估只是代理指標,且工具僅限唯讀存取激活值。整體而言,此工作展示反事實調查可大規模產生真實多樣的行為成因資料,對 AI 安全中評估與改進行為解釋方法深具價值。

§V 'Protocol status': experimental protocol is prospectively registered and amendment-logged; §V-B requires registered attack acceptance (refusal ≤0.2, judged compliance) before any defense metric is read.

Table VIII (Appendix F) and §VI-A: frozen-split replication within ±.05 of Table I values; untouched n=100 strata replicate on gemma-4 (Δ +0.755) and gpt-oss-20b (Δ +0.135).

Appendix G: blinded single-expert audit confirms 85.7% of judge fatal verdicts (FNR .404); sensitivity analysis compresses defense-attributable Δ to roughly half its pipeline value yet remains positive on every gate-passing model.

§VII-C Table XVI: 64-draw element-consensus attack recovers fully usable procedures on 0.083–0.625 on instrument-covered models vs. 0.58–0.96 undefended, with consensus precision unobservable to the attacker.

llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-safety/alignment work: a release-time defense against safety-removal (abliteration) attacks on open-weight language models, matching high-weight preferences (LLMs, AI safety, alignment/RLHF via DPO, red teaming/evaluation). Novelty is strong: 'decoy hardening' transplants defensive deception (honeypots) into weights, training falsified decoy behavior to express only in the attacked state via differentiable attack simulation, distinct from refusal-hardening defenses and DDO (§II-D). Rigor is exceptional: prospectively registered amendment-logged protocol, attack acceptance gates before any defense metric, strongest-found-attack policy, ablations of both training stages, honest boundary cases (9B fails gate). Evidence is multi-model (7 models, 5 families), replicated on frozen/untouched strata, with blinded expert audit and second-judge checks; main residual weakness is judge-only content verdicts with a shared-vendor residue (both gate-passing judge families are OpenAI) and a single-expert human anchor. Generalizability is decent across architectures/scales and to adjacent harm domains, but scoped to first releases, CBRNE-operational hazards, and excludes in-context jailbreaks, fine-tuning attacks, and several unmeasured attacker classes. Reproducibility is partial: code, harnesses, and numeric verdict artifacts are released, but decoy corpora, payloads, checkpoints, and private attack specs are withheld and key material is gated.

primary_link.title: Fool's Gold: Defensive Deception Against Safety-Removal Attacks on Open-Weight Models

recommendations.summary: Safety alignment in open-weight language models is trivially removable: abliteration projects a refusal-mediating direction out of the weights in minutes, and no release-time defense we are aware of prevents it durably. What cannot be prevented can be deceived. Our defense, decoy hardening ("Fool's Gold"), concedes the refusal strip and poisons its payoff: once refusal is stripped, most answers to hazardous operational requests are confident, fluent decoys whose critical elements are falsified.
recommendations.summary_zh: 開放權重模型的安全對齊可在數分鐘內被 abliteration 之類的權重編輯移除，而現有防禦皆無法持久抵擋。本文提出「誘餌強化」：承認拒絕機制終將被剝除，轉而欺騙攻擊者。方法上，作者把可微分的模擬攻擊放進訓練迴圈，先攻擊原模型取得真實危險答案，再逐元素偽造出表面流暢、關鍵數值（如試劑、劑量、溫度）為假的誘餌，配合拒絕錨定與 KL 約束將乾淨狀態行為釘回原模型，並以攻擊狀態下的 on-policy DPO 收斂逃逸率。防禦套用於五個家族、七個模型（9B–122B，含 MoE）；六個通過註冊關卡的模型在從未訓練的提示上，有 0.51–0.90 的受攻擊回應為誘餌，其中 +0.27–0.84 可歸因於防禦，且一般行為與 MMLU、GSM8K、WMDP 等能力維持在註冊預算內。面對 64 次取樣的元素共識攻擊，完全可用率降為 0.08–0.62（未防禦 0.58–0.96），而攻擊者在缺乏真值標籤下無從區分誘餌與真解；以合規為獎勵的 RL 消融反而把模型更深推入誘餌流形，良性資料 SFT 修復也無法找回真實內容。限制包括 10–49% 的殘餘逃逸尾巴、內容判決高度依賴單一評判模型（僅輔以人工盲測校準）、白箱線性探針在充足標籤與儀器化推論下可過濾答案、防禦對 in-context 越獄無效且只保護首次釋出的權重；少數偽造可能更危險，故加入 fail-safe 篩選並要求向下游使用者揭露。此工作的意義在於首個保證自「攻擊成功之後」才開始生效的釋出時防禦，把攻擊收益轉化為無法驗證的萃取難題。

recommendations.summary: Retrieval systems help deep research agents generate high-quality answers by providing relevant documents. However, existing retrievers typically select documents through relevance matching, while individually well-matched top-$k$ documents may not form a \textit{set} that satisfies the complex information needs of an agent query (\eg, diverse, concise and authoritative documents). In this paper, we propose search-oriented rubrics that \textit{explicitly} define the requirements that high-qualit
recommendations.summary_zh: 這篇論文提出一個名為RubricRanker的文件重排器，旨在改善深度研究代理（deep research agent）與檢索增強生成（RAG）系統的檢索品質。傳統檢索器與重排器通常僅依據單一文件的相關性進行排序，但對於代理查詢（agent query）這類複雜資訊需求，即使個別文件高度相關，所組成的文件集合仍可能不夠多元、精簡或權威。為了解決此問題，作者提出「搜尋導向評分量表」（search-oriented rubrics），以明確界定一個高品質文件集合應具備的條件，涵蓋集合層級（相關性、簡潔性、一致性）與文件層級（來源權威性、時效性）的準則。這些評分量表是透過GPT-5.1等大型語言模型，依據查詢與參考答案所生成，並帶有重要性權重。接著，作者設計一個兩階段訓練框架：第一階段為評分量表引導的監督式微調（SFT），使用教師模型（GPT-5.1）依據評分量表選出高品質文件集合，產生銀標籤以供冷啟動訓練；第二階段則為基於評分量表的強化學習（RL），利用GPT-5.1作為評審，依據評分量表對模型選出的文件集合進行評分，並透過GRPO演算法進行最佳化。實驗結果顯示，RubricRanker在四個深度研究基準（HealthBench、WebWalkerQA、DeepResearchBench、ResearchQA）上，以Dr-Tulu-8B為代理時，平均得分為60.1，比最強的基線Rank4Gen高出2.6分；在五個RAG基準（HotpotQA、Bamboogle、NQ、PopQA、TriviaQA）上，以Qwen3-8B為生成器時，平均EM分數為40.0，比Rank4Gen高出約2分。消融研究證實，兩階段訓練與評分量表引導的標籤建構皆對效能有顯著貢獻。此外，RubricRanker能減少深度研究代理的搜尋次數，例如在HealthBench上，平均搜尋次數從Rank4Gen的3.4次降至2.9次，顯示其能提供更有效率的證據收集。此方法之限制包括依賴GPT-5.1作為教師與評審，成本高昂，且評估部分僅抽取基準的子集。未來研究方向包括訓練專門的獎勵模型以降低成本，以及開發更直接評估文件集合品質的指標。此研究的重要性在於，它將重排器的訓練目標從單一文件相關性擴展至集合層級的品質，更能滿足複雜的資訊需求，對提升深度研究代理與RAG系統的效能具有實質貢獻。

recommendations.summary: External skills extend the capabilities of large language model agents, but also introduce an execution-time attack surface: a skill that appears benign under inspection may reveal harmful behavior only after particular environmental states, resources, or interaction histories are encountered. Existing scanners primarily rely on static analysis, predefined rules, or one-shot semantic judgments, making such conditional behavior difficult to elicit and attribute. We present SkillSentry, a dynamic
recommendations.summary_zh: 大型語言模型代理可透過外部技能擴充能力，但這些技能也引入了執行時攻擊面。現有掃描器依賴靜態分析或單次語意判斷，難以觸發並歸因僅在特定環境條件下出現的隱藏行為。SkillSentry 提出以動態安全測試框架解決此問題，核心概念為「能力漂移」測試：由技能描述與部署政策推導允許行為的能力契約，透過靜態分析找出可能超出契約的行為，並由語意評論家驗證測試計畫是否源於套件內容。接著，SkillSentry 建立配對的普通世界與蜜罐世界，後者僅添加最小且任務無關的誘餌資源（如偽造憑證、檔案），以觸發條件式行為。每個測試執行四組實驗：有無技能 × 有無誘餌，透過基線差分與動態驗證器，僅當效果僅在技能啟用時完成、有原始碼支持且超出契約時，才判定為不安全。實驗顯示，SkillSentry 在標準基準上平均 F1 達 96.26%，在語意保留的規避攻擊下平均 F1 為 92.95%，顯著優於七種基線。消融研究證實靜態分析提供覆蓋，動態執行與驗證提高精確度。主要限制為每次技能需 119.47 秒與大量輸入 token，因此較適合高保證的部署前審計；作者也承認其能力契約依賴 LLM 詮釋，可能對描述不明確的技能產生偏誤。此研究提出將「可疑程式碼」與「實際造成的效果」區分開來的審計方法，有助於在技能供應鏈中偵測隱藏惡意行為，並提供可重現的證據。

Across model tiers, LLMs play suboptimally in simple games such as tic-tac-toe or Connect Four, and l
recommendations.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討大型語言模型（LLM）在序貫決策任務上的表現，有別於單次推理任務，此類任務需要模型在動態環境中，針對對手行動做出反應，且獎勵往往延遲。作者採用完全可觀測的兩人零和博弈作為測試平台，例如井字棋、尼姆遊戲及四子棋，這些遊戲具有明確規則與可計算的最優策略，提供客觀的評估基準。實驗發現，即便最先進的模型在這些簡單遊戲中表現欠佳：高效能與中階模型在井字棋與尼姆遊戲中頻頻失誤；前沿模型對抗蒙特卡羅樹搜尋（MCTS）對手時，在四子棋中幾乎全數落敗。此外，作者設計語意等價但表面形式不同的「混淆」版本，發現模型表現大致不變，且推理歷程常能識別出原始遊戲，顯示此缺口並非僅源於記憶，而是決策當下的推理瓶頸。為解決此問題，作者提出 REAPER（Reflective Experiential Agent with Periodic Extraction of Rules）框架，在不調整模型權重的前提下，透過回合結束後反思每個行動的貢獻，並定期萃取一般性策略規則，以提供更細緻的決策信號。實驗結果顯示，在井字棋對上最優對手時，REAPER 顯著優於直接移植的 Memento 與強化後的基線，同時降低輸出 token 數。此研究顯示外部經驗記憶能改善 LLM 代理的序貫決策能力，但對於更大規模遊戲、更長視野與部分可觀測環境的適用性仍有待探討。

This creates a direct distribution channel for malicious behavior, yet existing malicious-Skill datasets are fragmented across sources, artifact formats, evidence regimes, and benign coverage; duplicated and structurally related content further complicates direct aggregation and evaluation. We present MaliciousSkillBench, a comprehensive benchmark for malicious A
recommendations.summary_zh: Agent Skill 是讓大型語言模型（LLM）代理取得可重複使用能力的指令套件，但惡意 Skill 可能竊取憑證、操縱代理行為或植入後門，使安裝前的偵測成為重要的資安問題。然而現有資料集來源零散、證據標準不一、內容互相重複，難以支撐可靠評估。本文提出 MaliciousSkillBench：作者凍結 13 個公開來源，保留 11 個符合嚴格條件者，將 8,414 筆原始惡意紀錄去重為 7,539 個正規化唯一身分與 4,588 個結構家族；排除 34 組跨標籤衝突後，主要基準含 9,740 個 Skill（7,505 個惡意、2,235 個良性），並為其中 4,983 個惡意身分對應 11 類攻擊，顯示各來源的威脅組成差異懸殊。評估方面，三個文字偵測器在隨機切分下 Macro-F1 達 0.882–0.932，最強的 word TF–IDF SVM 在留出來源測試卻降至 0.665：惡意召回率仍有 95.6%，良性誤報率卻高達 62.4%；三款現成掃描器（Cisco、SkillSpector、SkillFortify）則走向另一極端，召回率僅 0%–25.3%，低誤報其實是犧牲偵測能力換來的。研究限制包括覆蓋範圍受限於既定來源、僅分析靜態文字而非執行時行為，且來源與標籤組成互相糾結。此基準的價值在於證明可靠偵測必須同時衡量攻擊召回與良性誤報，並為防禦性研究提供可重現的共同評比基礎。
recommendations.title: MaliciousSkillBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Malicious Agent Skill Detection
recommendations.title_zh: MaliciousSkillBench：惡意代理 Skill 偵測的全面性基準

links.title: VIBE: A VAD-Informed Benchmark for Entity-Centered Affective Profiling of Large Language Model Outputs

evidence: Abstract states 'We introduce VIBE, a benchmark for entity-centered affective profiling of LLM outputs in Valence-Arousal-Dominance (VAD) space.'
Section 5 lists six instruction-tuned generators and detailed scorer assignment.
Section 11 provides reproducibility commands and artifact schema.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant: directly targets LLM affective outputs, evaluation methodology, and AI safety aspects. Novel benchmark with clear contracts and quantified findings. Rigorous with extensive validation, human calibration, and robustness checks. Generalizable across models and protocols, though some limitation in full multilingual coverage. Reproducibility artifacts included.

primary_link.title: VIBE: A VAD-Informed Benchmark for Entity-Centered Affective Profiling of Large Language Model Outputs

recommendations.summary: Large language models routinely describe socially salient targets, including political figures, countries, religions, organizations, historical events, and social groups, encoding affective framing alongside factual content: a target may appear favorable or threatening, calm or conflictual, powerful or vulnerable. Existing work captures parts of this space through sentiment, favorability, and emotion benchmarks, but none combines target-directed VAD attribution, an explicit scorer contract, and
recommendations.summary_zh: VIBE是一項以Valence-Arousal-Dominance（VAD）三維情感空間為核心的基準，旨在系統性地剖析大型語言模型（LLM）產出中，針對特定社會性顯著目標（如政治人物、國家、宗教、社會群體等）的情感框架。作者認為，傳統的標量情感傾向（scalar favorability）或整體回應情感評分，無法捕捉目標導向情感的完整樣貌，因此提出一套明確的「測量契約」，將文本生成與外部評分分離，並區分標量傾向、回應層級VAD與目標導向VAD三種評分模式，最後以「情感護照」（Affective Passport）作為報告格式，詳細記錄評分者身分、協議條件、涵蓋範圍與詮釋限制。研究透過三個經驗層級驗證其主張：H1證明標量傾向無法取代喚起度與支配度，雖然效價（valence）具有高度交叉驗證信度（評分者與人類相關性約0.944），但喚起度與支配度僅為單一評分者的方向性估計，且人類注釋者本身在這些軸上的一致性就偏低；H2顯示整體回應與目標導向的VAD評分存在顯著差異，尤其在支配度軸上；H3則量化了誘發協議條件（如情境框架、指令語言）對情感輪廓的影響，發現情境框架的影響遠大於模型身分。VIBE的貢獻在於提供一個更細緻、可重現的情感剖析工具，並強調情感報告必須附帶完整的測量脈絡，以避免跨模型或跨協議的錯誤比較。然而，研究也承認其依賴LLM評分者，且喚起度與支配度的絕對數值應視為序數趨勢而非精確點估計，目標庫亦非窮盡，這些都是解讀結果時需謹慎考量的限制。
recommendations.title: VIBE: A VAD-Informed Benchmark for Entity-Centered Affective Profiling of Large Language Model Outputs
recommendations.title_zh: VIBE：以VAD資訊為基礎的基準，用於大型語言模型輸出之實體中心情感剖析

links.title: PAST-Bench: Benchmarking the Foundations of Recursive Self-Improvement in Personal Agents

evidence: Benchmark spans 26 scenarios and 204 episodes across four capabilities (Section 1, Tables 2-3)
Evaluates seven base models and four agent frameworks (Tables 2-3)
Proposes Hermes+ with five interventions, showing improvement in Update capability (Section 4.4)
Includes mechanism-evidence score to attribute gains to intended persistence pathway (Appendix B)
Provides human validation of LLM judge (Table 8)
Reports reproducibility details including model inference settings (Appendix E)
llm_evaluation.rationale: The paper introduces PAST-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating recursive self-improvement in personal AI agents, focusing on memory, procedural reuse, information gathering, and update. It includes extensive experiments across multiple models and frameworks, proposing Hermes+ with targeted interventions. The work is highly relevant to LLM agents, memory, and evaluation, with strong rigor and evidence, though generalizability is moderate due to synthetic tasks. It contributes novel methodology with matched controls and mechanism evidence.

primary_link.title: PAST-Bench: Benchmarking the Foundations of Recursive Self-Improvement in Personal Agents

recommendations.summary: Recursive self-improvement requires agents to turn accumulated experience into better future behavior. Personal AI agents offer a concrete setting for studying this capability because they retain preferences, task histories, tool routines, and learned skills across sessions. Yet whether retained experience actually improves them over time has not been systematically tested. We introduce PAST-Bench, a benchmark designed to isolate this question. Each agent runs through ordered sequences of fresh-
recommendations.summary_zh: 本文提出 PAST-Bench，一個用於評測個人化 AI 代理能否藉由保留跨 session 的經驗來改善未來行為的基準。研究動機是：個人化代理雖能累積記憶、技能與工作流程，但既有評測基準無法區分效能提升是來自保留經驗，還是來自基礎模型、執行環境或任務難度。PAST-Bench 以「任務家族」為單位，每個家族包含有序的一系列全新 session episode，並配對「持久化開啟」與「持久化關閉」兩種條件，以隔離保留經驗的貢獻。基準涵蓋記憶、程序重用、資訊收集與更新四種能力，共 26 個情境、204 個 episode，並提供機制證據追蹤，以確認改進是否確實透過寫入、檢索、套用或更新等預期路徑發生。實驗於七個基礎模型與四個代理框架上進行，結果顯示自演化確實存在但因能力而異；相同總體增益可能隱藏不同的機制路徑。根據診斷，作者提出 Hermes+ 框架，在代理迴圈的五個階段（規劃、渲染、路由、閘控、收尾）加入五項干預機制。Hermes+ 在 MiniMax-M2.7 上將總體增益從 +0.13 提升至 +0.15，機制證據從 0.64 提升至 0.73，其中更新能力上的增益最顯著（+0.24）。然而，總體增益的差異小於運行間變異，且效果在能力與模型間並不均勻，作者因此將 Hermes+ 定位為診斷工具而非通用改進。此研究的意義在於提供一個評估與診斷基礎，以探討持久化代理如何從僅保留經驗，進展到系統性地透過經驗進行自我改進。限制包括任務家族為合成建構、評估情境孤立、機制證據不具因果必然性，且未涵蓋更強形式的遞迴自我改進。
recommendations.title: PAST-Bench: Benchmarking the Foundations of Recursive Self-Improvement in Personal Agents
recommendations.title_zh: PAST-Bench：評測個人化代理中遞迴自我改進的基礎

links.title: How Much Does a Reasoning Summary Reveal? An Observability Ladder for Large Language Models

evidence: Abstract states summaries carry most trace ranking signal (mean AUROC 0.774 vs 0.813) and add +0.156 over response without prompt
Section 3 shows summary gain collapses to +0.019 with prompt visible, while trace adds +0.041
Section 5 reports linear summary readers near chance (within-item AUROC 0.503-0.545) on repeated runs
Methods and Appendix A describe experimental design with five models, three benchmarks, and matched linear predictors
llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly addresses LLM reasoning traces, chain-of-thought, and monitorability, core AI safety topics. Highly relevant to LLM, reasoning, safety, and evaluation preferences. Novel observability ladder framework. Rigorous methodology with multiple benchmarks, models, ablations, and controls. Strong quantitative evidence with AUROC analyses and bootstrapped intervals. Findings about summary vs trace informativeness are impactful. Generalizable across models and benchmarks. Reproducibility high due to open-source datasets, code, and detailed methods.

primary_link.title: How Much Does a Reasoning Summary Reveal? An Observability Ladder for Large Language Models

recommendations.summary: Large language models often show users a final response and a short reasoning summary while the full reasoning trace stays hidden. We introduce an observability ladder that holds each completed run fixed and varies only what a reader inspects to judge whether the answer is correct: the response, a self-summary the model writes from the trace, the trace itself, and internal signals, each with and without the prompt. Across three benchmarks and five open-weight Qwen3 and gpt-oss models, we train m
recommendations.summary_zh: 這篇論文提出一個「可觀測性階梯」（observability ladder）的框架，系統性地檢驗大型語言模型（LLM）在使用者面前揭露不同層級資訊時，能多好地預測模型最終答案是否正確。作者固定每次完成的推理過程，僅改變監測者可見的證據：僅有回應、回應加自摘要、再加上完整推理軌跡，以及需要直接模型存取才能得到的內部訊號（如答案機率與隱藏狀態），並分別在有無提示詞（prompt）的情況下進行比較。研究涵蓋五個開放權重模型（Qwen3-4B、Qwen3-8B、Qwen3-14B、gpt-oss-20b、gpt-oss-120b）與三個基準（GPQA-Diamond、MMLU-Pro、Omni-MATH-2-Filtered），訓練配對的線性正確性預測器。主要結果顯示：在沒有提示詞時，摘要承載了軌跡大部分的分類訊號（平均AUROC 0.774對比0.813），且相較於僅回應增加0.156；但當提示詞可見時，摘要的增益大幅縮小至+0.019，而完整軌跡仍能增加+0.041。在相同字數下，軌跡末尾的摘錄表現與摘要相當或更好，且含有更密集、更具區辨力的不確定性與自我修正線索。在重複執行同一問題的對照實驗中，線性摘要閱讀器幾乎接近隨機，軌跡閱讀器也僅保留微弱訊號。GPT-5-mini作為更強的閱讀器，能在摘要與軌跡中恢復更多訊號，但軌跡仍略勝一籌。研究限制包括：自摘要為受控代理、結論依賴特定閱讀器、僅衡量最終答案正確性，且長度與訊號糾纏。此研究強調，可監測性（monitorability）是顯示內容與閱讀器的共同屬性，任何關於可監測性（包括忠實度）的主張都應明確指出這兩者。
recommendations.title: How Much Does a Reasoning Summary Reveal? An Observability Ladder for Large Language Models
recommendations.title_zh: 推理摘要會揭露多少資訊？大型語言模型的可觀測性階梯

links.title: Hybrid-Policy Self-Editing for Composable Unstructured Knowledge Editing

evidence: Section 2.2 formulates UKE composability and introduces decomposition and composition probes.
Section 4.1 reports experiments across Qwen2.5, Qwen3, Llama3.1, and Gemma2 with FT-M and LoRA editors.
Table 1 reports quantitative single-edit improvements; Section 4.3 and Appendix D.1 report continual-editing results.
Appendix C.2 provides training hyperparameters and model checkpoints.
llm_evaluation.rationale: LLM-centric knowledge editing with compositional reasoning is strongly matched to preferences. The hybrid-policy self-editing idea is a reasonable novel extension of on-policy distillation, but mostly incremental over prior OPSD/hybrid-distillation work. Rigor is moderate: multiple backbones, editors, ablations, and theory, but metrics rely heavily on LLM-as-judge and lack statistical significance testing. Generalizability is confined to gradient-based knowledge editors. Reproducibility is supported by code link and detailed hyperparameters.

primary_link.title: Hybrid-Policy Self-Editing for Composable Unstructured Knowledge Editing

recommendations.summary: Large language models (LLMs) achieve remarkable performance across natural language tasks, yet they are trained on static corpora and their knowledge quickly becomes outdated in a fast-changing world. This motivates knowledge editing (KE), which updates specific knowledge in an LLM without changing unrelated others. Recent works move from structured knowledge triples toward unstructured KE (UKE), where the edit is a free-form passage that may state multiple facts at once. Nonetheless, existing e
recommendations.summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）知識會過時，知識編輯（KE）藉由更新特定知識來因應。然而，非結構化知識編輯（UKE）中，現有方法僅被動地將新段落注入模型，導致編輯後的知識無法分解為個別事實，也無法組合進行多跳推理，此即本研究所定義的「可組合性」（composability）。作者提出HPSE方法，利用同一模型的特權上下文狀態進行主動式自蒸餾，並在學生的軌跡覆蓋不足時，以混合策略讓特權模型介入，提供更完整的事實導向監督。理論分析證明HPSE相較於純在策略蒸餾，在事實跨度上具有線性優勢。實驗於四個LLM與兩種編輯器上進行，結果顯示HPSE能一致提升單次與持續編輯的可組合性，且不損害局部性，為現有梯度式KE方法提供即插即用改良。
recommendations.title: Hybrid-Policy Self-Editing for Composable Unstructured Knowledge Editing
recommendations.title_zh: 混合策略自編輯：可組合非結構化知識編輯

links.title: When Many Answers Are Valid, Voting Fails: Symbolic Verification for Best-of-K Causal Reasoning in LLMs

evidence: Abstract: CALVER reaches 42.1% where plurality, a reward model, an LLM judge, and model confidence remain near 30%.
Method: Six deterministic checks scoring traces against causal criteria.
Experiments: Table 2: CALVER gains up to 24.1pp over medoid across 8 policies.
Limitations: Applicability limited to domains with executable validity predicates.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to LLMs, reasoning, self-consistency, and verification. Novel combination of causal reasoning with symbolic verification for best-of-k selection; robust theory and extensive experiments; clear limitations.

primary_link.title: When Many Answers Are Valid, Voting Fails: Symbolic Verification for Best-of-K Causal Reasoning in LLMs

recommendations.summary: Self-consistency assumes the most frequent answer among sampled reasoning traces is the most reliable, but this can fail in causal reasoning: samples often repeat the same confounding error, and votes fragment across multiple valid answers, letting an invalid answer win despite a valid minority trace. We introduce CALVER (Causal Axiom-Level VERification), a training-free symbolic verifier that scores structured traces against Pearl's causal criteria, including -separation, backdoor adjustment, a
recommendations.summary_zh: 這篇論文研究大型語言模型（LLM）在因果推理任務上，使用自洽性（self-consistency）等基於投票的測試時間擴展方法時，可能因『多個答案都有效』而失效的問題。作者指出，在如後門調整集（backdoor adjustment set）等因果查詢中，往往存在多個圖論上有效的答案，使正確答案的票數分散，反而讓單一但錯誤的答案成為多數。為解決此問題，作者提出 CALVER（Causal Axiom-Level VERification），這是一個無需訓練的符號驗證器，它利用 Pearl 的因果圖準則（如 d-separation、後門調整、介入操作等），對模型抽樣的每個推理軌跡進行六項結構化檢查，並選取分數最高的候選答案，而不參考基準答案。實驗顯示，在 CLEAR 基準的 find-one-valid 查詢上，CALVER 的正確率達 42.1%，顯著高於多數投票、獎勵模型、LLM 評審及模型信心度（約 30%），且優勢隨抽樣預算 K 增加而擴大，並在十個公開貝氏網路、不同模型家族及圖形由文字建構的情境中再現。論文亦證明嚴格 ATE 證書的健全性，並分析投票失敗的理論原因。限制在於 CALVER 依賴可執行的有效性述詞與因果結構（由使用者提供或從文字建構），當答案近乎唯一或圖形擷取可靠時，直接求解可能更佳。此研究的重要意義在於提出以任務有效性類別而非答案字串聚合的替代方案，為 LLM 在開放式因果推理任務的測試時間擴展提供符號驗證的新方向。
recommendations.title: When Many Answers Are Valid, Voting Fails: Symbolic Verification for Best-of-K Causal Reasoning in LLMs
recommendations.title_zh: 當許多答案都有效時，投票會失敗：LLM 中 Best-of-K 因果推理的符號驗證

links.title: When Correct Solutions Repeat: Rarity-Aware Credit Redistribution for GRPO

evidence: Abstract: 'Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) commonly optimizes each correct completion as an independent learning signal.'
Experimental Setup: 'Our primary experiments fine-tune Qwen2.5-Math-7B with LoRA...'
Experiments: 'Cue-GRPO improves over vanilla GRPO at all reported AIME budgets...'
Main Results: 'Cue-GRPO also outperforms the 32B-judge UARL baseline on AIME at all three budgets.'
Methodology: 'Partition-Conditioned Credit Redistribution' states the main theoretical contribution.
Reproducibility: 'Code is available at https://github.com/CzZ12/When-Correct-Solutions-Repeat-Rarity-Aware-Credit-Redistribution-for-GRPO.'
llm_evaluation.rationale: The paper is centrally about RLVR for LLM reasoning, addressing credit redistribution with GRPO. It combines LLM fine-tuning, reasoning, RLHF-adjacent alignment (reward shaping), and RL training improvements. Extensive concrete experiments on Qwen2.5-Math and Llama-3.1 with multiple benchmarks, ablations, multi-seed tests, and available code. Novel contribution clearly identified. Strong methodological rigor and evidence. Generalizability partially limited to math reasoning but tested on two backbones and several benchmarks, so relatively good. Reproducibility high due to code release and detailed training/evaluation protocols. Preference weight for RL, reasoning, and LLM is high, while secondary topics like safety or multimodal are absent. Overall score reflects weighted preferences and strict discipline.

primary_link.title: When Correct Solutions Repeat: Rarity-Aware Credit Redistribution for GRPO

recommendations.summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) com- monly optimizes each correct completion as an independent learning signal. In GRPO, this completion-level uniformity creates structure-level skew: recurring correct solution forms accumulate positive coefficient mass in proportion to how often they are sampled, while rare forms receive limited credit. We formalize this behavior as multiplicity-induced structure-level credit concentration and introduce a partition- conditioned rule that r
recommendations.summary_zh: 本篇論文針對 Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO）在可驗證獎勵強化學習（RLVR）中的一個結構性偏誤提出修正。作者指出，GRPO 在二值獎勵下對每個正確完成給予相同的正向優勢，但當多個正確完成共享同一種解題形式時，該形式會因其出現頻率而累積不成比例的正向信用，形成所謂的多重性誘發結構級信用集中。為解決此問題，論文提出分割條件化的信用重新分配規則（Credit Redistribution, CR），依集群稀有度重新分配正向優勢，同時保持負向優勢不變。作者並引入 Cue-GRPO 作為低開銷實現，利用確定性的策略線索（Strategy Cues）建構 rollout 局部的分割，無需輔助模型推論。實驗在 Qwen2.5-Math-7B 與 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 上進行，結果顯示 Cue-GRPO 在高採樣預算下顯著提升 AIME 的重複採樣表現，例如 Qwen2.5-Math-7B 在 AUC@256 從 GRPO 的 39.89 提升至 42.75，且僅增加約 6% 的訓練開銷。機制分析證實斜率從 1.00 降至 0.72，顯示信用集中確實被削弱。消融實驗顯示隨機集群與均勻提升均無法完全複製增益，而 α=0.8 為最佳設定。此外，CR-JP 控制組使用基於裁判的分割，也優於 UARL 基線，顯示 CR 可與不同分割來源搭配。限制包括策略線索目錄僅涵蓋競賽數學領域，且增益在高飽和基準（如 MATH500、GSM8K）上不明顯。整體而言，此研究將信用分配與分割建構分離，提出一個實用的設計軸，對提升 LLM 在重複採樣下的推理可靠性具有重要意義。
recommendations.title: When Correct Solutions Repeat: Rarity-Aware Credit Redistribution for GRPO
recommendations.title_zh: 當正確解答重複出現：GRPO 的稀有度感知信用重新分配

evidence: Abstract: comparative analysis of 27 CLA score variants
Section 3.1: propose fewshot embedding extraction method
Section 6.1: propose PMI-based translation metric
Section 6.2-6.3: correlations with chrF and PMI
Section 8: conclusions and evidence for English pivot language
Limitations: discusses domain coverage and language coverage
Ethical Considerations: code availability on GitHub
llm_evaluation.rationale: High relevance to multilingual LLMs, cross-lingual alignment, and prompting; strong methodology with comprehensive evaluation across tasks and models; novel contributions in few-shot embeddings and PMI metric; reproducible with open code.

primary_link.title: Predicting Multilingual Classification and Translation Performance of LLMs with Cross-Lingual Alignment $\unicode{x2013}$ Is English Enough?

recommendations.summary: Multilingual large language models (LLMs) have been shown to perform better on non-English classification tasks when the representations of the given language are more aligned to English within the model. Several cross-lingual alignment (CLA) scores have been proposed for use with LLMs, along with multiple approaches for extracting embeddings from the models. We provide a comparative analysis of 27 CLA score variants, examining how they differ and how well each predicts downstream performance ac
recommendations.summary_zh: 這篇研究探討多語言大型語言模型（LLM）在非英語任務上的表現，是否可透過衡量各語言與英語的「跨語言對齊（CLA）」分數來預測，並進一步檢驗模型是否將英語作為內部中繼語言。作者整合五種句子表示方法與六種對齊指標，共計27種CLA分數組合，在三種任務上進行比較，包括SIB-200文本分類、Belebele閱讀理解，以及Flores-200與BOUQuET的機器翻譯。在翻譯任務中，作者提出以「點間互資訊（PMI）」為基礎的評估指標，用以取代對目標語言有系統性偏誤的chrF分數，使跨語言比較更為公平。實驗涵蓋44種語言、三個模型家族（Qwen3、gemma-3、Ministral-3）的基礎與指令微調版本。結果顯示，與英語的CLA分數（src-en與en-tgt）在預測翻譯品質上，效果等同或優於源語言與目標語言之間的CLA（src-tgt），且最佳權重組合中src-tgt的權重趨近於零，為「LLM以英語為內部樞紐」的論點提供了新證據。此外，在相近語言對（如捷克語與斯洛伐克語）的實驗中，src-tgt對齊的權重則變得主導，顯示模型若直接翻譯較為容易時，可能不須依賴英語作為中介。作者建議採用位置加權平均（p-wm）結合平均神經元相關性（ANC）作為系統層級的CLA評估組合。研究限制包含平行資料領域有限、新提出的fewshot嵌入方法依賴維基數據描述、PMI指標無法完全證明目標語言獨立性，以及語言覆蓋偏重歐洲語言。整體而言，此研究提供了一套評估多語言能力的框架，也對LLM內部運作機制提出重要洞見。
recommendations.title: Predicting Multilingual Classification and Translation Performance of LLMs with Cross-Lingual Alignment $\unicode{x2013}$ Is English Enough?
recommendations.title_zh: 多語言分類與翻譯效能之預測：跨語言對齊是否以英語為核心？

links.title: MemToC: Benchmarking Memory-Tool Conflict Resolution in Large Language Models

evidence: §1/§3.3: controlled post-tool-call setting with injected returns of known correctness enables four source-correctness cases plus tool-error and no-tool controls
§3.2: 3,912 sub-questions filtered to 605, then 575 with verified answers, blinded two-annotator QC yields 542 final questions; 542×4×3 = 6,504 episodes
§5.1 (Table 1): instruction-tuned baselines retain verified answers in only 6.5–17.1% of eligible cases vs 86.0–93.1% correct-tool following; incorrect-tool following 78.4–86.0%

§5.2: SFT and DPO meet the asymmetric criterion on the same two of four backbones (Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, gemma-2-9b-it); Mistral SFT gains retention +41.8 but loses correct-tool following −27.6 and abstention −57.7
§5.4: prompting raises retention in 11/12 pooled combinations but every strategy reduces tool-error abstention for every model; abstain-and-flag cuts Llama correct-tool following 88%→24%
§5.4/App. G: tool-choice protocol is a model×protocol interaction; Llama drops 0.992→0.328 under free auto choice, repaired by schema-constrained decoding to 0.992, replicated at T=0.7
App. F.1: OOD transfer to FaithEval/ARC is positive but frame-dependent; abstention leak confirmed on all three transferred arms; disclosed matcher repair flipped one preregistered retention gate
§6: limitations—no proprietary models, single ToolHop core, 426/575 machine-authored distractors from one generator, annotators are authors, forced elicitation makes retention upper bounds
§8: benchmark, code, scoring layer, and per-claim map released Apache-2.0 with a verification script recomputing 180 reported values; two unrecomputable families are named rather than omitted
llm_evaluation.rationale: squarely in-scope LLM work: tool-augmented LLM arbitration between parametric memory and tool returns, evaluated on Llama/Qwen/Gemma/Mistral, mitigated with DPO/SFT and prompting. The controlled design—injecting tool returns of known correctness so arbitration (not mere source preference) is measurable (§1, §3.3)—is a genuine methodological advance over prior conflict benchmarks; the asymmetric success criterion and cross-fitted chain-level splits are thoughtful. Rigor is exceptional: preregistered protocol, Holm-corrected permutation tests with cluster bootstrap (§4.5, App. B), blinded scorer validation (κ=0.806, §4.2) and target validation (κ=0.785, §3.4), disclosed post-hoc matcher repair that flipped one gate (App. F.1), and honest negative results (prompting trade-offs §5.4, 19/20 arms reduce abstention; SAE steering asymmetry App. C). Evidence is strong with CIs, replication at T=0.7, and version provenance, though transfer rests on small verified pools (279/185 episodes) and two of four backbones lack seed replication. Generalizability is limited: only open-weight 7–9B models plus one confounded 70B probe (App. F.2), a single ToolHop-derived core with one distractor realization skewed to biographical domains, and annotators who are also authors (§6). Reproducibility is excellent: Apache-2.0 release with a verification script recomputing 180 values and a per-claim file map (§8), though fine-tuned absolute levels need unreleased training runs. Score reflects top-tier methodological care with moderate external validity.

primary_link.title: MemToC: Benchmarking Memory-Tool Conflict Resolution in Large Language Models

recommendations.summary: Tool-augmented LLMs must arbitrate between two fallible sources when a tool return conflicts with their parametric memory, yet existing evaluations measure source preference without establishing source correctness. We introduce MemToC, a controlled benchmark for post-tool-return arbitration with executable tools. MemToC comprises 6,504 evaluation episodes constructed from 542 quality-controlled factual questions, independently elicited model-specific closed-book answers, and controlled tool retu
recommendations.summary_zh: 工具增強的大型語言模型在工具回傳結果與其參數記憶矛盾時，必須在兩個都可能出錯的來源間仲裁，但既有評測往往只量測來源偏好，未事先確認來源正確性。本文提出 MemToC：自 ToolHop 資料集建構 542 道經品質控管的事實性問題，為每個模型獨立引出閉卷回答，再提供正確性已知的受控工具回傳，形成 6,504 個評測情境，依來源正確性劃分四種案例並設對照組，使仲裁行為而非單純偏好得以量測。在五個開放權重 7–9B 模型上，工具回傳強烈壓倒模型自身答案：四個指令微調模型在記憶正確而工具錯誤時，僅 6.5–17.1% 保留正確答案；工具正確時有 86.0–93.1% 跟隨；兩來源皆錯時仍有 78.4–86.0% 重複錯誤回傳，且排序在三種提示措辭間不穩定。作者以鏈層級交叉切分避免訓練與評測洩漏，比較提示策略與 SFT、DPO 微調，並採非對稱成功準則：正確答案保留率須提升，且正確工具跟隨率不得顯著下降。SFT 與 DPO 僅在相同兩個骨幹（Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct、gemma-2-9b-it）達標，顯示結果取決於骨幹多於最佳化目標；20 個方法—模型組合中有 19 個降低工具錯誤後的棄答率，增益常伴隨對工具的普遍不信任，外部遷移亦不完整且依模型而異。限制包括僅涵蓋 ToolHop 與開放權重模型、干擾答案建構單一、部分模型未做多種子驗證、強制引出使保留率成為上限，人工標記者亦為作者。本文將工具—記憶衝突重新框架為正確性條件化仲裁，凸顯評測須同時檢視正確工具使用、棄答與對措辭的穩健性。
recommendations.title: MemToC: Benchmarking Memory-Tool Conflict Resolution in Large Language Models
recommendations.title_zh: MemToC：評測大型語言模型的記憶—工具衝突解決能力

links.title: AgentSpec: Speculative Decoding for Batch Inference of LLM Agents

evidence: Abstract: proposes AgentSpec with structure-isolated drafting and redundancy-aware budget allocation; claims at most 2.02x speedup over autoregressive decoding for agent batch inference.
Section 3.2 / Table 1: measured average per-request rejection rates of 53.3% (EAGLE-3), 88.7% (NGram), 65.9% (SuffixDecoding) vs 26.4% for AgentSpec on the Reflexion code-generation workflow.
Section 3.2 / Figure 2: FFN latency of Qwen-3-8B grows linearly beyond batch size 256 on A100, motivating the token budget M(b)=AI-b definition.

Section 5.2 / Table 2: goodput results across Qwen-3-8B, GPT-OSS-20B, DeepSeek-Distill-8B on GAIA, SWE-Bench, Deep Research, Code Generation; AgentSpec achieves up to 104% relative gain and 2.02x speedup while several baselines fall below 1.0x.
Section 5.5 / Table 3: on MiMo-7B, MTP reaches only 0.73x speedup on Code Gen (All) while AgentSpec reaches 1.29x.
Section 5.6 / Table 5: execution breakdown shows AgentSpec verification cost 26.11 min (down 21%) and overall 27.85 min (down 19%) vs baselines.

Section 5.7 / Table 6: ablations AgentSpec(S), AgentSpec(R), AgentSpec(N) show structure-isolated drafting contributes more than redundancy-aware budget allocation, and the no-structure variant still outperforms baselines.
Section 5.4 / Table 4: on non-agentic Spec-Bench (Qwen-3-8B), AgentSpec achieves 1.14x overall speedup, smaller than agentic gains.

Section A.1: vLLM v0.12.0 V1 engine, A100 80G, FlashAttention-2, max batch 256, baselines run with official default configs, results averaged over five seeds; API extension with structure/query_id/agent_id fields documented.
Section A.3 / Table 7: H100 speedups (e.g., 2.28x CodeGen) exceed A100, supporting hardware generalization.
Limitation: acknowledges required lightweight interface between agent and serving system and dependence on explicit semantic blocks and repeated generation patterns.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly on-profile: an inference-efficiency method for LLM agents, evaluated on agent benchmarks (SWE-Bench, GAIA, USACO code generation, DeepResearch) in vLLM, matching Agents & Tool Use, LLM, Inference & Serving, and Code & Programming. Novelty is solid but incremental over SuffixDecoding/NGram-style draft-model-free speculation: structure-isolated drafting via a PDA over semantic blocks (Section 4.1) and redundancy-aware budget allocation (Section 4.2, Eq. 1-3) are concrete mechanisms, though budget-allocation ideas exist (AdaSpec, TETRIS). Rigor is good: bottleneck analysis with a cost model and FFN latency measurement (Section 3.2, Figure 2), four models from four families, four agentic workloads plus Spec-Bench, MTP comparison (Table 3), ablations isolating each component (Table 6), batch-size and thinking-mode sweeps (Figure 9), and H100 cross-check (Table 7). Weaknesses: losslessness is asserted in the abstract but no explicit output-equivalence verification is reported; baseline configs use defaults (Section A.1) which may favor the proposed method; no variance/CI despite five-run averaging; rejection-rate analysis concentrates on one Reflexion workload (Table 1). Evidence strength is high for throughput claims (Table 2: up to 104% gain, 2.02x speedup; Table 5: verification -21%), with the caveat above. Generalizability is supported across models, GPUs, and a non-agentic benchmark (1.14x, Table 4), though the method expects semantic-structure metadata from the agent, acknowledged in Limitations. Reproducibility is moderate: engine version, GPU, baseline hyperparameters, API extension example, and pseudocode are given (Section A.1, A.2), but no code-release claim and key hyperparameters (alpha, g_min) values are unspecified.

primary_link.title: AgentSpec: Speculative Decoding for Batch Inference of LLM Agents

recommendations.summary: Large language model (LLM)-based agent applications often incur high response time. Speculative decoding is a promising solution to improve the inference efficiency of LLM agents without impacting generation quality. However, state-of-the-art speculative decoding algorithms exhibit substantial speed degradation under large batch sizes, limiting their effectiveness to deploy in real-world agent applications. In this work, we first present a systematic analysis of speculative decoding for LLM agen
recommendations.summary_zh: 以大型語言模型（LLM）為基礎的代理應用常因多步推理與工具呼叫而推論成本高昂。推測解碼雖可無損加速生成，但在現代推論引擎普遍採用的大批次設定下，現有方法的加速效果會大幅衰退，甚至比自迴歸解碼更慢。作者分析後歸納兩大瓶頸：推測 token 的高拒絕率，以及動態 token 預算的低利用率。據此提出 AgentSpec，一套免草稿模型的推測解碼演算法：其一為結構隔離起草，要求代理提供語意結構識別資訊，透過輕量下推自動機追蹤語意區塊，僅從語意一致的歷史片段擷取草稿，將拒絕率降至約 26%，遠低於 EAGLE-3 的 53% 與 NGram 的 89%；其二為冗餘感知預算分配，以冗餘分數預測各請求的接受可能性，動態分配推測預算以貼近硬體可用上限。團隊在 vLLM 上實作，於 Qwen-3-8B、GPT-OSS-20B、DeepSeek 蒸餾模型與 MiMo-7B，以及程式碼生成、深度研究、SWE-Bench、GAIA 等代理式工作負載評估，最高達 2.02 倍加速，goodput 較最佳基線提升最多 104%，於 Spec-Bench 與對比 MiMo-7B 的 MTP 亦領先。消融實驗顯示兩個元件各有貢獻，其中結構隔離起草影響較大。限制在於需在代理與伺服器間加入輕量介面，且加速程度部分取決於工作負載中重複生成樣式的多寡；即使缺少明確語意結構，仍有穩定加速。此研究讓推測解碼在大批次代理服務場景重新變得實用，有助降低 LLM 代理的部署成本與延遲。
recommendations.title: AgentSpec: Speculative Decoding for Batch Inference of LLM Agents
recommendations.title_zh: AgentSpec：針對 LLM 代理批次推論的推測解碼演算法

links.title: AgentJudgeBench: A Multi-Difficulty Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Judges on Agentic Tool-Calling

evidence: Abstract: 3,808 instances, six DAG topologies, three difficulty tiers; hard without-GT alignment converges to a 77-82% band across all six judges, with GT exposure reducing alignment for GPT-5.4 (-1.5 pp) and Gemini-2.5-Pro (-3.9 pp).
Sec 3.2 / Table 2: full factorial alignment results across five generators, six judges, three difficulties, both GT conditions; QwQ-32B leads with-GT in 10 of 15 cells while never leading without-GT.
Appendix E (Table 10): 95% bootstrap CIs (n=2,000 stratified resamples) with half-widths <=0.3 pp for every cell, supporting robustness of monotone difficulty effects.

Appendix G (Tables 12-13): 120-record human study validates the programmatic scorer at 92.7% overall (82.5% on parameter structure); GPT-OSS-120B is most human-aligned judge (Delta=-2.8 pp) and QwQ-32B drops 1st to 4th under human verdicts.
Appendix N (Table 20): rewrite validation unanimity is 93.9% for hard-vs-medium but only 58.1% for medium-vs-easy, with the paper explicitly downgrading the medium tier to a robustness check.

Sec 4.2 RQ5 (Table 5/26): CoT thinking on/off changes alignment by at most 0.3 pp across 24 paired cells; RQ6 (Table 31): structured prompt advantage of +4.8 to +6.5 pp on one pairing only partially replicates and reverses on hard queries (+3.9/+2.4/-0.8 pp).
Appendix J (Table 1): C3 corrupted-GT control shows Gemini-2.5-Pro anchors to any reference block while QwQ-32B tracks its without-GT score within 0.2 pp.
Appendix O (Table 23): GPT-5.4 self-preference check finds aggregate bias +0.012 within cross-generator range but a localized sequence-accuracy over-credit of +0.172 vs <=+0.008 elsewhere.

Limitations / Appendix B: single-annotator validation, synthetic records with domain-drift risk, non-reproducible GPT-5.4 snapshot, and evaluation-time-only scope are all explicitly acknowledged and partially bounded (ranking shifts <=0.09 pp under generous correction).

Supplementary Material: dataset and all judge verdicts on HuggingFace (ServiceNow-AI/AgentJudgeBench) and pipeline code with reproducibility script via SyGra GitHub; verbatim prompts in Appendix W; GPT-5.4 identifier is a non-versioned Azure snapshot (Appendix M/P).
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly in-scope: a systematic reliability study of LLM-as-judge for agentic tool-calling, directly hitting top-weighted preferences (Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, evaluation/benchmarking, CoT ablation, prompt-format sensitivity). Novelty is solid though incremental in parts: individual ingredients (BFCL-style data, DAG benchmarks, judge models) exist, but the paired with/without-GT protocol with difficulty stratification, per-metric decomposition, and deterministic programmatic reference is a genuinely new combination (Appendix L comparison). Rigor is strong: full 5x6x3x2 factorial (321,648 evaluations, Appendix D), bootstrap CIs <=0.3 pp (Appendix E), corrupted-GT C3 control (Appendix J), 0.5-default C2 ablation (Table 4), CoT and temperature ablations each replicated on a second pairing (Appendix R), scorer human validation (Appendix G), self-preference check (Appendix O), and unusually honest limitations (single annotator, 58.1% medium-tier validation, non-reproducible GPT-5.4 snapshot). Evidence strength is high; key claims are backed by tables with CIs and bounded corrections (Table 15). Generalizability is the weakest axis: synthetic single-shot records, domain drift acknowledged, ceiling partly prompt-dependent for weak generators, and judge rankings are model-version-specific. Reproducibility is good (code, HF dataset, verbatim prompts in Appendix W) but marred by the non-reproducible GPT-5.4 Azure snapshot used as generator, judge, and meta-judge.

primary_link.title: AgentJudgeBench: A Multi-Difficulty Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Judges on Agentic Tool-Calling

recommendations.summary: LLM judges are widely used to evaluate agentic tool-calling systems, yet their reliability on structured, dependency-driven workflows remains largely unexamined. We present AgentJudgeBench, the first benchmark to systematically study LLM-as-a-judge reliability for agentic tool-calling over workflow DAGs, as distinct from the broader LLM-as-a-judge task of open-ended text or preference evaluation. The benchmark comprises 3,808 instances spanning six DAG topologies and three difficulty tiers, eval
recommendations.summary_zh: LLM 裁判已廣泛用於評估代理式工具呼叫系統，但在結構化、依賴驅動工作流程上的可靠性長期未被檢驗。本文提出 AgentJudgeBench，首個針對工作流程 DAG 上 LLM-as-a-judge 可靠性的系統性基準：包含 3,808 筆 BFCL 風格資料，橫跨六種 DAG 拓撲與三個難度層級，每筆均附經程式化驗證的 ground-truth 軌跡。五個生成器（3B–70B 開源模型與 GPT-5.4）產出工具呼叫預測，由六個裁判（20B 至前沿規模）在有／無 ground truth 的配對條件下，就工具選擇、參數結構、序列準確性與查詢覆蓋四項指標評分，合計 321,648 次評估。主要結果：裁判對齊度隨難度單調下降，無 ground truth 時降幅約 1.5 倍；高難度且無參考答案時，六個裁判不論規模皆收斂於 77–82% 窄幅區間，顯示模型容量無法克服的結構性天花板；提供 ground truth 未必有利，GPT-5.4 與 Gemini-2.5-Pro 對齊度反而下降，符合過度錨定；思維鏈推理與取樣溫度影響可忽略，結構化評分準則最多提升 6.5 個百分點但未必通用。有 ground truth 時 QwQ-32B 最貼近程式化參考，GPT-OSS-120B 最貼近人類判斷。限制包括資料為合成生成、程式化評分器在參數結構指標上與人類一致度僅 82.5%，medium 難度未完全校準，且 GPT-5.4 身兼生成器、裁判與改寫驗證的 meta-judge。本研究揭露 LLM 裁判的根本限制，為代理系統評估提供部署指引，警示不宜單一依賴任何裁判。
recommendations.title: AgentJudgeBench: A Multi-Difficulty Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Judges on Agentic Tool-Calling
recommendations.title_zh: AgentJudgeBench：以多難度基準評估 LLM 裁判於代理式工具呼叫的可靠性

links.title: Semantic Overlays: Mitigating Prompt Injection with Annotations Beyond Tokens and Steering Vectors

evidence: Abstract: SEP separation rises from 24.3% to 96.5% with utility unchanged, TensorTrust ASR falls 34.8% to 6.6%, all four PIArena families drop to 0% compliance, marked spans stay readable at 92.5% exact copy rate.
§7 Training: adapter is 50M parameters, base model untouched; training items share SEP's shape so SEP measures in-distribution generalization while TensorTrust and PIArena are zero-shot transfer.

Table 1 (§4): embedding-conditioned shared MLP reaches 99.5% exact span retrieval and 100% refusal-when-absent vs 63.3%/89.7% for a 604M per-overlay MLP, attributed to supervision sharing and state-conditioned writes.

Appendix I, Table I.1: replication on frozen Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct moves SEP 31.0%→96.2%, TensorTrust hijacking 68.9%→4.4%, all PIArena families to 0%, with hyperparameters unchanged and corpus re-derived per Appendix D.

Appendix E: red team of 222 adaptive black-box probes; no direct authority attacks succeeded, but trusted instructions that delegate to marked spans override the overlay, and no instruction hierarchy was trained.

Appendix F: documents SEP witness substring false positives (pen matches 'open'), a TensorTrust harness discarding 606 of 776 rows non-randomly, and substring scoring inflating extraction; main tables lead with the corrected rule and give published-rule numbers in parentheses.
Appendix G.1: three seeds at temperature 0.7 reproduce every SEP number within 0.4 points; run-to-run noise floor measured at ~2 points on a 300-item paired subset.
§8 and Appendix C: held-out instruction embeddings fail 0/120 by nearest-neighbor substitution (codes collapse to effective rank two), while held-out pointer concepts score 95%.

Reproducibility statement: code at github.com/JoshuaSP/semantic-overlays, corpus and adapter checkpoints on HuggingFace, ≈32 GPU-hours per overlay set, Appendix B gives full recipe and hyperparameters.

Appendix J: limitations include one base model at one scale, channel experiments not replicated, binary non-executable overlay, unmeasured agentic multi-turn settings, and unprofiled end-to-end serving latency.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM methodology and safety paper, squarely in scope: a trained span-targeted residual-stream adapter on frozen LLMs (Qwen3.5-9B, Llama-3.1-8B) that defends against prompt injection, directly matching high-weight preferences (LLMs, AI Safety, Red Teaming & Evaluation, Agents security, Interpretability/steering). Novelty is a genuine but incremental advance over prior defenses: unlike ISE/ASIDE/AIR it keeps the base frozen, applies edits only at designated prefill spans across all layers, state-conditioned and multiplexed; position-targeted steering is explicitly named as future work by Rimsky et al. Rigor is above average: four architectures compared on identical data (Table 1), loss ablation (CE vs KL vs hybrid, 93.5/88.5/79.6), Muon multiplier sweep, payload screening, mechanical target validation, a 222-probe adaptive red team, and honest reporting of failure modes (haiku 18% compliance; delegation attacks succeed; novel descriptors fail 0/120). Evidence is strong and specific (SEP 24.3→96.5 with utility ~unchanged on 9,160 items; TensorTrust 34.8→6.6 on all 776 rows; PIArena four families to 0%; replication on a second model family; seeded reruns within 0.4 points), and the authors surface defects in the very benchmarks they use, reporting both corrected and published-rule numbers. Generalizability is capped by single-scale testing (8-9B), channel experiments (§4-6) not replicated across families, single training runs outside the injection benchmarks, binary overlay only, and unmeasured multi-turn/agentic settings. Reproducibility is excellent: full pipeline code, corpus, and adapter checkpoints released, ~32 GPU-hours per set, recipes and harness deviations documented. Self-reported results and reliance on a small LLM judge for some scoring keep it short of the top band.

primary_link.title: Semantic Overlays: Mitigating Prompt Injection with Annotations Beyond Tokens and Steering Vectors

recommendations.summary: Everything a language model sees is tokens. The serving stack knows what each span is -- user input, tool output, instructions -- but the model must keep track of that itself, and it can lose track or be confused: text can be written to read like anything. Prompt injection is a natural exploit of this phenomenon. By scrambling the model's understanding of span identity, an attacker can induce unwanted and potentially dangerous actions. Adding a non-textual channel to the model's input -- a way t
recommendations.summary_zh: 語言模型的輸入全是token:部署端雖然知道每段文字來自使用者、擷取文件或工具,卻只能以可偽造的文字傳達這項資訊,提示注入攻擊正由此而生。本文提出Semantic Overlays:在凍結模型的殘差流上,於指定prefill位置套用小型學習式adapter,以頻外方式為跨度加上標記;標記是激活編輯而非文字,任何輸入皆無法模仿,基底模型完全未被修改,可依請求開關,其中以嵌入條件化的共享MLP效果最佳。實驗顯示:模型能讀回堆疊的視覺標記(99.5%精確跨度召回,缺席時100%正確拒答);標記能覆寫模型對內容的認知,例如宣稱片段是Python時,模型會忠實地以Python重寫該程式(97%);標記也能攜帶僅作用於該跨度的指令。將一個「勿執行」標記套用於不受信任內容即成提示注入防禦:SEP分離度自24.3%升至96.5%而效用不變(作者並發現且修正SEP評分器缺失),TensorTrust劫持成功率由34.8%降至6.6%,PIArena四類攻擊全數歸零,被標記內容仍可92.5%逐字引用;防禦亦在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上重現,紅隊222次自適應探測中直接權限攻擊皆未得手。限制:僅驗證單一規模、可信任指令委派至標記跨度時行為不一致、對最佳化式攻擊未經檢驗、未訓練的指令嵌入無法零樣本泛化,且假設部署端本身未被入侵。此法顯示頻外詮釋資料通道能兼顧安全與可用性,為不動權重的指令層級防護開創新路徑。

links.title: WebMCP-Phalanx: Enforcing and Characterizing Trust Boundaries for Browser-Integrated LLM Agents

evidence: Section 5.1: experiments conducted in a real browser environment on @mcp-b/global 2.3.2 (2026-06-17 draft spec); attack success defined as malicious tool invoked and exfiltrated data received at the receiving end.
Table 1 (Section 5.2): four-layer ablation (L0-L3), n=80 per cell; description injection 69/80 (L0) to 0/80 (L3); return-content injection 42/80 (L0) to 2/80 (L3).

Table 2 (Section 5.3) and Section 5.3 text: the 2/80 residuals at L2/L3 are explained as name-driven invocations occurring before inspection; Q detects the carrier 40/40; residuals are structural, not detection failures.

Table 3 (Section 5.4): cross-page semantic residual — lifecycle clearing alone leaves 70% ASR; lifecycle+framework yields 0% ASR at 100% completion; Section 5.2 reports no-attack baseline 61/80 statistically indistinguishable from L3 (p=0.48); Section 6.2 flags adversarial utility inflation (p=0.003).

Section 6.1: capability handles reduce overwrite/revocation attacks (V4, V6) from 20/20 to 0/20 and V5 legitimate responses rise 0/20 to 20/20; bearer-capability limits and confused-deputy risk acknowledged.

Section 6.2/Section 7: name-relevance Table 4 shows rule-based stripping ASR rises 0% to 70% with name relevance while multi-agent stays 0%; white-box adaptive attacker with Q's classifier prompt bypassed 15/16 description payloads with median one rewrite.

Section 7 (Limitations): reference implementation is a JavaScript polyfill emulating API-surface integrity and script provenance; site-declared trust policy and Request UI not empirically evaluated; Runtime Observation is detection/containment, not prevention; Section 5.1 uses a single unnamed language model and no code release is claimed.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly on-scope: security architecture for browser-integrated LLM agents with MCP-style tool calling, prompt-injection defense, and adversarial evaluation maps strongly to the Agents & Tool Use, AI Safety, LLM, and Red Teaming preferences. Strengths: well-specified threat model (same-origin script attacker, extensions explicitly out of scope), a clean four-layer ablation with n=80 per cell, a notable utility-confounder analysis anchoring completion to a no-attack baseline (p=0.48, p=0.003), an honest limitations section, and a white-box adaptive-attacker study showing 15/16 description-layer bypasses via tool-name relocation. Weaknesses: the asymmetric dual-agent quarantine is derivative of Dual-LLM/CaMeL-style privilege separation (novelty rests mainly on the browser-native capability layer and the WebMCP specification-level analysis); results are tied to one reference implementation version with an unnamed LLM; no empirical comparison against external defenses (CaMeL, ACE, IsolateGPT); two architectural components (trust policy, Request UI) are presented but not evaluated; no code/artifact release is claimed. Evidence is internally consistent and quantitative but self-contained, lowering generalizability and reproducibility. Calibrated weighted score ~0.78.

primary_link.title: WebMCP-Phalanx: Enforcing and Characterizing Trust Boundaries for Browser-Integrated LLM Agents

recommendations.summary: The emerging W3C WebMCP proposal enables LLM agents to invoke tools exposed by web pages. In multi-party web environments, however, integrating agent execution into a browser security model centered on the Same-Origin Policy (SOP) leaves insufficient provenance and lifecycle guarantees for agent-accessible tools, creating three risks: subject-attribution spoofing, uncontrolled tool lifecycles, and semantic prompt injection. We propose WebMCP-Phalanx, a dual-layer agent runtime architecture. Its
recommendations.summary_zh: 隨著 W3C 推動 WebMCP 標準草案，網頁將能向 LLM 代理人暴露可呼叫的工具，但也使代理執行落入以同源政策（SOP）為中心的瀏覽器安全模型；由於網站主程式、第三方廣告 SDK 與分析腳本共用同一 origin，規範未提供工具來源與生命週期保障，衍生主體歸屬偽冒、生命週期失控與語意提示注入等結構性弱點。作者提出 WebMCP-Phalanx 雙層架構：瀏覽器原生層以不可偽造的能力憑證綁定工具所有權，並結合遙測與生命週期監控產生綠、黃、紅三級信任標籤；多代理層則由不具工具呼叫權限的隔離代理（Q-LLM）先行檢視工具描述、輸入綱要與回傳內容，再交由擁有執行權限的特權代理（P-LLM）使用。真實瀏覽器實驗顯示，所有權機制將撤銷與覆寫攻擊成功率由 100% 降為 0%，雙代理執行環境擋下全部 80 次描述注入，回傳內容注入僅殘留 2 次，且任務效用與無攻擊基線無統計顯著差異。論文亦刻畫限制：同源腳本可自行註冊取得憑證，使來源維度失效；白箱自適應攻擊者能將指令藏於工具名稱並在檢查完成前觸發呼叫，繞過描述層過濾；polyfill 實作的安全假設屬模擬性質，能力憑證屬持有式憑證，仍有混淆代理人問題。作者建議 WebMCP 納入原生腳本來源與宣告式信任拓撲等機制，並新增呼叫時機閘門，盼在規範定型前落實安全設計，對瀏覽器整合代理的安全性與標準制定具直接參考價值。
recommendations.title: WebMCP-Phalanx: Enforcing and Characterizing Trust Boundaries for Browser-Integrated LLM Agents
recommendations.title_zh: WebMCP-Phalanx：為瀏覽器整合式 LLM 代理人強制並刻畫信任邊界

links.title: What Does Activation Steering Control? Attribution Across Answer Encodings and Output-Sensitive Subspaces

evidence: Abstract and Table 1: across all five A/B/C remappings on NormBank strict split, extraction-index effects (3.00-4.13) exceed semantic-label effects (up to 2.18), with advantage 1.95-4.04 and 93.8-97.6% positive pairs
Section 5.1/Table 17-18: norm-matched layer sweep shows extraction-index advantage rises from -0.061 at 50% depth to +0.236 at 75% and +0.208 at 87.5%, with paired depth contrasts excluding zero

Section 5.1/Table 22-24: validation-selected identifier-readout subspace contains 15.4% of CAA squared L2 energy yet retains 96.3% [95.8, 96.7] of the extraction-index effect; residual (84.6% energy) retains 1.0%; per-model retention 93.3-103.5%

Appendix C.1/Table 28: ITI-style replication across three retained models shows positive extraction-index advantage (5.63-9.33) under all five alternative mappings; wrong-sign control exceeded by 14.13 [14.09, 14.17]

Section 5.2/Table 3 and Appendix D: open-ended verdicts diverge from MCQ (refusal MCQ +3.28 vs open -0.13; sycophancy MCQ -0.48 vs open +1.11), with judge panel validated on 180 blinded human-scored responses (Pearson .927, QWK .929)

Section 4 and Appendix A: locked interventions (zero-based blocks 20/23/23/31, alpha=0.8), strict group-disjoint splits with zero cross-split overlap (Table 7), five seeded Gaussian controls, and group-cluster bootstrap with Holm correction (Appendix E.3)

Section 7 Limitations: audit covers only three three-label tasks and four instruction-tuned model families; factorial audit, localization, and ITI confined to NormBank; gradient subspace functionally localizes without identifying a complete circuit
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM interpretability/evaluation methodology paper: it audits what CAA/ITI activation steering actually controls by freezing interventions and counterfactually re-encoding MCQ answers, separating semantic-label, extraction-index, and extraction-row following, and localizing the effect to a low-rank output-sensitive subspace. Preference relevance is high (LLMs, interpretability, safety behaviors like hallucination/refusal/sycophancy, evaluation methodology). Novelty is solid: applying verbalizer/selector-remapping logic to attribute steering-induced changes is a genuinely new evaluation framework, though it builds on known MCQ-selection-bias work. Rigor is exceptional: 108-condition factorial audits, L2- and covariance-matched random controls, competence gating, wrong-sign controls, norm-matched layer sweeps, position controls, prespecified positive-gain criteria, cluster bootstrap with Holm correction, and blinded human validation of LLM judges (r=.927). Evidence is strong and quantified with tight CIs (Table 1: 3.00-4.13 extraction-index effects; Table 22: 15.4% energy retaining 96.3% of effect), and limitations are honestly scoped to three three-label tasks and four model families. Generalizability is decent but the paper itself documents reversals (Qwen, SC101), tempering universal claims. Reproducibility is aided by exact templates, locked hyperparameters, seeds, and split audits, though no explicit repository URL is stated. Score ~0.86.

primary_link.title: What Does Activation Steering Control? Attribution Across Answer Encodings and Output-Sensitive Subspaces

recommendations.summary: Activation steering is often evaluated under the answer encoding used to construct the direction. A reported gain may reflect the intended judgment or compatibility with answer identifiers seen during construction. We introduce Cross-Encoding Steering Evaluation, which freezes an intervention while re-encoding answers to the same held-out items. On NormBank, after A/B/C identifiers are reassigned, contrastive activation addition (CAA) induces larger target-versus-source score changes for the ext
recommendations.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討激活導引(activation steering)的根本證據問題:當對比激活加入(CAA)等介入手法在特定答案編碼下提升分數時,它究竟控制了什麼?作者提出「跨編碼導引評估」,在凍結介入方向的前提下,對同一批保留測試項目重新編碼答案(改變標籤對應、識別碼詞彙與列序),藉此區分語意標籤追隨、抽取索引追隨(extraction-index following)與抽取列追隨三種可能。在 NormBank 上,重新指派 A/B/C 後,CAA 對抽取索引的目標分數變化大於對語意標籤者;因子式審計(6 種語意映射、3 種識別碼詞彙、6 種列序,共 108 條件)證實效果追隨索引而非顯示列位置。經範數匹配後,此效果主要在較深層(75% 與 87.5% 深度)出現;一個僅佔方向平方範數 15.4% 的低秩輸出敏感子空間,卻保留了 96.3% 的效果,顯示高度集中。ITI 式方法在 NormBank 的三個模型重現同樣排序;MNLI 整體偏向抽取索引追隨(唯 Qwen 反轉),SC101 則偏向語意標籤追隨,顯示歸因隨模型與任務而異。開放式生成測試亦顯示選擇題分數與生成行為可能得出不同結論:幻覺在兩種評估皆為正,拒答僅在選擇題有增益,諂媚僅在開放式評估有增益。限制包括僅涵蓋三個三標籤任務與四個模型系列,子空間分析屬功能性定位而未找出完整電路。其重要性在於:單一答案編碼下的導引增益無法證明語意控制,導引主張須有與所宣稱控制層級相符的證據。

links.title: Whose Refusal Is It? The Unmeasured Contribution of Black-Box Multimodal Guardrails

evidence: §4.1 reports exact-match guard blocks vs judge-scored model refusals, with guard share ranging from 0% to 99% across the three read settings.

§4.2 Table 2 shows text-only guards dropping from 100/100 and 81/100 blocks to 0/100 when the same unencoded harmful payload moves from text to image, while a multimodal guard blocks 99/100 in both channels.
§4.6 Table 6 reports deployable vs granted protocol differences, including a -63pp granted effect that becomes -3pp and non-significant when deployable.
§4.8 Table 9 isolates read position inside ECSO, finding SAFE answer regeneration carries -18pp and -26pp while TELL and CAP stage grants are not significant.
§4.16 describes a designed end-to-end replicate of the protocol grid and drift band of 0-10pp, with architecture-ordered inflation reproducing across campaigns.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly relevant to AI safety, red-teaming/evaluation, and multimodal guardrails. The paper contributes a novel decomposition of defended-pipeline refusals into guard vs model refusals and shows evaluation-protocol artifacts can manufacture large apparent safety benefits. It reports quantitative exact-match counts, McNemar tests, multi-judge checks, a designed replicate, multiplicity control, and explicit limitations. Generalizability is deliberately constrained to specific defenses, targets, and encodings, and several findings rely on small or single-model cells, so magnitudes should not transfer. Reproducibility is strong via detailed artifacts and implementation disclosure. Assessment is based only on the supplied document, treated as untrusted data.

primary_link.title: Whose Refusal Is It? The Unmeasured Contribution of Black-Box Multimodal Guardrails

recommendations.summary: A black-box guardrail is evaluated as though the safety number it earns were its own. It is not. A defended pipeline holds two components that can refuse (the guardrail, and the target model out of its own alignment), and every reported metric is a sum over both. We show that the guardrail's actual share of the safety credited to it runs from none of it to essentially all of it, decided by two variables no evaluation records: which channel carries the payload, and what text the harness places in
recommendations.summary_zh: 本文探討黑箱防護欄（guardrail）在防禦管線中實際貢獻的安全性比例。作者指出，防禦管線中防護欄與目標模型皆可能拒絕有害請求，傳統攻擊成功率指標無法區分兩者貢獻。透過將防護欄阻擋（以固定拒答字串精確匹配）與模型自身拒答（以評判模型判讀）分離，他們發現防護欄的貢獻範圍可從0%到99%，取決於兩個未被記錄的變數：承載惡意內容的通道（文字或影像），以及評測時提供給防護欄內部讀取的文字（編碼攻擊或未編碼原始請求）。實驗顯示，僅文字防護欄對影像通道完全失明，而多模態防護欄雖能補足覆蓋，但在對抗性困難的正常流量上鑑別力較弱，因此建議以通道路由部署而非取代。此外，評測時若將未編碼請求提供給防護欄，會顯著高估其效益，且此效應主要由生成答案的階段而非決策階段所承載。作者亦修正自身先前的研究數據。主要限制在於結果基於特定防護欄、模型與攻擊編碼，通用性有限。此研究強調評估協議透明化的重要性，以免數字失真。
