links.title: TTPO: Test-Time Policy Optimization

evidence: Abstract + Table 2: claim 'raises Qwen3-1.7B from 38.0% to 45.2% in TTT' matches reported averages (Base 38.0, TTPO 45.2 over AIME26/HMMT26/BRUMO25).
Abstract + Table 7: non-thinking gains +25.2/+30.6/+36.4 correspond to Base 9.5/19.9/20.3 vs TTPO 34.7/50.5/56.7 averages.

Section 4.1: evaluation is Avg@12 at temperature 1.0; OPSD/TTPO trained 100 steps with 'peak performance across checkpoints saved every 25 steps', GRPO/TTRL 500 steps with peak across all checkpoints — peak selection without error bars.

Section 3.2 / Figure 1(a): asserts pseudo-labels wrong on ~85% of AIME 2026 prompts and ~79% of disagreeing rollouts wrong; the 85% figure is not analyzed per problem and sits uneasily with the 37.8 base Avg@12 and K=64 voting.
Table 1: TTPO vs label-supervised OPSD margins are 40.1 vs 39.7 (1.7B), 58.6 vs 58.4 (4B), 62.6 vs 61.7 (8B) — within plausible noise, no variance reported.
Section 4.3 / Table 3: token-level ablations (TTPO 46.5/31.6/54.7 vs w/o pos. weight 43.3/30.6/52.8 and w/o neg. mask 45.4/29.5/50.0) support both components.
Figure 3: update-strategy ablation shows full TTPO (48.9) beats all alternatives including reversed assignment (37.2) on Qwen3-1.7B AIME26 TTT.

Appendix A (Tables 5-6) and Appendix B: full training/eval hyperparameters (LoRA r=64, alpha=128, lr 5e-6, K=64, lambda=0.1, 16k sampling / 1,024 gradient tokens) and prompt templates; code URL given in Abstract.
Appendix F: limitations explicitly cover majority-vote dependence, restriction to math with verifiable answers, and fixed curriculum; code generation and open-ended reasoning unexplored.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core-topic LLM reasoning paper: label-free test-time training via an asymmetric objective (OPSD distillation on majority-vote-agreeing rollouts, GRPO penalties on disagreeing ones) with token-level weighting/masking, evaluated on Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B across five competition math benchmarks. Strong preference fit (LLMs, chain-of-thought reasoning, RL/GRPO, LoRA fine-tuning). Novelty is moderate: the asymmetric routing and the empirical observation that ~79% of disagreeing rollouts are wrong regardless of pseudo-label correctness are a genuine contribution, but components (TTRL, OPSD, TIP, STAPO token selection) are assembled from prior work. Rigor is good: four baselines including label-free and label-supervised, extensive ablations (Table 3 token selection, Figure 3 update-strategy grid, Table 4 privileged information, Tables 8-10 hyperparameter sweeps), theory appendix (E), and explicit limitations (Appendix F). Deductions: all methods report peak-across-checkpoint accuracy (Section 4.1) which inflates absolute numbers; headline 'matches or exceeds label-supervised OPSD' rests on 0.2-0.9 avg-point margins (Table 1) without error bars or significance tests; the ~85% wrong-pseudo-label rate (Section 3.2) seems internally high given a 37.8 base Avg@12 and K=64 voting, and is not broken down per problem; the surprising 'pseudo-labels beat ground-truth supervision' result (Figure 5) has plausible but unverified explanations. Generalizability is limited to verifiable-answer math on one model family, acknowledged in Appendix F. Reproducibility is solid: code link, full hyperparameter tables (Appendix A, Tables 5-6), prompt templates (Appendix B).

primary_link.title: TTPO: Test-Time Policy Optimization

recommendations.summary: Recent prominent post-training methods, such as Reinforcement Learning (RL) and On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD), have driven rapid progress in mathematical reasoning for large language models, yet their reliance on ground-truth labels precludes test-time training (TTT). Replacing ground truth with majority-vote pseudo-labels is a natural alternative, yet it is fragile: an incorrect vote corrupts the teacher and misleads every token. We observe that this failure mode is asymmetric: rollouts that disagree with the pseudo-label are typically wrong regardless of whether the vote itself is correct. Building on this observation, we propose Test-Time Policy Optimization (TTPO), an asymmetric objective that distills agreeing rollouts via OPSD and penalizes disagreeing rollouts with Grouped RL. Token-level selection further refines both branches: distillation down-weights already-converged positions, while RL penalizes only confident errors. Both updates remain well-grounded even under frequent pseudo-label errors, and majority-vote routing yields tighter self-supervision as the model improves. Without any labels, TTPO matches label-supervised OPSD on five competition-level benchmarks, raises Qwen3-1.7B from 38.0% to 45.2% in TTT, yields +25.2% to +36.4% without thinking, and shows strong cross-task generalization.
recommendations.summary_zh: 這篇論文處理大型語言模型在無標籤情境下進行測試時訓練（TTT）的難題。現行後訓練方法如強化學習（RLVR）與 on-policy 自我蒸餾（OPSD）皆仰賴標準答案；改用多數決虛擬標籤時，錯誤共識會污染教師模型，在每個 token 上誤導訓練——在競賽級題目上虛擬標籤約有 85% 是錯的。作者觀察到關鍵的不對稱性：與虛擬標籤不一致的 rollout 中約 79% 本身也是錯的，因此懲罰「不一致」樣本不論標籤對錯幾乎都正確。據此提出 TTPO 不對稱目標：對一致的正樣本施以前向 KL 為基礎的 OPSD 蒸餾，並以 token 加權聚焦學生尚未掌握的位置；對不一致的負樣本施以 GRPO 懲罰，並以遮罩只懲罰導致失敗的自信錯誤。在 AIME、HMMT、BRUMO 五個競賽級數學基準上，完全不用標籤的 TTPO 即追平或超越使用標準答案的 OPSD；純 TTT 設定下將 Qwen3-1.7B 平均準確率由 38.0% 提升至 45.2%；關閉思考模式時增益達 +25.2 至 +36.4 個百分點，並展現跨基準遷移與自我演進能力。有趣的是，以虛擬標籤訓練反而勝過使用標準答案，因為過難的真實標籤使兩個分支同時缺乏學習訊號。限制包括依賴多數決品質、僅驗證於具可驗證答案的數學領域，以及採用固定的訓練課程。此研究為無標籤的測試時自我改良提供了穩健且有效的新方向。
recommendations.title: TTPO: Test-Time Policy Optimization
recommendations.title_zh: TTPO：測試時策略最佳化

links.title: Unlearning Is Not Just Erasing: Temporal Decoupling via Generation Inequality

evidence: Abstract: 'ADU achieves the strongest aggregate performance among evaluated baselines on the TOFU and WMDP benchmarks, including a Forget Quality of 0.93 on TOFU. It preserves 87–98% of model utility (92.9% on average versus 81.9% for baselines)'
Table 1: On Llama3.1-8B-Instruct, ADU Bio 27.32 / Cyber 27.97 vs Base 71.86 / 45.37, with MMLU 62.84 and GSM8K 58.82 retained; best or near-best across seven baselines

Table 5 (Discussions, Path-specific causal validation): 'Base − Selected C̃e' lowers WMDP Avg from 58.62 to 36.37 vs 57.09 for cardinality-matched random edges; 'ADU ← Base selected' restores 27.65 to 47.23 vs 28.82 for matched-random replacement, with MMLU shifts of only -0.58/+0.53

Table 4 (Component ablation): removing pathway loss raises WMDP Avg to 47.79 (vs 27.65); removing retain objective drops MMLU to 56.32 and GSM8K to 52.10; random heads degrade both forgetting and retention

Robustness Analysis (Fig. 5): six attacks grouped into prompt scaffolding (few-shot, masking, role-play CoT) and adaptive recovery (anchor shift, multi-turn probing, repeated sampling); ADU has the smallest increase and lowest final accuracy under adaptive recovery

Method section: LoRA adapters update W_Q, W_K, W_V, W_O in layers containing selected global heads; head partition computed once with ρ=0.3 and fixed; defaults q=0.4, α=0.3 from Fig. 4 sensitivity analysis
Contributions item 3 states evaluations on 'WMDP, TOFU, and MUSE-Books' while the Experiments section and Table 3 use 'MUSE-Harry Potter' with Llama2-7B — an internal naming inconsistency

Metrics section: fluency 'evaluated by GPT-4o on a 1 to 5 scale' (single-judge, no inter-annotator check reported in provided text); no code-release or artifact-availability statement appears anywhere in the document
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM research with strong preference fit: parameter-level unlearning for LLMs (Llama3.1-8B-Instruct, Qwen3-14B, Llama2-7B) intersecting AI safety/privacy (WMDP hazardous-knowledge removal, GDPR motivation), interpretability-style analysis (local/global attention head partition, bidirectional activation exchange for causal mediation), and evaluation robustness. Not a pure domain application, so in scope. Novelty is solid but not maximal: attention-based unlearning exists (ASU suppresses attention to salient tokens), and the contribution is the shift from static token salience to context-specific preplan-anchor retrieval pathways plus a temporal 'generation inequality' characterization. Rigor is good: three benchmarks, seven baselines across three method families, component ablations (Table 4), hyperparameter sensitivity (Fig. 4), and six-attack robustness analysis. Evidence is strengthened by controlled causal interventions (Table 5: Base minus selected edges drops WMDP Avg 58.62→36.37 vs 57.09 matched-random; ADU restored to 47.23 vs 28.82 random), but weakened by conditional theory resting on unverified directional-alignment assumptions, single-judge GPT-4o fluency, an unverified seed-stability claim deferred to Appendix D.4, and an internal inconsistency (contributions/conclusion say 'MUSE-Books' while experiments use MUSE-Harry Potter). Generalizability is moderate: two model families and three task types, but the method presupposes the extended context-rich retrieval regime the authors themselves flag, and requires retain sets and calibration splits. Reproducibility is middling: hyperparameters (ρ=0.3, q=0.4, α=0.3) and appendices A–F are specified, but no code or artifact availability is claimed in the provided text.

primary_link.title: Unlearning Is Not Just Erasing: Temporal Decoupling via Generation Inequality

recommendations.summary: Large language models (LLMs) require effective unlearning to address privacy regulations and safety concerns. However, achieving precise forgetting without compromising general utility remains challenging. Existing sequence- and token-level methods penalize target outputs without modeling their context-dependent retrieval paths, which can disrupt linguistic structure or suppress benign knowledge. We present ADU, a fine-grained, training-based framework that shifts unlearning from token erasure t
recommendations.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討大型語言模型(LLM)的機器遺忘(unlearning)問題:模型須依 GDPR 等規範遺忘敏感或私人內容,同時保留一般能力。既有序列級與 token 級方法只懲罰可見輸出,未建模情境相依的內部檢索路徑,容易破壞語言結構,或在無害情境造成過度遺忘。作者提出「生成不平等」概念:局部注意力頭維持短程依賴,全域注意力頭則在語義轉折的前規劃位置回溯檢索遠處持續被關注的錨點。據此提出 ADU 框架:先在原始模型上定位前規劃—錨點路徑並固定,再訓練注意力投影 adapter 抑制這些路徑的注意力質量,並以保留集語言建模與局部注意力保存損失約束副作用;訓練後以雙向激活交換驗證所選路徑的因果中介角色。實驗顯示,ADU 在 WMDP 上將 Llama3.1-8B-Instruct 的 Bio/Cyber 準確率降至 27.32/27.97,MMLU 與 GSM8K 保留 62.84/58.82;TOFU 遺忘品質達 0.93,平均保留 92.9% 效用(基線 81.9%);MUSE 上 ROUGE-L 最低;面對提示框架與適應性恢復等攻擊仍維持最低敏感準確率。消融實驗證實路徑損失與保留損失缺一不可。限制在於路徑識別依賴注意力且僅在原始模型計算一次,錨點自動建構與殘留知識防護仍待改進。此研究將遺忘從擦除 token 轉為抑制情境化檢索路徑,對隱私合規與安全部署深具意義。
recommendations.title: Unlearning Is Not Just Erasing: Temporal Decoupling via Generation Inequality
recommendations.title_zh: 機器遺忘不只是擦除:以生成不平等達成時間解耦

links.title: Graph-Guided Selective Unlearning for Language Models: Controlling Support Routes Beyond Forget Seeds

evidence: Section 3.3, Table 2: GraphSU achieves 46.83% soft leakage at retain PPL 3.27 on TOFU complete deletion, lowest among methods satisfying PPL<=10; GRU's 38.13% violates the constraint at PPL 79.11.

Section 3.3: Seed-Only ablation uses the same unlearning objective but omits the graph controller, isolating scope-control effects; reductions of 46.42/41.65/18.33 points on TOFU and 49.50/21.66/12.22 on PISTOL across settings.

Appendix F, Table 8: taxonomy-blind free-form probes (736 all-target, 342 confirmed-attack) evaluated with five detectors; combined-detector reduction 13.59 pp with 95% CI [8.97, 18.34] and McNemar p=5.98e-10.

Appendix D: local Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct extraction swap yields soft leakage 49.83% vs 46.83% (GPT-4.1); 40% graph-critical corruption retains 66/72 support nodes with diffusion-score correlation >=0.9974.
Appendix A: Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct complete deletion shows 13.33% vs Seed-Only 93.67% leakage at PPL 1.96 vs 1.05; PPL definition correction (exp(0.03)≈1.03) documented.
Appendix J: the archive lacks a leave-one-view-out sweep for the five affinity terms and independent sweeps over rho, hop limit, and budget B; gains are not attributed to a single view.
Appendix K: unlearning runs use one training seed; no across-seed variance reported and none fabricated.
Limitations section: soft leakage measures behavioral recoverability under fixed route probes, not certified representational erasure.
Appendix H, Table 9: graph build at 4K samples takes 452.36s with 7.82MB cache and 4.01s warm selection; exact cosine retrieval is quadratic and flagged as bottleneck.
Section 3.1, Table 1: baselines GA, GA+KL, DPO, NPO-TR, AltPO, GRU, SELU from same SFT checkpoint with shared forget seeds and prompts; per-setting hyperparameters given but full sweeps deferred.
llm_evaluation.rationale: On-topic LLM methodology paper: selective unlearning for fine-tuned language models with privacy/compliance motivation, adversarial recovery-probe evaluation, and safety-adjacent framing, aligning with high-weight LLM, AI Safety, and Red Teaming/Evaluation preferences; no out-of-scope domain trigger. Novelty is solid but incremental: scope expansion beyond forget seeds via related-knowledge removal (UIPE, Wei et al.) and influence-style attribution (Koh & Liang, TRAK) exist; the multi-view support graph with restart-diffusion and graded forgetting strengths (Section 2.3-2.5) is a credible new controller, explicitly separated from the loss. Rigor is strong: matched Seed-Only ablation sharing the same objective (Section 3.3), seven baselines, three deletion settings, two datasets, two backbones (Table 2, Appendix A), local-extractor swap with corruption stress tests (Appendix D), and taxonomy-blind LLM-generated probes with bootstrap CIs and McNemar tests (Appendix F/Table 8). Evidence is weakened by a single training seed (Appendix K), absence of leave-one-view-out or fusion-weight sweeps (Appendix J), self-defined soft-leakage metric with tau=0.85, small models (GPT-2 Medium, Llama-3.2-3B), and a post-hoc PPL<=10 feasibility guardrail, though Appendix B shows Pareto robustness across caps 5-50 and honest reporting of residual partial-deletion leakage (81.67% TOFU). Generalizability is limited to QA-format English unlearning benchmarks; beyond-QA applicability is argued (Appendix A) but not tested, and quadratic candidate retrieval is a scaling bottleneck (Appendix H). Reproducibility is aided by released anonymous code, frozen prompts/manifests, hyperparameter tables, and a validated local extraction path, but full sweeps are not provided. Calculated: 0.85*0.4 + 0.7*0.15 + 0.8*0.15 + 0.77*0.15 + 0.6*0.1 + 0.7*0.05 = 0.77.

primary_link.title: Graph-Guided Selective Unlearning for Language Models: Controlling Support Routes Beyond Forget Seeds

recommendations.summary: Enterprises fine-tune language models on proprietary data that may later require removal due to privacy, contractual, or compliance obligations. Selective unlearning removes requested knowledge while preserving model utility, offering a practical alternative to full retraining, but existing methods treat the explicitly identified forget examples as the complete deletion scope. This is insufficient when target knowledge remains recoverable through paraphrases, aliases, or neighboring training exa
recommendations.summary_zh: 企業常以專有資料微調大型語言模型，但基於隱私、合約或法規義務，事後往往必須刪除特定知識。現有選擇性遺忘方法多半只針對明確標記的遺忘樣本，忽略目標知識仍可透過改寫、別名或相鄰訓練樣本被推論還原的問題。本文提出GraphSU，一個與損失函數無關的圖引導控制器：先以GPT-4.1離線抽取事實三元組，融合實體、關係、尾實體三種符號重疊、語意相似度與答案側梯度對齊共五種視圖，建構加權支援圖；再以個人化圖擴散從遺忘種子傳播刪除壓力，選出高風險支援鄰居並賦予分級遺忘強度，最後結合熵最大化、unlikelihood、表示斥力與保留損失進行更新。在TOFU與PISTOL基準上，以GPT-2 Medium與Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct評估，GraphSU在所有刪除設定下均達到保留困惑度低於10的最低軟性洩漏，相較共用相同遺忘目標的Seed-Only對照組最多降低49.5個百分點，且在736個未見過的自由形式探測提示上維持統計顯著的改善。限制方面：部分刪除仍有大量殘餘洩漏；軟性洩漏僅衡量行為層面的可達性，並非具備正式保證的表徵抹除；實驗僅使用單一訓練種子，亦未完成逐視圖消融分析。整體而言，本研究顯示可靠的知識刪除關鍵在於控制支援路徑，而非只設計遺忘損失函數，對企業部署中的隱私與合規管理具實務價值。
recommendations.title: Graph-Guided Selective Unlearning for Language Models: Controlling Support Routes Beyond Forget Seeds
recommendations.title_zh: GraphSU：圖引導的語言模型選擇性遺忘——控制遺忘種子之外的支援路徑

links.title: PILOT in the Loop: Live Self-Improvement for Long-Horizon Agents

evidence: Abstract: 'PILOT ranks first in five of six configurations'; 'PILOT gains 14.6 points with GLM-5.1 and 12.4 points with Kimi-K2.6; mean output tokens fall by 42.9% and 47.4%'
Section 3.1 Setup: 'We run each configuration twice and report the mean pass rate across the two runs' — no variance, confidence intervals, or significance tests reported anywhere

Section 3.1 Evaluation settings: one-shot setting uses 'a fresh harness state, isolating whether live steering keeps the worker on track'; self-improvement setting uses verifier outcomes only to retain/discard updates, never to create them

Table 2 / Section 4.2: steering-aided successful runs classified by manual trace inspection at 2.3% (GLM-5.1) and 10.6% (Kimi-K2.6) overall, with a stated inclusion criterion but no inter-annotator agreement or second annotator

Appendix A.1: 'We exclude 43 SWE-bench Multilingual tasks and 198 SWE-bench Pro tasks whose pinned environments cannot bootstrap the JavaScript agent runtimes... We apply the same exclusions to every harness' — lists 'will be released'
Appendix A.3: identical self-improvement instruction prepended for every harness with only harness-native [SKILL_PATH]/[MEMORY_PATH] substitutions — a good control against instruction-induced gains

Limitations: 'Iterative self-improvement repeats every task across many iterations... limits the current evaluation to three benchmarks and two open-weight backbones'; supervisor and worker share the same backbone, heterogeneous pairings 'unexplored'

Section 3.3/Figure 3(b): skill library grows from 62 to 83 (GLM-5.1) and 50 to 81 (Kimi-K2.6) over 20 iterations; Figure 3(c) reports token reductions counting all supervisor and worker assistant turns (honest accounting)
llm_evaluation.rationale: A strongly on-topic agentic-LLM paper: a supervisor-worker harness (PILOT) enabling mid-run 'live steering' plus concurrent harness evolution (skills/memory) over frozen LLM backbones (GLM-5.1, Kimi-K2.6), evaluated on Terminal-Bench 2.0, SWE-bench Multilingual, and SWE-bench Pro. Preference relevance is high (agents, LLMs, coding benchmarks, token-efficiency analysis). Novelty is moderate: the framing of 'live' (mid-execution) correction plus concurrent harness updates is a sensible architectural gap relative to post-hoc self-improvement work (Reflexion, ExpeL, ACE, etc.), but the components (supervisor-worker, skill libraries, memory) are well-trodden. Rigor is decent but limited: fixed backbone across harnesses, identical self-improvement instruction across harnesses (Appendix A.3), uniform task exclusions (Appendix A.1), and two settings that partially decompose steering vs. self-evolution; however, only two runs per configuration with no significance testing, no ablations of the channel mechanics or supervisor design, and manual single-pass classification of steering-aided runs (Table 2, 2.3%/10.6%). Evidence includes concrete tables and two trace-grounded case studies (Figure 4), but gains of 4-5 points on 89 tasks are not statistically supported. Generalizability is constrained to two open-weight backbones and adjacent terminal/SWE domains, acknowledged in Limitations. Reproducibility is moderately good: public GitHub claim, pseudocode (A.2), full instruction text (A.3), exclusion lists promised, though supervisor prompts, skill schemas, and update criteria are underspecified.

primary_link.title: PILOT in the Loop: Live Self-Improvement for Long-Horizon Agents

recommendations.summary: Long-horizon agent runs generate experience that can improve both the current run and future work. Most self-improvement methods process this experience only after execution ends, so they cannot redirect the active run or immediately apply and validate lessons learned from it. We argue that self-improvement should instead be live, using emerging experience both to redirect the active run and to update the persistent harness. Existing agent architectures do not fully support this goal. Single-agent self-correction combines task execution and trajectory assessment within one context, while subagent delegation separates execution but typically cannot redirect an active subagent. We present PILOT, a supervisor-worker harness for live self-improvement through two coupled mechanisms: (1) live steering lets a separate supervisor redirect or abort the active worker during execution; and (2) live self-evolution distils procedures and failure modes revealed during execution into reusable skills and memory. Across two frozen backbones and three benchmarks, PILOT ranks first in five of six configurations. On Terminal-Bench 2.0, PILOT outperforms counterpart harnesses by up to 9.8 percentage points. In the self-improvement setting, PILOT gains 14.6 points with GLM-5.1 and 12.4 points with Kimi-K2.6. Mean output tokens fall by 42.9% and 47.4%, while successful evaluations per million output tokens rise by 110.3% and 134.0%, respectively.
recommendations.summary_zh: 長程代理在執行任務時產生的經驗,理應能同時改善當前與未來的表現:成功軌跡可沉澱為可重複使用的程序,失敗軌跡則暴露應避免的失敗模式。然而多數自我改進方法只在執行結束後做事後檢視,既無法導正進行中的執行,也無法立即套用並驗證新學到的知識;單一代理自我修正會讓執行與監督在有限的上下文中互相干擾,子代理委派又通常要等執行結束才能取得結果並介入。對此,作者提出 PILOT,一個監督者—工作者(supervisor–worker)框架,以兩個耦合機制實現「即時自我改進」:(1)即時導引(live steering),監督者透過雙向即時通道接收工作者的通知、提問、結果與錯誤警示,並能在執行中導引或中止工作者;(2)即時自我演化(live self-evolution),將執行中浮現的有效程序、專案慣例與失敗模式沉澱為可重複使用的技能庫與記憶。模型參數全程凍結,僅演化持久化的框架狀態。在 GLM-5.1 與 Kimi-K2.6 兩個凍結骨幹及 Terminal-Bench 2.0、SWE-bench Multilingual、SWE-bench Pro 三項基準上,PILOT 於六種組合中的五種排名第一,Terminal-Bench 2.0 最高領先對手 9.8 個百分點;在自我改進設定下,最佳通過率分別提升 14.6 與 12.4 個百分點,平均輸出 token 減少 42.9% 與 47.4%,每百萬輸出 token 的成功評估數增加 110.3% 與 134.0%,技能庫由 62、50 個成長至 83、81 個,且增益在困難任務上最為顯著。限制方面,迭代式自我改進成本高昂,評估僅涵蓋三項基準與兩個開放權重模型;監督者與工作者共用同一模型,異質配對的取捨尚待探索。本文的價值在於將「導正當前執行」與「累積可重用經驗」整合成單一連續迴路,使代理的自我改進能即時發生並跨任務延續。
recommendations.title: PILOT in the Loop: Live Self-Improvement for Long-Horizon Agents

evidence: Section 4.2: Large-scale execution yields 38.4M triples and 1.6M entities.
Section 5.1: Manual evaluation of NED on 400 samples; merge accuracy 98% homonymy and 91% synonymy.
Section 5.3: Human triple precision 94.5% on n=200; LLM evaluation on n=1000 gives 92.8% true.

llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to LLM-based knowledge base construction, addressing disambiguation with direct LLM use. Novel approach to on-the-fly disambiguation in LLM-native KBs, with large-scale execution and extensive evaluations. Rigorous methodology with ablations, manual and automatic evaluation, and clear resource details. Generalizable to other domains, though some reliance on commercial models. Reproducibility supported by detailed pipeline and public anonymized interface.

primary_link.title: GPTKB 2.0: Direct Construction of Disambiguated Knowledge Bases from Large Language Models

recommendations.summary: Automated Knowledge Base Construction (AKBC) is a core NLP task, and recent work proposes generating knowledge bases directly from large language models (LLMs), treating the model itself as the knowledge source. However, LLMs natively possess no representation of entities, leading to duplicate entries as well as conflations. We propose GPTKB 2.0, a methodology for constructing disambiguated KBs directly from LLMs. GPTKB 2.0 incorporates on-the-fly disambiguation of entities, relations and classe
recommendations.summary_zh: 本論文提出 GPTKB 2.0，一種直接從大型語言模型（LLM）的參數知識中，規模化建構具備實體消歧義能力之知識庫（KB）的方法。傳統知識庫建構多依賴維基百科或 Wikidata 等外部資源，而 LLM 原生缺乏實體表示，直接生成常導致同義詞未合併（如 Île-de-France 與 Île-de-France region）以及同形異義詞遭錯誤合併（如城市與電影 Munich）等問題。GPTKB 2.0 的管線包含三個階段：知識提取（elicitation）、命名實體辨識（NER）與消歧義（disambiguation）。其核心創新在於「情境引導」的消歧義程序：利用來源三元組與既有實體描述作為脈絡，進行兩輪 NED（triple-context NED 與 description-context NED），並搭配 guarded parallelization 策略，在不犧牲正確性的前提下達成平行化。實作結果建構了包含 159 萬個實體、3840 萬條三元組的知識庫，其中 36.8% 的實體為 Wikidata 所未收錄，並成功區分 131,990 個同形異義實體。人工評估顯示 NED 合併正確率為 91–98%、分割正確率為 95–100%，三元組事實正確率為 94.5%。此方法在超過 15 年後，首度展示可於 Wikimedia 範疇外建構大規模、已消歧義的通用實體庫。然而，該知識庫缺乏來源引用、規模仍遠小於 Wikidata，且靜態反映模型訓練時之知識，可能包含過時或錯誤資訊。此研究對 LLM 知識具體化與知識庫建構領域具有重要意義，也突顯了在 LLM 原生設定下進行實體消歧義的挑戰與契機。

primary_link.title: Beyond Solution-Centric Search: Adaptive Inquiry and Knowledge Revision for Autonomous ML Engineering

recommendations.summary: Long-horizon autonomous research tasks such as machine learning engineering require systems to make interdependent decisions under a limited budget. Existing LLM-based agents typically organize candidate-solution improvement through tree, graph, or chain structures, meaning that the search process determines how information is acquired and managed. We call this design solution-centric search and propose instead the information paradigm, in which an evolving information state represents the syste
recommendations.summary_zh: 本文提出資訊範式（information paradigm）取代傳統以候選解決方案為中心的搜尋範式（solution-centric search paradigm），用於長時間尺度的自主機器學習工程任務。作者指出，現有LLM代理系統多透過樹狀、圖狀或鏈狀結構組織候選方案的產生與改良，然此設計將資訊獲取與管理置於次要地位，限制系統在有限預算下對決策關鍵未知項的探測與跨實驗知識的整合。作者提出Iris系統，以「探究－修訂」循環（inquiry–revision loop）為核心，將資訊狀態（information state）視為演化中的核心表徵。在資訊獲取方面，Iris會根據當前資訊狀態生成自適應的局部動作拓撲，並區分介入性動作（interventional actions）與認知性動作（epistemic actions），後者可在不修改保留解決方案的前提下蒐集具有鑑別力的證據，用於診斷決策關鍵未知項。在資訊管理方面，Iris將跨實驗觀察綜整為具明確範疇與狀態的可修訂任務知識（task knowledge），並支援多粒度資訊存取，依決策需求提供原始證據、結構化摘要或任務知識。作者在MLE-Bench上以12小時預算進行評估，Iris達到64.9%的整體任何獎牌率（any-medal rate），為比較系統中最高，同時在四項跨領域任務（涵蓋框架工程與模型後訓練）上展現泛化能力。此外，元件消融研究顯示，移除自適應拓撲、認知性動作或知識管理均會降低效能，證實各元件之貢獻。作者亦分析軌跡動態，展示認知性診斷如何重新導向後續介入並修訂知識庫。本文限制包括：主要評估集中於MLE-Bench與四項任務，跨領域任務僅以單次執行報導；消融實驗僅涵蓋15個小型資料集任務；系統性能可能受底層模型選擇影響。此研究的重要性在於提出以資訊為中心的研究代理設計觀點，促使未來系統更重視資訊獲取與修訂作為核心目標。
recommendations.title: Beyond Solution-Centric Search: Adaptive Inquiry and Knowledge Revision for Autonomous ML Engineering
recommendations.title_zh: 超越以解決方案為中心的搜尋：自主機器學習工程的自適應探究與知識修訂

primary_link.title: DataSpace: Benchmarking Data Agents for Verifiable Analytics over Heterogeneous Workspaces

recommendations.summary: Data agents enable natural-language analytics over organizational workspaces, where relevant evidence may be scattered across databases, structured files, long documents, and multimedia. Existing benchmarks largely isolate structured querying, retrieval, or open-ended analysis, leaving heterogeneous evidence discovery, complete tabular outputs, and deterministic evaluation insufficiently unified. We introduce DataSpace, a benchmark in which data agents produce verifiable tabular results from tas
recommendations.summary_zh: DataSpace 是一個針對數據代理（data agent）的基準測試，旨在評估其在任務導向的異質工作區中，透過自然語言查詢產生完整且可驗證的表格結果。此基準涵蓋 410 個跨語言任務，包含 7,439 個工件，總計約 15 GB，形式涵蓋 CSV、JSON、SQLite、Markdown、PDF 與影片。與現有基準不同，DataSpace 強調工作區內多種資料形式（結構化檔案、資料庫、長文件、多媒體）的整合與探索，要求代理產出完整的表格而非簡短答案，並採用確定性評估，容忍等效表示但拒絕不完整或錯誤輸出。作者提出 DataSpace-Builder，一個執行驅動的建構框架，將 EHRSQL 與 BULL 兩個英文 Text-to-SQL 基準轉換為跨語言、異質工作區任務，包含跨語言轉換、約束感知的關係取樣、模態路由與工件產出，以及 11 位領域專家的人工審查與修復。評估協議包含標題不變的欄位對齊、型別與精度正規化，以及順序感知的列比較。實驗顯示，在六個前沿多模態模型與五個代理框架的組合中，最佳準確率僅達 66.34%，且代理框架的選擇在固定骨幹下造成 15.36 個百分點的差異。多模態證據整合與連接操作在所有骨幹上都一致地降低準確率，顯示這些是資料代理可靠性的關鍵瓶頸。此基準尚未飽和，仍有大量任務未被任何模型解決，為未來研究提供了明確的挑戰方向。

links.title: AdaThinkV: Adaptive Thinking for Token-Efficient Video Reasoning

evidence: Abstract: AdaThinkV achieves 40.79 mean accuracy with 257.20 tokens, outperforming baseline by 2.98 points with 22.7% fewer tokens.
Table 1: Comparison across benchmarks shows AdaThinkV SOTA.
Table 6: Ablation shows ThinkGain improves token efficiency, VRPO improves accuracy.
Table 8: Efficiency analysis shows VRPO achieves higher accuracy at same compute.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to adaptive reasoning (adaptive CoT), RL optimization, and LLM efficiency. Introduces novel ThinkGain and VRPO methods. Strong experimental validation with ablations and benchmarks. Some gaps in details (supplement referenced).

primary_link.title: AdaThinkV: Adaptive Thinking for Token-Efficient Video Reasoning

recommendations.summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning can improve performance on difficult video questions but often wastes decoding tokens on simple ones. We study whether a video multimodal large language model can adapt its reasoning effort to each question. We propose AdaThinkV, an adaptive framework for video reasoning that learns whether to reason explicitly without offline difficulty labels, manually tuned confidence thresholds, or an external router. During reinforcement learning, AdaThinkV samples matched r
recommendations.summary_zh: AdaThinkV 是一套專為影片多模態大型語言模型（MLLM）設計的自適應推理框架，旨在解決顯式思維鏈（Chain-of-Thought）推理雖然能提升複雜影片問題的準確度，但對簡單問題卻可能造成 token 浪費的問題。作者主張模型應能自行判斷何時需要顯式推理，而非依賴離線難度標籤、手動設定的信心閾值或外部路由器。AdaThinkV 的核心由兩項技術組成：ThinkGain 透過在同一提示上配對執行「思考（THINK）」與「直接回答（ANSWER）」兩種模式的推論，並以準確度增益減去額外的長度成本，來估計每個提示的「條件淨推理效用」，進而監督模式選擇與條件式續寫；Variance Recovery Policy Optimization（VRPO）則針對那些當前所有回應皆失敗且獎勵變異量過低的困難提示群組，保留原有 rollouts 並逐步擴展，以恢復可用的強化學習信號，避免動態採樣可能導致的偏差。在推理階段，AdaThinkV 會以單一自迴歸序列生成模式標記與後續內容。實驗結果顯示，在統一的影片推理評測基準上，AdaThinkV 達到 40.79 的平均準確率，僅生成 257.20 個輸出 token，比最強的適應性基準方法（VideoAuto-R1-Qwen3）高出 2.98 個百分點，同時減少 22.7% 的 token 使用量。在一般影片理解、時間定位與串流影片等基準上，AdaThinkV 也展現出領先或相當的效能。消融研究證實，ThinkGain 主要改善準確度與 token 數的取捨，而 VRPO 則提升絕對準確度。作者也討論了這些方法的限制，例如 ThinkGain 的蒙地卡羅估計可能含有雜訊，以及群組擴展可能引入選擇偏差，並在補充材料中提供進一步分析。此研究的重要性在於，它展示了如何有效率地分配推理運算資源，為影片理解任務中的成本感知決策提供了一個可行方向。
recommendations.title: AdaThinkV: Adaptive Thinking for Token-Efficient Video Reasoning
recommendations.title_zh: AdaThinkV：運用自適應思考達成具備效率的影片推理

links.title: Actions Speak Louder than Words: Measuring Cross-Lingual Policy Retention in Tool-Using Agents

evidence: Abstract: reports 8 models, 6 parallel benchmarks, 41 languages, and 2.38M rollouts with code/data release.
Section 3: Table 1 shows each correction increases the length-matched raw gap from +0.0625 to +0.2074.
Section 4: reports four frontier models retain 71-73% action policy under greedy decoding, with model identity explaining 5.7% of variance.
Section 5: reports Translate is the most-used tool and presents causal removal/mandate manipulations across four models.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to LLM agents, tool use, cross-lingual evaluation, and NLP. The paper proposes a ceiling-corrected estimand for cross-lingual action-policy retention, with strong controls for confounds, large-scale rollouts, causal English-pivot tests, and release claims. Limitations include symbolic rather than grounded execution and a small n=4 central model set, though extensions are reported.

primary_link.title: Actions Speak Louder than Words: Measuring Cross-Lingual Policy Retention in Tool-Using Agents

recommendations.summary: When a tool-using agent is given the same task in a different language, does it still take the same steps? Multilingual evaluation rarely asks: it compares final answers and discards the actions. Yet those actions are the product: they fix cost and latency, decide how the system fails, and are the only auditable part of its behaviour. We make the action policy the measured object across 8 models, 6 parallel benchmarks and 41 languages (2.38M rollouts). The naive measurement fails: five confounds
recommendations.summary_zh: 本研究提出一套衡量方法，用以評估多語言工具型智慧體的跨語言策略保留程度，亦即當任務語言改變時，智慧體是否仍執行相同的動作序列。作者指出，傳統的答案正確率比較忽略了中間的動作軌跡，而這些軌跡才是影響成本、延遲、失敗模式與稽核的關鍵。研究涵蓋八個模型、六個平行基準、41種語言，共238萬次軌跡生成。他們發現五個混淆因子會扭曲原始軌跡相似度，因此開發修正方案，並證明每項修正反而使跨語言分歧效應更顯著。在貪婪解碼下，四個前沿模型保留自身策略的71–73%，且模型身分僅解釋5.7%的變異。此外，研究發現模型傾向以英文為中介，此機制具有因果性且難以透過指令消除。最後，他們揭露單一正則表達式萃取程式可能造成錯誤的多語言失敗表象，強調衡量工具使用軌跡的重要性。
recommendations.title: Actions Speak Louder than Words: Measuring Cross-Lingual Policy Retention in Tool-Using Agents
recommendations.title_zh: 行動勝於言詞：衡量使用工具之智慧體在跨語言策略保留上的表現

links.title: IAPO: Influence-Aware Policy Optimization for Credit Assignment in Multi-Turn Service Agents

evidence: Abstract: 'IAPO represents each rollout as a typed influence-dependency graph... Experiments with Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B demonstrate superior performance over multi-turn RL baselines across three service-agent benchmarks: τ2-Bench, UserBench, and AgentChangeBench.'

Method/Influence-Dependency Graph: support-use (i→+j) and failed-use (i→-j) edges with necessity/explicit-binding/source-priority acceptance criteria; 'user turns and tool returns provide evidence but never receive advantage.'
Properties, Propositions 1-4: mass conservation Σ A_i,ℓ = L Â_τ, uniform fallback, sign preservation, optimization-interface preservation; 'proofs are in Appendix B.'
Table 1 (8B): IAPO 42.18±2.55 vs GRPO 29.61±3.56 on τ2-Bench; UserBench 24.44 vs 19.83; AgentChangeBench 30.44 vs 26.03; BFCL-MT 39.36 vs 39.04.

Experiments/Experimental Setup: 'train Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B with thinking disabled on 8× NVIDIA H20 GPUs using a verl/FSDP GRPO stack, N=16 samples/prompt, max 30 turns. Dependency annotation uses Qwen3-32B at temperature 0... IAPO defaults: β+=0.05, c=0.25.'
Table 3 (Ablation): β+=0 yields 32.50 τ2 vs 42.18 default; β+=0.1 yields 33.96; c=0.5 yields 42.29 τ2 but UserBench drops to 17.78; Gemma4-31B annotator yields 40.90 τ2.
Annotator Stability: 'Six frozen annotators achieve 100% parse rate... mean edge-typed F1 0.87, source Jaccard 0.84, mean pairwise Cohen's κ=0.83'; m− Spearman ρ=0.96-1.00 (Table 4).
Main Results: 'IAPO lowers macro tool-call redundancy from GRPO's 46.00 to 29.74 (Appendix F)'; routing departs from flat credit ('86.5% of steps move by more than 10% from flat credit, Appendix E').
No code or data release statement appears anywhere in the provided document; only public benchmarks and the MUA-RL checkpoint (re-evaluated) are cited.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-agent RL methodology, squarely in scope: multi-turn service agents, GRPO-style training, tool use, and function calling (Abstract; Related Work). The core idea—routing a fixed trajectory-level advantage through a within-rollout, LLM-annotated typed influence-dependency graph instead of uniform GRPO credit—is a genuinely distinct angle versus cross-rollout grouping (GiGPO), reset/branch methods, or auxiliary critics (Introduction; Related Work), though influence-based credit assignment has older RL precedents (RUDDER, hindsight). Rigor is solid: a controlled GRPO baseline differing only in the advantage map (Experiments), two model scales, three seeds, OOD benchmarks, hyperparameter and annotator-swap ablations (Table 3), and cross-annotator stability audits (Table 4); proofs of mass conservation and sign preservation are stated (Properties, Appendix B). Deductions: no significance testing, the chosen defaults (β+=0.05, c=0.25) are the sweep optima with notable sensitivity (42.18 vs 33.96 for β+=0.1), and the method's quality hinges on a frozen Qwen3-32B annotator whose extraction rules could bias credit. Evidence strength is good but internal: detailed quantitative tables (Table 1: 42.18±2.55 vs 29.61±3.56 at 8B; Table 5 BFCL retention) with no code/data release statement in the document. Generalizability is supported by training only on τ²-Bench while improving UserBench/AgentChangeBench and flat BFCL (Main Results), but the approach presumes multi-turn interaction with observable tool/schema errors and a capable annotator model. Reproducibility is moderate: stack (verl/FSDP, 8×H20, N=16, temp-0 annotator) and defaults are given with full details claimed in Appendix F, but no artifact availability is stated.

primary_link.title: IAPO: Influence-Aware Policy Optimization for Credit Assignment in Multi-Turn Service Agents

recommendations.summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents increasingly solve long-horizon tasks through multi-turn interactions with users and external tools. In these settings, relevant task information often unfolds over time rather than being fully specified at the initial prompt. Service agents make this challenge especially concrete: users may clarify or revise their goals, while tool responses provide information needed for subsequent decisions. Thus, a final reward alone cannot indicate which actions contributed
recommendations.summary_zh: 多輪服務代理的任務資訊隨對話逐步浮現：使用者會中途修改目標，工具回傳揭示所需狀態，僅憑最終獎勵難以判斷哪些動作促成任務完成。GRPO 等演算法把軌跡層級優勢平均套用到每個 token，無法區分中間動作的貢獻。論文提出 IAPO（影響感知策略最佳化），將完成的 rollout 表示為以可訓練動作為節點、帶正負號的影響依賴圖：支援使用邊記錄後續動作消費前序動作引出的資訊，失敗使用邊標記可觀察錯誤的傳播與回退；使用者與工具觀察僅作證據、不取得梯度信用。路由權重據此重新分配原軌跡優勢，並具質量守恆、符號保持與均勻回退等保證。實驗以 Qwen3-4B 與 Qwen3-8B 在 τ²-Bench 訓練，並於 τ²-Bench、UserBench 與 AgentChangeBench 驗證：8B 模型於 τ²-Bench 由 29.61% 提升至 42.18%，電信領域增益達 +18.19 個百分點，並優於 GRPO、GiGPO 與 InfoPO，BFCL-v4 Multi-Turn 的函式呼叫能力亦維持不變；消融實驗亦顯示兩類訊號皆有貢獻、標註模型可替換。限制在於依賴凍結標註模型（Qwen3-32B）抽取依賴圖，標註品質與超參數 β+、c 的設定影響成效，且驗證集中在服務型任務。此研究顯示，rollout 內已實現的依賴結構是稀疏獎勵下細粒度功勞分配的實用來源。
recommendations.title: IAPO: Influence-Aware Policy Optimization for Credit Assignment in Multi-Turn Service Agents
recommendations.title_zh: IAPO：以影響感知策略最佳化解決多輪服務代理的功勞分配問題

links.title: CatchBench: When Can an Agent Failure Be Caught?

evidence: Abstract: 'The release scores 72 entrants, from rule scanners and structural models to eleven LLM judges across nine model families (GPT, Claude, Gemini, Gemma, Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mistral, Nova), over 1187 declared configurations and 1162 recorded runs.'

Section 3.3: 'Sixteen comparison families are declared before scoring, and the contrasts inside each are adjusted by Holm's step-down procedure... all 118 reported contrasts are regenerated from the committed predictions.'
Section 5.4: 'The auditable lift over size (flat) is +0.141 on SWE-Gym (0.804 against 0.663). This is the paper's only effect that survives multiplicity correction.'

Section 4.3 Bar Verdicts: 'File-level Gold passes item 1... fails item 2... Named-value Gold v2 leaves items 1 to 3 undetermined... Thus both substrates remain mechanism diagnostics and carry no evidential weight.'

Appendix D.1: 'The injecagent harvester writes each roster as the user tool followed by the attacker tools... A rule that reads nothing but position... scores 1.000 F1 there' — a construction leak in the authors' own PRE corpus.
Reproducibility Statement: 'The scored board calls no model service: it reads committed prediction caches, so a third party reproduces every number in this paper without an API key.'
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly on-topic: a benchmark for auditing LLM-agent failures scored across PRE/LIVE/POST information states, entrants include 11 LLM judges (GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, etc.), directly matching top-weight preferences for agents/tool use, LLMs, and LLM-as-judge evaluation. Novelty is solid rather than fundamental: the evidence-budget axis (three information states under one task-method interface) and a five-item admissibility bar for injected faults are new for agent auditing (Table 1 shows no prior benchmark covers all three states), but the fixed-data/many-method arena contract is inherited from ADBench/BOND. Rigor is exceptional: 16 pre-declared comparison families, 118 Holm-corrected paired contrasts, per-board floors, seed-stability analyses, and honest separation of 'separates' from 'unresolved' (47/118). The paper even documents and repairs its own harness defects (PyGOD batching bug, judge parser bug, injecagent declaration-order leak). Evidence is strong and internally consistent, with the headline SWE-Gym structural gain (+0.141 ROC-AUC, Section 5.4) the only effect surviving correction, and GPT-5.5's localization lead (0.452 vs 0.211) cleanly established; caveats include single-pass judge generations and small corpora that leave many contrasts unresolved. Generalizability is limited by domain split: structural signal holds on SWE-Gym but tau-bench remains an acknowledged open problem, and all three Gold-derived boards ship only as mechanism diagnostics after failing the authors' own admissibility bar. Reproducibility is outstanding: public repo, committed prediction caches allowing API-free rescoring, pinned corpus commits, CI checks, and documented PII redaction, though raw upstream traces must be fetched and judge regeneration needs credentials.

primary_link.title: CatchBench: When Can an Agent Failure Be Caught?

recommendations.summary: When can an agent failure be caught? An audit is usually limited by the record rather than by the method. CatchBench therefore puts one auditor's question to three information states: the declared configuration before a run (PRE), a growing prefix of its trace (LIVE), and the finished trace (POST). Prior benchmarks fix one of these states or vary the telemetry; to our knowledge none scores all three under one task-method interface. Each state admits different questions, so seven task contracts c
recommendations.summary_zh: 本論文提出 CatchBench，是首個在單一任務—方法介面下，跨三種資訊狀態評測 AI 代理稽核方法的基準：執行前的宣告設定（PRE）、執行中的軌跡前綴（LIVE）與執行後的完整軌跡（POST）。作者主張稽核成效受限於紀錄本身而非方法，故設計七項任務契約，涵蓋過度授權稽核、失敗早期預警、線上錯誤偵測、步驟定位、失敗偵測與原因歸因，形成九個計分板，收錄 1187 個宣告設定與 1162 筆執行紀錄，評測 72 個方法，包括規則掃描器、結構化偵測器與九個模型家族的十一個 LLM 評審。主要結果：118 個預先宣告的比較僅 47 個在 Holm 校正後可分離；GPT-5.5 在 Who&When 定位任務以 Top-1 0.452 領先所有非 LLM 方法；SWE-Gym 失敗偵測的結構特徵效應（0.804 對 0.663）是唯一通過校正者，而 tau-bench 的早期預警始終低於 0.70 警戒線。論文也揭露自身資料的缺陷：某語料來源保留宣告順位，一條只看位置的規則即達完美 F1，顯示分數反映語料建構方式而非推理能力；注入式 Gold 資料因留下可被偵測的建造痕跡，未通過五項可採納性檢驗，三個 Gold 計分板僅列為機制診斷。限制包括多數比較無法解析、標籤流程異質且部分仰賴 LLM 判讀、遺失接地與線上過期狀態偵測等問題仍未解。其價值在於證明基準分數須先公開標籤產生流程並檢驗捷徑才可解讀，並以預先宣告、無需模型呼叫即可重現的統計契約，取代單一排行榜式的結論。
recommendations.title: CatchBench: When Can an Agent Failure Be Caught?

links.title: FraQ: Efficient Coordinate-Space Recompression for Federated Low-Rank Adaptation

evidence: Section 1: Introduces problem of aggregation mismatch in federated LoRA and states FraQ achieves accuracy close to uncompressed baselines while substantially reducing downlink communication.
Section 3.2: Proposition 1 establishes isometric coordinate equivalence, proving optimal low-rank recompression can be performed in coordinate space.
Table 1: Reports accuracy, downlink, and latency for multiple methods; FraQ achieves competitive accuracy with reduced downlink.
Section 4.1: Describes experimental setup with RoBERTa and LLaMA-3.2-3B on text classification and commonsense reasoning benchmarks.
Section 4.2: Presents main results showing FraQ maintains accuracy within 0.61 points of FLoRA on classification and within 0.33 on reasoning, while using 23.4% to 67.8% of FLoRA's downlink.
Ablation study (Table 3) shows direction-adaptive orientation and Gram-based recovery reduce latency and memory while preserving accuracy.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Paper presents FraQ, a method for efficient federated LoRA recompression, directly relevant to LLM fine-tuning, federated learning, and efficient adaptation. It addresses aggregation mismatch in LoRA, a known issue, with a novel coordinate-space approach using QR and Gram matrices. The paper provides strong theoretical guarantees, extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks, and ablations. However, it is not specifically about Japanese LLM or reasoning/CoT, but strongly aligns with LLM, federated learning, and efficiency. Baseline comparisons and quantitative results are thorough. Limitations are acknowledged. Reproducibility is supported by detailed algorithmic and hyperparameter descriptions.

primary_link.title: FraQ: Efficient Coordinate-Space Recompression for Federated Low-Rank Adaptation

recommendations.summary: Federated fine-tuning with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) enables efficient collaborative adaptation of Large Language Models (LLMs) without centralizing private data. However, LoRA's two-factor parameterization creates an aggregation mismatch across clients: naively averaging the factors does not recover the average of their induced updates. This mismatch can be avoided by forming the exact aggregate in the full weight space and then recompressing it, but decomposing the resulting dense matrix is c
recommendations.summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）的聯邦微調常使用低秩適應（LoRA）技術，以在保護資料隱私的同時進行高效的參數更新。然而，LoRA的雙因子參數化導致聚合不匹配問題：傳統FedAvg方式對兩個低秩因子分別做平均，無法精確還原所有客戶端更新之加權平均，造成全局模型表現下降。現有方法雖可透過堆疊所有客戶端的因子矩陣來精確表示聚合更新，但會使廣播給客戶端的適配器維度隨客戶端數量與本地秩數增長，增加下行通訊成本。FraQ提出一個創新的座標空間再壓縮框架，解決此困境。其核心在於利用正交基底與緊湊座標矩陣來表示精確聚合更新，無需在伺服器端具體化完整的權重矩陣。此方法首先建立正交基底，接著從一個小型Gram矩陣的特徵分解中恢復聚合更新的奇異譜，並根據能量保留門檻選擇最小的秩數，最後僅將保留的座標子空間映射回原始空間，形成緊湊的全局LoRA因子。理論上，FraQ透過等距座標轉換證明其壓縮結果能達到全空間Eckart–Young最優近似。實驗涵蓋文本分類與常識推理等多項任務，並在不同資料異質性與統一同質或異質客戶端秩數的設定下進行。結果顯示，FraQ在多數情況下能達到與未壓縮方法相當的準確度，同時顯著降低下行通訊量（例如在推理任務中，τ=0.95時僅需FLoRA的67.8%通訊量），並大幅減少伺服器端再壓縮的延遲（比FLoRIST快8至15倍，比FlexLoRA快數百倍）。此外，FraQ在數值穩定性上也表現優異，即使在病態條件數下仍能保持低誤差。儘管如此，FraQ仍有兩項限制：其一，其計算成本隨參與客戶端總秩數呈立方增長，在客戶端數量極多時優勢減弱；其二，其採用合併並重新初始化的機制，無法利用前輪的適配器狀態加速收斂。整體而言，FraQ提供了一個兼顧準確度、通訊效率與伺服器端計算負擔的聯邦LoRA再壓縮方案，對於資源受限或異質的聯邦環境尤具價值。

links.title: Decomposition Attacks Across Unlinkable Identities: Limits of Stateful Defenses for LLM Services

evidence: Abstract: reports experiments on 91 executable tasks and 11,393 capability-matched benign requests; all ten tested policies fail to stop attacks or exceed budgets; attack success >=99% after one attempt and 100% after two on defense-unseen families.

Section 4, Theorems 1-2 and Propositions 2-3: exact one-attempt frontier ASR*(B)=max{0,1-B/D} and finite-retry frontier, plus non-identification of off-service pooling from the request trace; proofs in Appendix A.1-A.5.

Section 5.1: dataset construction from 500 synthetic cyber tasks -> 491 screened -> 262 qualified -> 91-task common support cohort with 365 operations and 11,393 certified matched controls; frozen family splits for training, adaptation, calibration, and evaluation.
Section 6.1 and Appendix B.17: independent causal replay reproduces the analytic frontiers within frozen Monte Carlo tolerance (65,000 cells), with LP agreement to 5.69e-14.

Section 7.2, Table 2: on the main evaluation split the best admissible realizable defense (M5) reaches 97.64% ASR under 1% MCD/0.5% BBR caps; methods with lower ASR (M1, M6, M8) exceed the matched-control cap.

Section 7.3 and Appendix B.4: Thompson sampling using only Allow/Block bits reaches 99.4% ASR vs 47.2% for a fixed profile across 3,072 cells; one certified retry raises M1 from 8.75% to 98.75% ASR in the positive control (Table 4).

Section 8 and Appendix B.18: acknowledged limitations include synthetic cyber-only tasks, shared construction prefix (removed in B.12 ablation), mutable DeepSeek API aliases observed on a single date, and main-split in-distribution design; conclusions framed as conditional mechanism evidence.

Appendix B.3 and B.17: pinned model revisions (hashes), exact prompts and thresholds, seeds for resampling, and a portable result inventory with identifiers and hashes support reproducibility, though the capability bank is described as gated for reviewers.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A strong LLM-safety paper squarely on preference: it formalizes decomposition (multi-request) attacks against stateful defenses for LLM services under unlinkable identities, proves exact security-utility frontiers (Theorems 1-2, Propositions 1-3), builds an executable benchmark (91 tasks, 365 operations, 11,393 capability-matched controls, 1.5M background requests), and evaluates 8 realizable defenses plus a privileged steelman and a coalition-aware oracle. Novelty is high: the hidden access-coalition threat model, balanced recoloring protocol, and impossibility-style frontier results go beyond TwinGate/DecomposedHarm/Paranoid Monitors. Rigor is exceptional: theory replayed to numerical precision (Section 6.1, Appendix B.17), calibration/test family splits, an 11-family defense-unseen outer cohort, positive controls (Section 7.3, Table 4), construction-prefix ablation (Section 7.1, B.12), generator-provenance analysis (B.10-B.11), budget sweeps and threshold re-solving (B.8, B.13), and honest cap-overrun reporting (Tables 2, 10, 12). Evidence is strong but domain-limited: only synthetic cyber-programming tasks, a single attacker/judge model family (Qwen 3.5), and mutable DeepSeek API alias screens are acknowledged limitations (Section 8, B.18), and the main evaluation split is in-distribution by construction. Generalizability of the theoretical claim is broad within the stated observation boundary, but empirical transfer is only mechanism-level. Reproducibility is very strong on paper: pinned model revisions, seeds, prompts, thresholds, and a result inventory (B.3, B.17), though availability appears gated rather than fully public. No unsupported claims detected; the key numbers (97.64% best admissible ASR on main split, >=99.43% at highest outer density, 99.4% Thompson-sampling ASR) are consistently reported with intervals.

primary_link.title: Decomposition Attacks Across Unlinkable Identities: Limits of Stateful Defenses for LLM Services

recommendations.summary: Most large language model services use stateless defenses, which judge only the current request, to refuse harmful tasks. Decomposition attacks exploit this limitation by splitting a harmful task into individually permissible requests and combining their answers. Defending against them therefore requires a stateful monitor that considers requests together. If it can group all requests for one attacker task, it can stop the attack. recommendations.summary_zh: 本文研究大型語言模型（LLM）服務對分解式攻擊的防禦極限。此類攻擊將有害任務拆成個別看似無害的子請求，分別送出後於服務外合併答案；多數服務僅依當前請求判斷的無狀態防禦因此失效。理論上，有狀態監控若能將同一攻擊的所有請求正確分組並累積其能力即可阻斷任務，但攻擊者可透過服務無法連結的全新身分送出請求，使分組訊號失效。作者建立區分「可連結群組」與「存取聯盟」的威脅模型，並證明在此觀測邊界內，理想防禦者的安全與效用權衡前緣完全由良性請求的分組結構決定：良性請求重複出現於可辨識群組時防禦可行；若攻擊與良性請求皆使用不可區分的新群組，加強防護必然增加誤擋，且當攻擊者可重試並觀察 Allow/Block 回饋時，有利的操作點隨之消失。實驗以 91 個可執行任務、365 項操作與 11,393 個能力相符的良性請求驗證理論：在 1% 良性誤擋與 0.5% 背景誤擋上限下，十種受測政策（含具備精確請求—操作對應的特權基準）不是擋不住攻擊就是超出預算；在防禦未見的任務家族上，一次嘗試攻擊成功率至少 99%，兩次後達 100%；僅憑二元回饋的 Thompson sampling 攻擊者可達 99.4% ASR。研究受限於合成網路程式設計任務與僅觀察請求的通道，未涵蓋能存取回應或工具證據的系統。其意義在於指出：有效防禦需仰賴可靠身分連結、新身分成本或範圍限定授權等獨立證據，且安全評估應揭露狀態累積單位與良性對照設計。

links.title: Training Agents to Evolve with Their Harness: TaoLive Digital Avatar Agent Technical Report

evidence: Abstract/Section 5.2 Table 3: HAT reaches 94.8 AVG on T1 vs base 80.3 and best top model 93.0; Fixed-Harness SFT drops IFE-P to 73.8 (-7.7) while HAT achieves 83.5.
Section 5.3 Table 4: ablation crosses HSA at SFT and RL; non-augmented RL drops Prompt Robustness 72.6→66.7 whereas HSA-RL raises 77.1→77.6, supporting the HSA claim.
Appendix C.4 Table 14: paired bootstrap shows Ours−Fixed-SFT IFE-P +8.50 [4.44,12.38] but Ours−Base +2.03 [-1.11,+5.18] with P_boot=0.1134, i.e., general-capability gain over base not significant.
Appendix B.4/Figure 9: judge calibration on n=482 human labels; effectiveness agreement peaks at 83.40% and selected panel at 82.2%, so headline Accuracy/Effectiveness rest on an imperfect proxy.

Section 5.5 Tables 5/7: single H20 with MTP gives P95 8.114s at C=1 (1.69× decode speedup, 100% ≤15s attainment); speedup degrades to 1.27×/1.19× at C=4-8, honestly scoped as low-concurrency optimization.
Section 5.7 Table 8: human blind test on 100 requests, Harness preferred 35 vs ReAct 1 (binomial p<0.001), with 64 ties.
Section 5.8 Table 10: A/B with 1,581,494 control and 395,276 treatment UVs shows GMV +4.3340% and IPV +0.9107%; significance is the platform's assessment without exposed test, thresholds, or CIs.
Section 5.1 and Appendix C: training data are 10K proprietary live-room SFT examples and 4K RL tasks with no code, data, or checkpoint release, limiting reproducibility.
Section 5.6: held-out harness edits cut error counts by 51.7% for HAT vs 18.1% for Fixed-Harness SFT on 1,000 held-out real-traffic cases.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An industrial LLM-agent technical report squarely within preferred topics (agents/tool use, agentic RL, distillation, prompting, serving). Core methodological idea—Harness-State Augmentation placing harness variation (skills, tools, prompts, hooks) into the training distribution to prevent surface-form overfitting—is a sensible, moderately novel framing that mostly composes known techniques (teacher-rejection SFT, on-policy distillation, GRPO/GDPO/GSPO). Rigor is above average for a tech report: stage-wise ablations (Table 4), judge calibration against 482 human labels (Appendix B.4), paired bootstrap (Table 14), a 100-request human blind test with binomial test, and a ~1.98M-UV online A/B test. Evidence is strong but self-referential: headline quality scores come from the authors' own LLM-judge panel with ~82-90% human agreement, two of four sets are synthetic/LLM-generated, and the IFEval gain over base (+2.03, CI [-1.11,+5.18], P_boot=0.1134) is honestly reported as not significant; A/B significance is reproduced from the platform without test details. Generalizability is claimed via a general formulation but all evaluation is Taobao live-commerce; the method plausibly transfers to any evolvable-harness agent. Reproducibility is low: no code/data release, proprietary live-room data, internal simulator and harness inventory, unreleased future-model checkpoints. Not a pure domain application since the training methodology is the contribution.

primary_link.title: Training Agents to Evolve with Their Harness: TaoLive Digital Avatar Agent Technical Report

recommendations.summary: AI-powered digital avatar streamers must answer product questions, engage viewers, and execute marketing strategies in real time, demanding low latency, frequent strategy updates, and accurate yet effective responses. Evolvable Harnesses, whose Skills, Hooks, prompts, and tools can be updated independently of model weights, enable rapid iteration but expose a trade-off: large models adapt zero-shot yet are too slow, whereas compact models meet latency targets but overfit to fixed Harness configurations. We propose Harness-Aware Training (HAT), which trains compact models to adapt to changing Harnesses. Its key component, Harness-State Augmentation (HSA), applies task-preserving transformations to Skill identifiers and content, tool schemas, prompt structures, and Hook functions. Training proceeds in three stages: HSA-SFT learns reasoning and tool use from strong-model trajectories across diverse environments; General On-Policy Distillation restores generalization lost during SFT; and HSA-RL improves robustness to changing Harnesses through reinforcement learning in augmented environments. Across four evaluation sets, HAT achieves 94.8 on Live-Stream QA (base: 80.3; strongest general LLM: 93.0) and 94.6 on Harness-Variant QA (base: 75.4). Unlike Fixed-Harness SFT, which lowers IFEval by 7.7 points from the base model, HAT avoids this regression and reaches 83.5. On one NVIDIA H20 GPU, the optimized system delivers P50 and P95 latencies of 3.4 s and 8.1 s. Deployed in Taobao Live's digital-avatar service, it also yields positive online A/B test results for GMV and item-page views.
recommendations.summary_zh: 此報告探討淘寶直播數位虛擬主播代理的訓練難題:即時電商要求超低延遲、策略頻繁更新,回覆又須準確。團隊採用可演化的 Harness 架構,將 Skills、Hooks、系統提示與工具註冊表同凍結的模型權重解耦,業務行為免重訓即可調整;但僅以單一組態做 SFT,輕量模型會對技能與工具名稱、提示模板產生表面形式過擬合,IFEval 掉了7.7分。作者提出 Harness-Aware Training(HAT),以 Harness-State Augmentation(HSA)對技能識別與內容、工具定義、系統提示及 Hook 施加保留語意的擾動,並採三階段訓練:HSA-SFT 由教師模型在多樣 Harness 環境產生軌跡;General OPD 以基礎模型做 on-policy 蒸餾,恢復通用指令遵循;HSA-RL 在模擬直播環境以 GRPO 與 GDPO 做強化學習。訓練後的 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 在 Live-Stream QA 達94.8分、Harness-Variant QA 達94.6分,IFEval 保住83.5分而未退化;單張 NVIDIA H20 開啟 MTP 後 P50 延遲3.4秒、P95約8.1秒,請求全數於15秒內完成;線上 A/B 測試確認收貨 GMV 較 ReAct 提升4.33%、商品頁瀏覽提升0.91%。限制為評測集與模擬器多源自自有業務資料且依賴內部評審,MTP 加速僅限低併發,訓練動態屬單次運行診斷。本研究示範讓輕量模型理解當前 Harness 而非背誦固定版本,兼顧延遲、適應性與通用能力,對快速迭代的生產級代理系統深具參考價值。

links.title: Learning to Persuade Exposes How Easily LLMs Abandon Correct Beliefs

evidence: Abstract: reports RL-trained persuaders raise persuasion success from approximately 24% to over 93% against the training-time persuadee and transfer at 25-83% to unseen models.
Section 4.1 Main Results: reports TruthfulQA Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct accuracy drops from 66.2% to 1.8% and PSR rises from 24.3% to 93.7% after training.
Section 4.2 Analysis: reports curriculum continual training improves GPT-4o-mini TruthfulQA PSR from 24.6% to 37.9% and identifies emergent deception and credibility-based strategies.
Appendix E Tables 2-8: provide full PSR/ASR means and standard deviations across five datasets, multiple persuaders and persuadees over five seeds.

llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant LLM safety/agent red-teaming paper; moderate novelty with strong controlled experiments and broad transfer evaluation, but single-turn MCQ scope and LLM-based annotation limit confidence.

primary_link.title: Learning to Persuade Exposes How Easily LLMs Abandon Correct Beliefs

As LLMs increasingly debate, advise, and think collaboratively with humans and each other, resistance to harmful persuasion becomes a core requirement for reliable behavior. Yet we show that this requirement is far from met: a single targeted persuasive argument is enough to collapse model accuracy to near zero, even when the argumen
recommendations.summary_zh: 本研究探討大型語言模型在面對最佳化說服攻擊時的脆弱性。作者提出「對抗式說服」框架，以強化學習訓練「說服者」代理，使其能在單次互動中，讓目標模型（「被說服者」）改變原本正確的答案。實驗顯示，透過強化學習訓練的說服者，能將對訓練時所見模型的說服成功率從約24%提升至93%以上，並能轉移至未見過的模型，例如對Qwen-14B達83%成功率，對Llama-3.1-8B達79%，對GPT-4o-mini也有25%。進一步以課程式持續訓練，可再將對GPT-4o-mini的攻擊成功率提升至38%。分析發現，最佳化後的说服策略傾向使用可信度手法，包括捏造引用與虛假權威證據。此研究揭示當前LLM代理的重大安全漏洞：即使初始推理正確，仍可能被最佳化的自然語言影響引導至錯誤結論。作者定位此框架為紅隊工具，用以審計多代理與人機協作系統的說服韌性。限制包括僅限單輪、選擇題情境，且未提出完整防禦機制。

links.title: LatentGuard: Efficient and Inspectable Latent Reasoning for LLM Safeguards

evidence: Abstract states LatentGuard improves F1 from 83.95 to 84.91 and reduces reasoning tokens from 268.56 to 1.60.
Table 1: LatentGuard-8B achieves mean weighted F1 of 84.91 vs GuardReasoner-8B 83.95.
Table 2: LatentGuard-8B reduces latency to 0.089s vs 0.792s and reasoning tokens to 1.60.
Table 3: Audit decoder AUS 85.75 with abalations showing source-text and latent states contribute.
Section 4.5 Ablations table shows staged curriculum improves mean F1 over w/o curriculum and w/o latent.
Table 4: Human validation shows 95.6% label agreement and 94.8% rationale agreement.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to LLM safety, reasoning, and efficiency guardrails. The paper introduces latent reasoning for LLM safeguards, directly aligning with multiple preferences (LLM, safety, reasoning, efficiency, evaluation). The method and baselines are rigorous, with clear ablations and quantitative results. While novelty is moderate given prior latent reasoning work, it uniquely applies to safety and adds auditability. Evidence is strong with F1 gains and efficiency metrics, but generalization to multimodal is limited. Reproducibility is supported by details on data, training, and inference.

primary_link.title: LatentGuard: Efficient and Inspectable Latent Reasoning for LLM Safeguards

recommendations.summary: Reasoning-based guard models improve LLM safeguards, but decoding explicit rationales for every interaction makes them costly to deploy. Although latent-reasoning methods reduce token generation by moving reasoning into continuous states, they remain underexplored for safety moderation and lack an inspection interface for deployment. In this paper, we propose LatentGuard, an efficient and inspectable safeguard framework that brings continuous latent reasoning to guard models. LatentGuard uses a
recommendations.summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）的部署需要安全防護機制，但現有防護模型在效率、品質與可檢視性之間面臨取捨。基於分類的防護模型（如 LlamaGuard、WildGuard）雖高效，但缺乏決策透明度；而基於推理的防護模型（如 GuardReasoner）雖能產生明確理由以提升可檢視性，卻因每次互動都需生成完整思緒鏈而帶來高昂的延遲與計算成本。為解決此問題，本文提出 LatentGuard，一個高效率且可檢視的防護框架，將連續潛在推理引入防護模型，以解耦安全預測與理由生成。LatentGuard 採用分階段課程，逐步將任務對齊的文字理由壓縮為緊湊的潛在狀態，使模型在標準推論期間能直接從連續表徵預測結構化的安全標籤（請求有害性、拒絕偵測、回應有害性），無需生成明確理由。同時，為保留可檢視性，LatentGuard 訓練一個隔離的輔助解碼器，僅在需要稽核時才按需求生成緊湊的稽核工件，不影響標準推論路徑。實驗結果顯示，LatentGuard-8B 在三任務平均加權 F1 上從 GuardReasoner-8B 的 83.95 提升至 84.91，同時將關鍵路徑的推理成本從平均 268.56 個明確理由 token 降至 1.60 個潛在推理 token，延遲從 0.792 秒降至 0.089 秒。其稽核解碼器在稽核效用分數（AUS）上達到 85.75，證明潛在推理能支援有用的按需檢視。然而，作者也指出稽核模式仍會產生額外計算，且生成的稽核工件是簡潔的證據摘要，而非模型內部計算的忠實重建；此外，目前評估僅限於文字型安全審核。整體而言，LatentGuard 展示了潛在推理在可擴展且可檢視的 LLM 防護上的潛力。
recommendations.title: LatentGuard: Efficient and Inspectable Latent Reasoning for LLM Safeguards
recommendations.title_zh: LatentGuard：針對 LLM 防護的高效率且可檢視之潛在推理框架

links.title: Does Forgetting Transfer Across Modalities? A Real-World Benchmark for Cross-Modal Knowledge Unlearning Evaluation

evidence: Abstract: introduces UNLINK-VL, a benchmark for cross-modal knowledge unlearning in VLMs
Section 1 (Introduction): discusses memorization risks and need for cross-modal unlearning
Section 3 (UNLINK-VL Benchmark): detailed pipeline for data construction
Section 4 (Experiments): quantitative results on Qwen3-VL-8B and Qwen3-VL-32B
Table 2: main results showing asymmetric transfer
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to AI safety (unlearning), multimodal AI, and LLM/VLM evaluation.
