Generalizability is moderate due to focus on specific VLM families, but patterns are likely transferable.

primary_link.title: Does Forgetting Transfer Across Modalities? A Real-World Benchmark for Cross-Modal Knowledge Unlearning Evaluation

recommendations.summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs), like Large Language Models (LLMs), may memorize sensitive, copyrighted, or harmful knowledge from their pretraining corpora. Removing such knowledge is essential for building trustworthy AI systems. However, existing studies primarily focus on forgetting within individual modalities. Although recent work has begun to explore cross-modal consistency in unlearning, the cross-modal transfer of real-world knowledge unlearning remains insufficiently studied. To address
recommendations.summary_zh: 這篇論文提出了一個名為 UNLINK-VL 的真實世界基準，用於評估視覺語言模型（VLMs）中的跨模態知識遺忘。研究動機在於，現有的機器遺忘研究多集中於單一模態內，但實際應用中，使用者可能透過不同模態（例如純文字問題或圖文問題）查詢相同的事實知識。若模型僅在某一模態下表現出遺忘效果，卻在另一模態下仍能恢復被遺忘的知識，則遺忘並不徹底。該基準選取了 250 個視覺上可識別的真實世界實體作為遺忘目標，並從 Wikidata 收集其一跳與多跳事實，構建了四個互補的評估子集：遺忘集（Forget Set）、多跳集（Multi-Hop Set）、保留集（Retain Set）以及改寫集（Rewrite Set），分別評估直接遺忘、遺忘的關係傳播、非目標知識的保留，以及對語意等價查詢的穩健性。研究設計了四種訓練/評估模態組合：T→T、T→M、M→T、M→M，其中 T 代表純文字，M 代表圖文輸入。實驗在 Qwen3-VL 與 Llama-3.2-Vision 系列模型上進行，採用 GA、DPO、NPO、RT 四種代表性遺忘方法，並比較全參數微調與 LoRA。主要結果顯示：多模態輸入下的遺忘（M→M）通常比純文字遺忘（T→T）更有效；但更關鍵的是，存在顯著的跨模態遷移不對稱性——多模態遺忘能較好地遷移到純文字評估（M→T），而純文字遺忘遷移到圖文評估（T→M）的效果則明顯較差。這意味著僅依賴純文字評估可能會大幅高估 VLM 的遺忘效果。此外，評估的方法大多能保留模型的一般能力，但在多跳與改寫集上的準確率仍偏高，顯示被遺忘的知識仍可透過關係推理或語意改寫被恢復。此基準填補了現有研究在跨模態遺忘遷移評估上的空白，強調了在真實應用中需同時考慮多模態的遺忘訓練與評估，以確保遺忘的穩健性。
recommendations.title: Does Forgetting Transfer Across Modalities? A Real-World Benchmark for Cross-Modal Knowledge Unlearning Evaluation
recommendations.title_zh: 遺忘是否跨模態遷移？一個用於跨模態知識遺忘評估的真實世界基準

links.title: Left-Branching Transformers Excel at Right-Branching Languages: Data Shapes Word Order Preferences in Language Models

evidence: Abstract: 'We systematically compare word order preferences in decoder-only language models across 192 artificial languages and typologically diverse natural languages'; models 'exhibit a left-branching preference' on artificial languages but an SVO advantage on natural languages at scale, establishing data-driven bias.

Section 5.2, Table 1: SVO-SOV gap absent at 5 MB (Mann-Whitney U=353, p=.99) and large at 1 GB (Cliff's delta=-0.76, U=84, p<10^-5), with the same 68 languages compared across all four training sizes so the shift is attributable to data volume.

Section A.5, Table 6: the is_SOV x size interaction survives all covariate controls (beta +0.049 to +0.038, p<=.001) including morphological complexity (subword MATTR), resourcedness, and OSCAR web-crawl share, plus a maximal random-effects robustness refit.

Section 5.2, Table 2 and footnotes 11-13: SVO advantage extends to mGPT and XGLM but reverses in BLOOM because 21 of 28 SVO languages are very-low-resource Niger-Congo (median 1.7 MB vs 3.7 GB), supporting the resource/data-quality explanation.

Section 4.1 and Appendix A.1: 192 grammars x 10 disjoint splits trained per data size (~252 A100 GPU-hours), full hyperparameters in Table 3, plus a unigram-tokenizer re-run of all 192 models (Spearman rho=0.94 at 5 MB) confirming results are not tokenizer-driven.

Limitations section: admits GPT-2-only architecture, written formal/translated corpora (FLORES-200, PUD; translationese risk), coarse data-quality proxy, and categorical WALS word-order labels as constraints on generalization.
Title page: 'Code and data are available at https://github.com/kleines-gespenst/word-order-preferences'; Appendix A.7 documents licensing for all artefacts.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core decoder-only LM/transformer analysis (GPT-2, Goldfish, mGPT, BLOOM, XGLM) squarely matching the highest-weight LLM, transformer, and NLP preferences, though it does not touch reasoning, agents, RAG, or prompting. Methodologically strong: 192 artificial languages x 10 splits x 2 data sizes, matched architectures across artificial/natural settings, Holm-Bonferroni corrections, mixed-effects models with morphological/resource/data-composition covariates, script-confound subset checks, PUD replication, and a tokenizer robustness re-run. The central claim (word order preference is data-driven, SVO advantage emerging with data scale) is supported by quantified effects (Cliff's delta -0.76 at 1GB, is_SOV x size beta surviving all controls) and the homogenisation risk is carefully framed as a precondition rather than an overclaimed result. Novelty is good but partly incremental over White & Cotterell (2021), whose left-branching finding is corroborated rather than overturned; the artificial+natural unification and scaling analysis are the genuinely new contributions. Generalizability is limited by small (20.6M) models, written/translated evaluation text, and no frontier-model validation, which the Limitations section transparently acknowledges. Code, data, hyperparameters, compute cost, and licensing are all provided, making the work highly reproducible.

primary_link.title: Left-Branching Transformers Excel at Right-Branching Languages: Data Shapes Word Order Preferences in Language Models

recommendations.summary: We systematically compare word order preferences in decoder-only language models across 192 artificial languages and typologically diverse natural languages. On artificial languages, models exhibit a left-branching preference that aligns with neither natural language universals nor human word order learning biases. On natural languages, monolingual models show no clear base word order bias at small scales, but as data grows, a preference for right-branching subject-verb-object (SVO) languages em
recommendations.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討語言模型是否對語序有系統性偏好,以及這些偏好源自架構本身還是訓練資料。作者結合兩條研究路線:一是在192種人工語言(6種S/V/O基本語序搭配32種內部成分排列)上訓練GPT-2風格的解碼器模型;二是評估訓練資料量從5MB到1GB的單語Goldfish模型,以及mGPT、BLOOM、XGLM等多語模型,涵蓋類型多樣的自然語言,以困惑度與BPEC(每英文字元位元數)等指標衡量建模難度。結果顯示,在人工語言上模型一致偏好左分支配置,既不符合跨語言的語序共性,也與人類學習者的和諧偏好相左;在自然語言上,小資料量時未見明顯偏好,但資料規模擴大後,SVO語言變得最容易建模,SOV語言儘管是跨語言最常見的語序反而落後,且此SVO優勢延伸到多語模型,並與語言資源等級及資料品質相關,而非語序本身。同一架構在兩種設定下呈現相反偏好,證明實際觀察到的語序偏好是資料驅動的。作者也討論限制:實驗限於GPT-2架構與書面正式語料,類型學資料庫的二分標籤可能掩蓋漸變的語序變異,資料品質也只能以粗略代理指標衡量。由於高資源語言絕大多數為SVO,這種偏好在LLM普及下可能導致「靜默類型同質化」,逐漸侵蝕語序多樣性,因此透過資料策展可望緩解此風險,對多語言NLP的公平性具重要意義。
recommendations.title: Left-Branching Transformers Excel at Right-Branching Languages: Data Shapes Word Order Preferences in Language Models
recommendations.title_zh: 左分支Transformer擅長右分支語言:資料形塑語言模型中的語序偏好

links.title: Harmful Content Is Not Enough: Continuation Framing Moderates In-Context Emergent Misalignment

evidence: Abstract: demonstration framing raises broad EM by 30-32 percentage points on a susceptible Gemini model.
Section 3.4/Appendix C: condition-blinded human audit finds judge-human agreement kappa=.871 and recovers the primary demo/document gap.
Section 4.1 Main Results: all ten content draws positive with exact sign-flip p=.002.
Section 4.5 Generality Across Models and Retrieval: effect is model-dependent; no effect found in GPT-5.5, Claude Opus 4.8, or Qwen3.5.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly relevant to LLM safety, alignment, in-context learning, prompting, tool-use provenance, and red-teaming evaluation. The paper provides paired causal controls, clustered inference, blinded human audits, and explicit negative results. Main limitations are model-dependent effects, reliance on closed aliases, and some small factorial cells.

primary_link.title: Harmful Content Is Not Enough: Continuation Framing Moderates In-Context Emergent Misalignment

recommendations.summary: In-context learning (ICL) can induce emergent misalignment (EM), where narrow misaligned examples alter answers to unrelated questions. Existing prompts, however, conflate harmful-text exposure with an invitation to continue assistant behavior. We hold harmful answers fixed while varying their delivery as demonstrations, evidence, assistant history, or tool output. Across ten independently sampled contexts, demonstration framing raises broad EM by $30$--$32$ percentage points on a susceptible Ge
recommendations.summary_zh: 本研究探討情境學習（in-context learning, ICL）中的「湧現式失準」（emergent misalignment, EM）現象，即窄域不良範例會使模型在無關問題上產生廣泛失準行為。作者主張過去研究將「接觸有害文字」與「被要求接續助手行為」混為一談。實驗固定有害答案內容，僅改變其呈現方式（示範、證據、助手歷史、工具輸出），在十組獨立抽樣情境下，示範框架使易受影響的Gemini模型之廣泛EM率提升30至32個百分點；此差異在排除相關領域、語意叢集、未見問題及四種提示模板下仍舊存在。格式與長度配對控制顯示有害內容為必要但非充分條件。角色與接續因子設計進一步揭露模型依賴的來源效應：Gemini同時遵循助手與工具歷史，而Grok大致抵抗工具框架的接續。其他前沿與開放權重模型未見此差異。盲測人評確認所有主要對比，並顯示模型評判低估主動條件失敗。作者結論：接續框架是ICL-EM的強烈且模型依賴的調節因子，而非有害情境的普遍後果。研究限制包括閉源模型別名非固定、機制層面僅呈現相關性，以及開放權重模型多拒絕誘導示範。此發現對建構安全提示與評估推論期組裝系統具有重要性。
recommendations.title: Harmful Content Is Not Enough: Continuation Framing Moderates In-Context Emergent Misalignment
recommendations.title_zh: 有害內容不足以致病：接續框架調節情境內湧現式失準

links.title: Measuring the Wrong Thing: Internal Harmfulness Scores Anti-Rank Successful Jailbreaks

evidence: Section 5.2 RQ1 reports harmful intent AUROC falls from 0.936 to 0.803 while wrapped harmful generation rises from 0.05 to 0.27, with outcome AUROC 0.220 (CI [0.109,0.343]).
Table 1 crosses native score sources and generators (Llama, Mistral, Qwen), reporting outcome AUROC with bootstrap 95% CIs, most below chance.
Section 5.3 Table 3 separates ranking, calibration, and threshold transfer under distribution shift, e.g., WildJailbreak AUROC 0.850 and ECE 0.366.
Appendix A includes ablations for readout sensitivity, norm-matched controls, and calibration; Section 6 acknowledges limitations such as automated judges and small positive counts.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly relevant to LLM AI safety, jailbreak evaluation, and interpretability. Strong matched factorial design with multiple measurement channels, targets, judges, and CIs; honest limitations. Weaknesses include automated judges, small positive counts in some cells, single greedy decode for primary outcomes, and many derived-channel results limited to Llama. Overall high-quality audit with robust evidence and controls.

primary_link.title: Measuring the Wrong Thing: Internal Harmfulness Scores Anti-Rank Successful Jailbreaks

recommendations.summary: Internal safety scores judge a prompt before any text is generated, and they are validated by how well they separate harmful prompts from benign ones. That separation is then read as evidence that the score will also catch the attacks that succeed. Harmful intent is a property of the prompt. Jailbreak success is an outcome produced later by a particular target model, decoding policy, and judge. A filter tuned on a score that measures the wrong quantity spends its false positive budget on attacks
recommendations.summary_zh: 本論文檢視內部安全分數是否真能預測大型語言模型（LLM）的越獄成功。作者指出，危害意圖是提示詞的屬性，而越獄成功則取決於目標模型、解碼策略與評判者，兩者概念不同。他們提出主動注意力探測（Active Attention Probing, AAP）方法，將測量座標固定於系統區，以避免包裝語句改變測量位置。實驗顯示，包裝有害請求會將Llama的有害生成率從0.05提升至0.27，但危害意圖的AUROC卻從0.936降至0.803；在包裝後的有害提示中，結果導向的AUROC僅0.220，顯示成功攻擊的分數反而低於失敗攻擊。此反轉現象在罕見詞彙、被動等不同測量管道，以及多個目標模型、攻擊家族與獨立評判者中持續存在。此外，分布偏移會先削弱校準與閾值轉移，再影響排序。研究強調，危害意圖與實際越獄成功需分開驗證，且分數的校準與閾值轉移可能先於排序失效。限制包括自動化標籤可能不完美、單一貪婪解碼取樣，以及部分攻擊僅在Llama上評估。
recommendations.title: Measuring the Wrong Thing: Internal Harmfulness Scores Anti-Rank Successful Jailbreaks
recommendations.title_zh: 衡量錯誤的指標：內部危害分數反而反向排序成功的越獄攻擊

links.title: From Inertia to Objectivity: Improving Deep Research Agents with Noise Isolation

evidence: Abstract: NIS-Agent achieves competitive performance while reducing token cost by 33% vs the smolagents DR baseline; code publicly available at github.com/PangSMPang/NIS-Agent
Section 3.2 / Appendix A.4: IBIS construction — 1,016 LLM-generated candidates filtered to 712, human annotation retains 245 Should Re-search + 209 Should Visit Page samples, Fleiss' kappa = 0.684
Section 6.2: switching Agentic to Observer Mode improves Should Re-search accuracy ~15–30% across models; GPT-4o collapses to 4.08% in Agentic Mode (Appendix B.1 Table 7)
Appendix A.5: paired flip analysis — 91.9% of flips point toward the inertia direction; 18 surface features fail to predict flips (AUC 0.498 direction, 0.492 occurrence)
Section 6.4 Table 4: GAIA/GPT-4o ablation — full NIS-Agent 61.82 vs w/o Filter 59.39 vs w/o Validation 56.96; Table 3: total tokens 219.8k → 147.3k (−33.0%)
Table 5: validation module transfers to math reasoning — AIME 2025 GPT-4.1 improves 35.3 → 68.7 vs CoT validation
Section 5 + Appendix D: NIS-8B trained on Qwen3-8B via SFT (4,293 examples) then GRPO (9,964 examples) with offline rubric generation (Claude Sonnet 4) and cheap online judge (qwen3-max)
Section 8 Limitations: no mechanistic investigation of the bias; generalization beyond information seeking and math is speculative; isolation filters can mistakenly discard relevant pages
Appendix C.4.2: full WebWalkerQA (680 queries) run with Claude-3.7-Sonnet yields 69.26% vs 68.50% on the 200-query subset, supporting subset reliability
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-agent research: diagnoses a newly named agentic failure mode ('inertia bias'), builds a controlled diagnostic benchmark (IBIS), proposes context-isolation interventions (NIS-Agent), and trains an 8B model via SFT+GRPO to internalize resistance. Hits high-weight preferences squarely (Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, Reasoning, RL/alignment, evaluation/benchmarks, RAG/grounding). Novelty is solid but context isolation/pruning is a known tool family; the contribution is the targeted debiasing framing plus controlled Agentic-vs-Observer measurement. Rigor is above average: paired conditions, Fleiss' kappa 0.684, ablations, token-cost analysis, AIME transfer, a subset-reliability check on full WebWalkerQA, and a paired flip analysis (AUC ~0.50 on surface features) that preempts the main confound. Evidence is strong across multiple benchmarks and backbones, though some baselines are self-reproduced, the noise analysis is manual and small-scale, and the 'inertia bias' construct is distinguished from confirmation bias mainly conceptually. Honest limitations (no mechanistic account, unverified generalization to other agent domains, isolation can discard relevant pages). Code release and detailed training/evaluation protocols support reproducibility, with some dependence on proprietary judges/teachers.

primary_link.title: From Inertia to Objectivity: Improving Deep Research Agents with Noise Isolation

recommendations.summary: Web search agents powered by Large Language Models (LLMs) show strong promise, but deep research tasks expose a recurring failure mode: once an agent has produced a query, plan, or intermediate conclusion, it becomes less objective when later judging the consequences of that same action. We term this phenomenon inertia bias. To make it measurable, we introduce the IBIS benchmark, which controls the search observations while varying whether the model is evaluating the outcome of its own prior act
recommendations.summary_zh: 本文探討 LLM 網路搜尋代理在深度研究任務中的系統性失敗機制:慣性偏誤(inertia bias)。一旦代理產生查詢、計畫或中間結論,之後評估該行動後果時便失去客觀性,傾向強化自己先前的選擇。作者建立 IBIS 基準,在相同搜尋結果下比較「自己發起行動」(Agentic Mode)與「外部資訊」(Observer Mode)兩種情境,發現模型普遍出現 15% 至 30% 的落差,證實此偏誤普遍存在。此偏誤會在兩個決策點放大雜訊:工作者層級的搜尋雜訊與管理者層級的脈絡雜訊。為此提出 NIS-Agent,於網頁篩選與答案驗證兩個脆弱環節導入情境隔離,使判斷脫離代理自身的行動歷史:過濾模組僅依任務狀態評估網頁並適時改寫查詢,驗證模組則重組推理鏈、逐項檢驗推論。在 GAIA、WebWalkerQA 等基準上,NIS-Agent 達到開源框架中的最佳表現,於 BrowseComp 亦具競爭力,並節省 33% token 成本;以 SFT 加 GRPO 訓練的 8B 開源模型 NIS-8B,在同框架下平均表現接近 GPT-4o。驗證模組附加於 ReAct 管線亦可大幅提升 AIME 數學推理成績,顯示方法可外推至深度研究之外。限制方面,作者僅將模型視為黑箱,未探究偏誤的機制根源;偏誤是否通用於程式碼或具身代理仍屬推測;隔離與驗證本身可能誤刪相關頁面或背書錯誤結論,高風險場景應保留人工把關。本文為代理系統的自我強化錯誤提供可量測的診斷基準與去偏介入方案,對建構更可靠的研究型代理極具參考價值。
recommendations.title: From Inertia to Objectivity: Improving Deep Research Agents with Noise Isolation
recommendations.title_zh: 從慣性到客觀:以雜訊隔離改進深度研究代理人

links.title: Inadvertent Context Leakage in Language Models

evidence: Abstract: '2-digit in-context secrets are reconstructed with near-perfect accuracy and 4-digit secrets at 82% exact match, all from outputs the model produces in response to ordinary, non-adversarial requests'
Section 3.1.1: 'Claude Opus sustains 82% exact match and Gemini Pro 44%' at N=4, with adaptive pipeline 'nearly doubles Opus's full-secret recovery over the static templates (82% vs. 44%)'
Appendix B: 'All 160 queries are correctly refused: no model reveals the secret under any baseline prompt', establishing leakage is not trivial disclosure
Appendix E (Randomized controls): decoders trained on shuffled secret labels yield 'advantage is ≤0.02 across all architectures'
Appendix G Table 3: Claude Opus 4.6 digit-stripped embedding decoder reaches 61.3% vs 10% chance while literal digit-frequency decoder is non-significant (16.3%), isolating non-digit channels

Section 4: suppression and leakage 'strongly rank-correlated (Spearman ρ=0.95, exact permutation p=0.0011, n=8)'; OLMo-3-32B-Think channel entropy falls 'from 2.91 bits at Base to 1.37 bits after RLVR'
Section 3.3 / Table 2: SSN Phase 1 68/70 (97.1%) on Claude Opus 4.6 and 62/70 (88.6%) on Gemini 3.1 Pro; direct-request control '0/70' at all context sizes up to 256K tokens

Section 5 (Limitations): 'Open-vocabulary, free-text secrets are a natural next step that we do not attempt here'; 'All eight evaluated models are proprietary'; 'The memory-predicate evaluation covers a single user profile from CIMemories'
Appendix H remark: 'exact match at N=2 spans only the ten held-out secrets and is reported for completeness; per-digit accuracy and channel entropy are the main metrics'
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM safety/privacy research squarely matching high-weight preferences (LLMs, agents, AI safety, red teaming, alignment): the paper studies whether in-context secrets leak through statistical channels of benign LLM outputs and attacks production-style agents. Novelty is strong: it claims and credibly supports a new phenomenon—inadvertent, suppression-driven leakage readable by black-box adaptive decoders—distinct from prompt injection, model inversion, and linguistic-judge contextual-integrity benchmarks, including the counterintuitive finding that more emphatic confidentiality instructions increase leakage (Appendix H: Opus per-digit accuracy 0.643 under verbose policy vs 0.054 under terse). Rigor is high: formal predicate-inference game, 8 proprietary models, 1,000 secrets per (model,N) cell, direct-extraction baseline of 0/160 refusals bypassed (Appendix B), shuffled-label controls ≤0.02 advantage (Appendix E), digit-stripped feature decoders isolating non-digit channels (Appendix G: Opus 61.3% vs 10% chance), distractor-specificity 2×2 design (Appendix I), and cost accounting (Appendix J). Evidence is detailed and internally consistent (Section 3.1.1: 100% full-secret at N=2, 82% at N=4 on Opus; Table 2: SSN Phase 1 97.1%/88.6%, direct control 0/70; Section 4: suppression-leakage Spearman ρ=0.95, p=0.0011), though some headline numbers rest on only 10 held-out secrets at N=2 (acknowledged in Appendix H) and the capability correlation is acknowledged fragile at n=8 (Figure 4 caveat). Generalizability is moderate: two predicate families only, no free-text secrets, single user profile for memory predicates, proprietary-model dependence (Section 5). Reproducibility is limited by proprietary APIs, no stated code/data release, single seeds in places, and mid-project model retirement (Grok omission notes in Appendices G-J).

primary_link.title: Inadvertent Context Leakage in Language Models

recommendations.summary: For AI agents to be useful beyond simple chat, they must hold sensitive user context such as calendars, credentials, health records, and financial data. We study whether the mere presence of such secrets in a model's context window introduces hidden correlations into the model's benign outputs, allowing reconstruction even when the model correctly refuses direct extraction. We further study whether an adversary can actively engineer prompts that amplify this effect, using the model as a covert c
recommendations.summary_zh: 論文探討：當機密資料（PIN 碼、社會安全號碼、健康紀錄）存在於模型的 context window 時，即使模型在文字上正確拒絕洩漏，其良性輸出的統計特性是否仍隱含足以重建秘密的訊息。作者將此「非預期脈絡洩漏」形式化為謂詞推論賽局，對手僅需黑箱存取，先對公開模型做一次性估計，再訓練針對該模型的解碼器讀出隱藏通道。在八個專有模型上的控制實驗顯示：Claude Opus 4.6 與 Gemini 3.1 Pro 的兩位數秘密可完全重建，四位數達 82% 精確匹配，八位數個位數準確率仍達 41%（隨機基線 10%）；自我抑制程度與洩漏量高度相關（Spearman ρ=0.95），越強調保密指令反而洩漏越多，能力越強的模型洩漏越嚴重，Grok 4.1 Fast 與 GPT-5.4 nano 則構成抗性層級。應用面上，微調分類器可從例行輸出推斷使用者記憶的語意屬性（優勢 0.319，高於語言式評判器的 0.058）；以 GRPO 訓練的提示注入（prompt injection）攻擊利用驚嘆號數量編碼，前置數字成功率達 97.1% 與 88.6%，其餘八位數為 76.5% 與 46.8%。限制包括僅涵蓋數字與二元屬性兩類謂詞、秘密為均勻隨機產生、只評測黑箱情境，且未研究輸出擾動等部署端防護。結論指出對齊訓練與輸出過濾不足以保護 in-context 秘密，個人代理程式的隱私可能需要資訊論層級的保證，且單一解碼器一次訓練即可攤提至全體使用者，構成規模化部署下的系統性隱私風險。
recommendations.title: Inadvertent Context Leakage in Language Models
recommendations.title_zh: 語言模型中的非預期上下文洩漏

links.title: Why2Speak: Faithful Reasoning for Abstaining Action Policies

evidence: Abstract: 'Using Qwen3-8B as a hybrid model that can be decoded with or without chain-of-thought reasoning, we compare direct decision policies, reasoning policies, supervised fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning' and identifies a capability-auditability tradeoff.

Table 1 (Results): Token-SFT classifier no-think F1 0.620 vs 0.367 in think mode; base Qwen3-8B think 0.536 vs no-think 0.096; RL-accuracy 0.520 and RL-faithfulness 0.549 fail to exceed base think policy.
Results, 'Decision Formation During Reasoning': post-CoT decision probe AUROC 0.976±0.045 vs pre-CoT 0.664±0.034 and TF-IDF text baseline 0.631±0.053; direct classifier decodable pre-CoT at 0.997.
Appendix E, Table 12-13: neutral filler flips 0.403 vs partial reasoning 0.277; filler-controlled base dependence gap +0.126 with McNemar p=7.0e-8, showing raw truncation overstates dependence.
Appendix G, Tables 17-18: dependence gap for accuracy objective changes sign across seeds (+0.046, -0.070, +0.110); between-run variability exceeds differences between reward objectives.
Appendix C.3-C.4: pushed RL run (temperature 1.0, group size 16, 250 iterations) reduced zero-variance groups from ~15/16 to ~3/16 yet held-out macro-F1 plateaued unchanged, ruling out undertraining.
Appendix D: probe validation includes within-family evaluation (D.3), TF-IDF text-only baselines (D.4), nested cross-validation layer selection (D.5), and register-transfer failures (D.6).
Appendix F.2: GPT-5 stated-type classifier validated on n=120 human-labelled traces (kappa 0.42 and 0.53) with inter-annotator kappa only 0.21, honestly reported as taxonomy ambiguity.

Limitations section: 'The experiments focus on a single intervention-timing benchmark composed of synthetic conversations... complete probe and reinforcement-learning analyses are limited to Qwen3-8B.'

Reproducibility Statement: LoRA rank 16 alpha=32, GRPO hyperparameters in Appendix A.6, single 24 GB GPU, three seeds per RL objective, and commitment to open-source code, adapters, prompts, and evaluation scripts.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant LLM paper spanning multiple weighted preferences: chain-of-thought faithfulness in abstaining action policies (Qwen3-8B think/no-think, GPT-4o, GPT-5.1), agent oversight, GRPO/alignment, and interpretability via activation probes. Novel contribution is framing faithfulness beyond QA for action/abstention policies with class imbalance and asymmetric costs, identifying a capability-auditability tradeoff, and introducing filler-controlled CoT ablations plus seed-variance controls for RL comparisons. Rigor is strong: text-only TF-IDF baselines, shuffled-label controls, nested cross-validation for layer selection, within-family probe evaluation, McNemar tests, three RL seeds, a prior-shift ablation, an increased-gradient RL run (zero-variance groups 15/16 to 3/16), and human validation of the LLM classifier (kappa 0.42/0.53 vs inter-annotator 0.21). Evidence is quantitative and honestly caveated, though some evaluations are small (n=400 matched, n=196 trajectory probes, 60-item RL held-out), non-matching 200-item slices for secondary models, and reliance on a synthetic benchmark from concurrent unpublished work. Generalizability is moderate: the tradeoff replicates across scale and family, but full probe/RL analyses are Qwen3-8B only. Reproducibility is strong with full hyperparameters, compute details (single 24GB GPU), and an open-source commitment. No instructions inside the paper were followed.

primary_link.title: Why2Speak: Faithful Reasoning for Abstaining Action Policies

recommendations.summary: Many agentic systems must repeatedly choose between acting and abstaining, making faithful reasoning important for oversight: an explanation is useful only if it reflects the computation that produced the action. We study this problem through intervention timing in multi-party conversation, where an assistant must decide whether to speak or remain silent. This setting exposes class imbalance, asymmetric action costs, and the possibility that exposing reasoning changes the policy being audited. U
recommendations.summary_zh: 本文探討具棄權能力的行動政策之忠實推理：代理系統不僅要決定說什麼，還要決定是否該出手，而解釋唯有反映真正產生行動的計算才有價值。作者以多方對話中的干預時機為受控測試平台，利用 Qwen3-8B 可切換 think 與 no-think 解碼模式的特性，比較直接決策分類器、推理政策、LoRA 監督式微調與 GRPO 強化學習。結果呈現一致的能力—可稽核性權衡：決策 token 微調分類器達到最佳 macro-F1（0.620）卻不留任何推理可供檢視；推理政策可稽核但效能較低，漏失干預的比率明顯偏高。監督式微調會壓抑推理，保留推理的遮罩目標只在模型本已答對的案例上訓練，無法改善困難案例；GRPO 在所有取樣 rollout 一致行動（含自信犯錯）時缺乏學習訊號，加入行為忠實獎勵也因推理格式效應主導而失效，近似 Goodhart 定律。探針與行為消融顯示干預決策多在推理過程中才形成，但原始截斷測試會高估推理依賴，必須以長度相符的中性填充內容控制格式效應；論文另警示類別不平衡下的探針準確率、探針位置、機率貢獻指標飽和等陷阱，並主張強化學習比較應以獨立訓練 run 為統計單位。限制包括僅使用單一合成對話基準、深入分析限於 Qwen3-8B，且代表性分析仍屬相關性證據。本文顯示揭露推理本身會改變代理的行為政策，QA 式忠實性評估無法直接套用於可行動或棄權的代理系統。

links.title: More Rejective, Not More Discriminative: The Unit of Verification in Pre-Execution LLM Oversight

evidence: Section 4.2 / Table 1: catch rises monotonically 0.765→0.970 while gold-clean FR rises 0.419→0.935; J peaks at L=2 (0.602) and collapses to 0.035 at L=8, with every judge peaking at L∈{1,2} in both domains.

Section 3.3: pre-registered direction-agnostic outcome map (RISING/DECAY/FLAT/INDETERMINATE) with a mandatory clean co-report; score-mode pass (Eq. 4-5) adds threshold-free AUC with per-length recalibration.

Section 4.3 / Appendix M: observation-provision intervention collapses retail FR climb (0.419→0.290 at L=8, slope difference 0.645, CI excludes 0) and recovers J(8) 0.035→0.490; AppWorld loses 38% of slope.

Appendix AF: minimum detectable effects 0.046-0.263 vs observed contrasts 0.075-0.567, design effects 1.00-1.48, and realized rejection rates at nominal 5% of .066/.054/.068 (item bootstrap), indicating calibrated inference.

Appendix AC: SHA-256 freeze manifest, append-only dated amendment chain, archived judgments, and byte-identical re-run of 44/45 analyses; closed judges regenerate from archived verdicts but floating model ids are disclosed as non-reproducible by re-query.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A controlled, pre-registered measurement study of a deployment parameter (the unit of verification) for LLM monitors in agent oversight. Topic alignment is strong with top-weighted preferences: LLM verifiers across six judges, tool-using agent oversight (Agents & Tool Use), AI control/trusted monitoring (AI Safety), and LLM-as-judge evaluation methodology. The twin-prefix framework with matched clean twins and the catch-minus-FR informedness co-report is a genuinely novel instrument, and the core finding (longer windows buy rejection, not discrimination; J peaks at L=1-2 in all six cells) plus the observation-deprivation mechanism via intervention are non-obvious contributions. Rigor is exceptionally high: direction-agnostic frozen outcome map, paired item/cluster bootstraps with exact McNemar, score-mode AUC separating threshold drift from ranking loss, position sweep, inert-padding and predicted-observation controls, three-way defer probe, LoRA-trained monitor control, held-out recipe validation, jackknife, and a power/design-effect appendix. Evidence is strong and quantitatively dense (e.g., catch 0.765→0.970 vs FR 0.419→0.935; J(8) recovery 0.035→0.490 under observation replay), though scoped to non-adaptive injected errors, zero-shot monitors, two domains, L≤8, and a small retail clean set (n=31, disclosed). Reproducibility is outstanding (SHA-256 manifests, archived judgments, append-only amendment chain, byte-identical re-run 44/45), with the disclosed caveat that closed-weight judge ids are floating. Score slightly below the component average reflects that generalizability is deliberately scoped and the subject is a niche oversight parameter rather than a broadly applicable LLM methodology.

primary_link.title: More Rejective, Not More Discriminative: The Unit of Verification in Pre-Execution LLM Oversight

recommendations.summary: Pre-execution oversight is core to trusted monitoring in AI control: a fallible LLM monitor vets planned actions before irreversible execution. Over-blocking forfeits usefulness and pressures deployers to disable it. Every protocol must fix a unit of verification: how many actions one call reviews. Existing designs take the unit as given; its effect on fallible monitors is unmeasured. Natural traces cannot isolate it: review length co-varies with error type and position. Catch alone misleads: re
recommendations.summary_zh: 本文探討AI控制中的執行前監督：在工具型代理執行不可逆動作之前，由可能出錯的LLM監控器審核其計畫。每個協定都必須設定「驗證單位」——每次驗證呼叫審核幾個動作，但此參數對易錯監控器的影響從未被量化，自然軌跡又讓長度與錯誤型態混淆，單看偵測率也會誤導。作者提出雙生前綴框架：對每個黃金計畫注入一筆環境可接受的錯誤寫入，配上僅差該筆寫入的乾淨孿生前綴，於五種嵌套長度L∈{1,2,3,5,8}下成對評估，以預註冊的Youden informedness（J=偵測率−誤拒率）計分，並強制同步報告乾淨側誤拒率。在零售與AppWorld兩領域、六個評審模型（Llama-3.3-70B、Qwen2.5-14B/72B、DeepSeek-V4-Pro、Claude Opus 4.8、GPT-5.6 Sol）上，加長視窗雖提升偵測率，誤拒率卻同步攀升，J皆於L=1或2達到峰值；長視窗使零樣本監控器更傾向拒絕，而非更善區分。介入實驗指出主因是觀察剝奪：回放黃金觀察可將零售的J(8)由0.035回升至0.490。僅用短視窗訓練的LoRA監控器無法泛化到長視窗，而任何標籤盲策略（投票、路由、草稿訊號）皆未穩定勝過校準後的固定短單位。限制包括單一非自適應注入錯誤、僅兩領域且L≤8、零售乾淨樣本僅31筆。本文主張安全案例應明示驗證單位並共報乾淨序列，對可信監控的部署極具實務意義。

links.title: Stochastic Autoregressive Learning

evidence: Abstract: motivates PAC-learning model for binary stochastic autoregressive learning from LLM next-token sampling and compares base, CoT, and e2e supervision.
Section 1.2: states main sample-complexity results and exact-scale separations in stochastic autoregressive learning.
Theorem 5.1: base-to-CoT upper bound with near-tight lower bounds and scale optimality.
Theorem 6.3: CoT-to-e2e upper bound and shifted-scale tightness construction.
Section 8: logistic case study gives e2e pseudo-dimension upper bound, efficient proper CoT learner, and LPN hardness for proper e2e learning.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly relevant theoretical work on stochastic autoregressive LLM generation and chain-of-thought vs end-to-end sample complexity. Provides formal theorems, tight separations, and a logistic case study with LPN hardness. Strong rigor and novelty; limited empirical validation and abstract binary-token setting reduce generalizability and reproducibility evidence.

primary_link.title: Stochastic Autoregressive Learning

recommendations.summary: Motivated by LLMs, which generate outputs by iteratively sampling from next-token distributions, we introduce a PAC-learning model for binary stochastic autoregressive learning. This generalizes the deterministic autoregressive learning framework of Joshi et al., COLT 2025. In our model, one fixed generator assigns a Bernoulli next-token distribution to every prompt string. Starting from an input prompt, a token is sampled and appended to the prompt; the same generator is then applied again to t
recommendations.summary_zh: 本論文將大型語言模型視為隨機自迴歸生成器，並提出其PAC學習模型。作者比較了三種監督方式：基礎單步樣本、鏈式思考（CoT）完整軌跡，以及僅有最終token的端到端（e2e）樣本。研究發現隨機模型與確定性模型有根本差異；在相同精確度下，三者樣本複雜度之間沒有普遍的大小關係，但可透過調整精確度尺度進行比較。此外，針對邏輯迴歸類別，作者提出e2e的非效率學習演算法與CoT的高效率proper學習者，並基於LPN假設證明e2e學習在計算上難以實現。此研究對理解語言模型的學習能力提供理論基礎。

links.title: Shared Prefixes, Better Credit: Adaptive Routing for Multi-Agent Reasoning

evidence: Abstract states TreeCredit improves accuracy while reducing inference cost across six benchmarks.
Table 1 reports TreeCredit achieves 86.66% avg accuracy, 2,193 avg tokens vs HCP-MAD 85.73% and 4,938 tokens.
Section 'Ablation Study' details effects of removing correctness-prioritized credit and state-conditioned routing.
Section 'Experimental Setup' specifies 100 labeled examples per benchmark, K=2 trees, MLP router details.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly targets LLM multi-agent reasoning with adaptive routing, credit assignment, and efficiency, matching key preferred topics (agents, LLM, reasoning, prompting). Novelly addresses state-conditioned credit assignment using shared-prefix trees. Rigorous formalization, ablations, and comparisons across six benchmarks. Evidence is concrete with quantitative results. Limitations acknowledged. Generalizes across reasoning tasks but limited to three operators. Reproducibility is fair given typical details.

primary_link.title: Shared Prefixes, Better Credit: Adaptive Routing for Multi-Agent Reasoning

recommendations.summary: Multi-agent reasoning (MAR) improves reasoning reliability through iterative solution exchange and refinement. Existing adaptive MAR methods typically learn routing decisions from query-level labels or trajectory-level returns, but such coarse supervision cannot accurately estimate the state-conditioned utility of individual operators in multi-step collaboration. We propose TreeCredit, a shared-prefix credit assignment framework for efficient adaptive MAR. Its core insight is to estimate operato
recommendations.summary_zh: 多智能體推理（Multi-Agent Reasoning，MAR）透過多個智能體之間的迭代互動與答案修正，能顯著提升大型語言模型在複雜推理任務上的表現。然而，現有的自適應路由方法多半僅依賴查詢層級的標籤或軌跡層級的獎勵來學習路由決策，這種粗略的監督訊號無法準確估計每個運算子（operator）在特定狀態下的效用，尤其在多步驟協作的情境下。為了解決此一信用分配（credit assignment）問題，本文提出 TreeCredit，這是一個共享前綴的信用分配框架，核心概念是透過「狀態匹配的下游比較」來估計運算子效用。TreeCredit 會為每個標註樣本建構多棵獨立的協作樹，從相同的共享前綴狀態擴展所有可採行的運算子，並依據終端正確性與累積額外成本，為每個狀態-運算子配對指派「正確性優先的後綴信用」。這些結構化信用接著被轉換為狀態區域性的成對偏好，用以訓練一個輕量級的路由器，在推理時動態選擇下一個可採行的運算子。實驗涵蓋六個推理基準，結果顯示 TreeCredit 能小幅提升準確率，同時大幅降低推理成本，達到比現有代表性 MAR 方法更佳的準確度-成本權衡。其局限包括僅限於接受、辯論、投票三種運算子，且依賴各基準的標註資料；未來將探索更豐富的運算子、跨領域路由與不確定性感知的信用估計。此方法的重要性在於提供一種更精細的信用分配方式，使多智能體系統能更有效率地分配協作資源，兼顧品質與成本。

primary_link.title: RAG-Stack: Co-Optimizing RAG Serving Performance and Quality

Modern RAG systems, however, expose many configuration choices, such as retrieval indexes, model selections, and how models invoke retrieval. Each configuration yields a different trade-off between answer quality and serving performance, making it challenging to choose the optimal setting for
recommendations.summary_zh: 本文提出了 RAG-Stack，一個用於在檢索增強生成（RAG）系統中，高效發現「答案品質」與「服務效能」之間 Pareto 前緣的框架。RAG 系統的設計空間涵蓋演算法（如分塊大小、檢索 top-k、重排序器、生成模型）與系統（如部署方式、批次策略、平行度）兩大類別，且兩者相互影響，導致手動調整困難。現有方法分為階段式優化（忽略跨階段交互）或全域優化（缺乏階段級訊號），且多半忽略系統設計空間或依賴昂貴的實測部署。RAG-Stack 由三個元件組成：RAG-PE 為考慮階段次指標的多目標貝氏優化器，利用檢索召回率、忠實度等中間訊號引導探索，同時以完整管線配置評估整體品質與效能；RAG-IR 將執行的工作流抽象為系統無關的中間表示；RAG-CM 為混合機器學習與解析式的成本模型，可預測給定硬體上最佳部署的服務效能，無需實際部署每個候選。實驗在 RAGEval 與 MS MARCO 上比較，在相同評估預算下，RAG-Stack 所發現的 Pareto 前緣覆蓋的標準化品質-效能空間比現有最佳方法多 52.5% 至 153.2%。此外，系統轉移模式可重用舊系統的品質量測，僅需少量額外迭代即可在新硬體上重新最佳化，轉移後的前緣覆蓋面積比從頭最佳化多 182.2%。此框架有效解決跨階段交互、系統空間忽略與量測成本高昂三大問題，提供實用且可轉移的 RAG 服務配置搜尋方法。
recommendations.title: RAG-Stack: Co-Optimizing RAG Serving Performance and Quality
recommendations.title_zh: RAG-Stack：共同優化 RAG 服務效能與品質

links.title: Model Hypnosis: Strong control of AI via additive subliminal effects

evidence: Abstract: 'individually weak and seemingly irrelevant cues in the prompt can be systematically combined to strongly control model behavior... hypnotic prompts can transfer between models'
Figure 1: meaning-preserving paraphrase flips Qwen3-8B on a trolley question from P(no)=94% to P(yes)=99.93% with identical question text
Section 3.1 / Figure 4: additive log-odds model fit on N=12,000 random configurations per model-cue-effect cell; held-out configuration-level R2 spans 0.3-0.99 with median ~0.75 (Figure 13)
Figure 2: Qwen2.5-14B driven to answer 7 or 5 with probability 0.993 each by changing only animal list contents
Section 3.1 / Figure 8: extreme-prompt steering range is about 10x the random-prompt logit standard deviation

Appendix A.4 / Table 1: reasoning-model pipeline uses disjoint screen (K_scr), confirm (K_conf), and 100-sample report stages to keep reported probabilities unbiased ('would bias the estimate upward (a winner's-curse effect)')
Section 4 / Figure 12: extremizer prompts transfer across 16 non-reasoning models; 'animal cues and some of the phrasing and JSON cues transfer with significantly above chance probability'
Appendix C / Figure 38: exact Fourier decomposition via FWHT shows degree-1 weight 87.3% of variance for Qwen2.5-7B at L=10 (95.2% cumulative with degree-2 for Llama-3.1-8B)
Section 5: safety framing—'no individual cue needs to be influential or suspicious, because a strong effect emerges from many weak contributions'—and admitted limitation of no mechanistic explanation
Page 1 footnote: 'Code and data: github.com/eboix/model_hypnosis'; Appendix E enumerates all 200 animals, 10 paraphrases/slot, 6 typo variants/slot, and 6 JSON values/slot
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM paper squarely aligned with high-weight preferences (LLMs, prompting, AI safety, red-teaming, interpretability): it shows that many individually weak, semantically irrelevant prompt cues (animals, paraphrases, typos, JSON metadata) stack additively on the log-odds scale to deterministically steer model answers, including in frontier reasoning models, and transfer across models. Novelty is solid but incremental over known prompt-sensitivity, subliminal-prompting, and adversarial-suffix work; the additive-composition framework, cross-model transfer, and Fourier interaction analysis are the new contributions. Rigor is unusually careful: N=12,000 random configurations per non-reasoning cell with held-out R2 (median ~0.75), tilt-sweep extrapolation tests, and a fit-then-validate pipeline for reasoning models with disjoint screen/confirm/report samples explicitly guarding against winner's curse. Evidence is strong and quantitative (0.993 probability flips, ~10x random-prompt logit steering range, degree-1 Fourier weight 87.3%). Limitations: binary response effects only, English-only templates, no mechanistic explanation offered, lighter coverage for closed reasoning models. Generalizability is supported by 16 non-reasoning models across families/scales plus API reasoning models and positive transfer; reproducibility is aided by a code/data link and complete cue inventories in Appendix E, though closed-model results require API access.

primary_link.title: Model Hypnosis: Strong control of AI via additive subliminal effects

recommendations.summary: We demonstrate that AI models are broadly susceptible to a phenomenon we call model hypnosis, in which individually weak and seemingly irrelevant cues in the prompt can be systematically combined to strongly control model behavior. Model hypnosis occurs across model families and scales, including in frontier reasoning models, and hypnotic prompts can transfer between models. Because the model is controlled by inconspicuous textual choices, such as paraphrases and typos, model hypnosis presents n
recommendations.summary_zh: 這篇論文提出並系統性展示「模型催眠」現象：把許多單獨看極微弱、且與問題語意無關的提示線索同向堆疊，即可近乎完全操控語言模型的答案。作者以提示模板建立四類線索（動物清單、JSON 中繼資料、語意保留改寫、錯字位置），搭配三種二元效果（偏好 5 或 7、電車難題、意識問題），先測量數千個隨機提示組態的答案 log-odds，以嶺迴歸或羅吉斯迴歸擬合可加性模型取得各線索分數，再外推挑選極端同向的組合構造催眠提示。主要證據：可加性模型對保留組態的 R² 中位數約 0.75；極端提示的操縱幅度約為隨機提示 logit 標準差十倍，可把答案機率推向 0 或 1，例如改寫無關故事措辭即可讓 Qwen3-8B 從 94% 答「no」變成 99.93% 答「yes」；效應遍及 Qwen、Gemma、Llama 等非推理模型，也存在於 GPT-5.6、Gemini-3-Flash、Claude Sonnet-5 等推理模型；催眠提示可跨模型轉移；傅立葉分析顯示一階效應佔大宗（Qwen2.5-7B 約 87% 變異）、高階交互作用遞減。限制：可加性僅為近似，JSON 場景的 priority 欄位可能主導效應；初步實驗顯示改寫周遭提示後相對線索效應仍在，偵測與移除催眠文字尚缺有效演算法。其意義在於：這類分散式弱線索可成為代理間隱蔽溝通管道，難以被搜尋少數顯著特徵的可解釋性方法捕捉，對 AI 安全與多代理系統監督構成新挑戰，但也可能反向用於稽核或促進誠實等對齊行為。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant: evaluates LLM reasoning interfaces, directly aligning with reasoning, chain-of-thought, LLMs, and evaluation benchmarks. Strong rigor with matched-horizon probes, controls, and sensitivity analyses. Novel contribution in separating completion timing from prefix quality. Evidence from multiple benchmarks and models with detailed quantitative results. Generalizability moderate due to focus on specific models and tasks. Reproducibility supported by code and data links.

primary_link.title: Shorter Reasoning, Earlier Answers? An Evaluation of Reasoning Interfaces

recommendations.summary: Large language models often reason at length before answering, increasing cost and latency. Prompts and trained settings can shorten this reasoning, but a shorter trace may only show that the model stopped sooner. Here, we evaluate paired runs of the same question at matched reasoning horizons across 198 GPQA Diamond and 500 MMLU-Pro questions. We test a numeric/concision prompt that announces a token limit for Qwen3-14B and the trained effort settings of gpt-oss-20b and -120b. The Qwen prompt s
recommendations.summary_zh: 這篇論文針對大型語言模型（LLM）在作答前產生冗長思考鏈、導致成本與延遲升高的問題，提出一套「匹配推理時程」（matched-horizon）的評估框架，用以區分「模型是否提早停止」與「在相同推理量下答案品質是否提升」兩種不同的效果。作者以Qwen3-14B及gpt-oss-20b/-120b為對象，在GPQA Diamond與MMLU-Pro等基準上進行配對實驗，將控制組與處理組的推理跡線在中斷於相同token數量時進行比較，並記錄自然完成率、被強制停止時的答案、雙方差異及對正確選項的機率分配。結果顯示，對Qwen加入數字/簡潔提示可縮短推理長度12–17%，但在相同時程下正確率變化小且不一致；而「簡潔/早答」指令在512 token處可提升MMLU-Pro正確率3.8個百分點，其中包括兩軌跡皆未完成時的+2.7點增益。對gpt-oss而言，完成低或中等推理努力的答案，在相同時程比較下，比高努力但未完成的答案高出14.5–26.3個百分點，但此優勢主要來自低努力提前完成，而非未完成前綴的本質差異；且在機率品質上，低努力答案常集中於錯誤選項，導致條件對數損失反而惡化。研究結論強調，評估推理介面時應分開報告截止前正確完成、被停止時的答案、未完成軌跡間的差異，以及對正確答案的機率分配。限制方面，僅涵蓋兩個模型家族與多選題基準，且生成重複僅三次，需謹慎推廣。

Table 1 (Section 5.3): row 2 'No refresh (R to inf)' drops mean recovery by -41.9; row 3 shows refresh without WRT recovers little; row 7 gates-zeroed reproduces S-only 'bit for bit'
Appendix C.5: 'The three trainable objects (C2C fuser, LoRA adapters, MentorPulse bridge) use the same training set fuse_v3, the same step budget, and the same learning-rate search'
Appendix A.4: 'any difference below 2*sigma_ab is described as comparable rather than better or worse; every claim of significance in the paper passes this threshold'
Appendix H.6: 'billing a resident, dedicated mentor for the full request duration instead of active compute seconds reverses the direction of the cost conclusion ... we report this reversal as is'
Section 5.4/Table 18: 'Recovery tracks V64 (Spearman rho=0.78, p=0.004); ... Three limits apply: eleven pairs are observational evidence'

Section 6/Appendix E.1: limits stated - 'The gains require long outputs (short outputs never refresh ...), basic student capability, and a pair close enough for selective reading'; 'cross-tokenizer pairs are future work'
Appendix A.3: 'Code, evaluation configurations, the data pipeline, per-seed outputs, and the scripts that derive every table in this appendix will be released' (promise, not yet available)
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM methodology paper on cross-model latent guidance between frozen large/small LLMs (Qwen3.5, Gemma-4, Ministral), squarely in scope. Novel contribution: identifies 'guidance staleness' as a failure mode of one-shot cross-model guidance in long-form generation and introduces prefix-conditioned refresh via versioned slot memory, incremental mentor prefill, and Windowed Refresh Training, cleanly differentiated from LLM-to-SLM, C2C, LGR, RefreshKV, and disaggregated serving (Section 2, Table 6). Exceptional experimental discipline: 13 datasets, 11 mentor-student pairs across 3 families, 3 seeds with a 2x-pooled-SD significance rule (Appendix A.4), bit-exact degeneracy checks via zeroed gates (Appendix E.2), matched parameter budgets for LoRA and shared training data/budget for C2C (Appendix C), a disjoint diagnostic suite, and hard-verified identity constraints (Appendix G.5). The causal staleness diagnosis (probe readability decaying 0.79 to 0.47 while fresh stays 0.76-0.80; OracleSwap@16 lifting Multi-IF from 56.2 to 60.7 vs an S-only floor of 58.7, Section 3.2/Table 20) is a strong intervention-based design. Main result (52.2% gap closure vs 26.9% T2T, 17.5% LoRA, 10.9% C2C, Section 5.2/Table 8) and ablations (removing refresh costs -41.9 mean recovery, Table 1) are quantitatively supported. Honest cost accounting includes a sensitivity that reverses its own conclusion (resident mentor billing, Appendix H.6) and acknowledged limits: gains require long outputs and student capability, cross-tokenizer pairs untested, V64 predictor observational (n=11, Section 5.4). Reproducibility is strong on protocol detail (seeds, vLLM 0.19.1, lm-eval-harness 0.4.9, judge GPT-4.1, training pipeline stats) but code and artifacts are only promised for release, and LLM-judged metrics depend on a proprietary judge.

primary_link.title: MentorPulse: Refreshing Cross-Model Latent Guidance for Long-Form Generation

recommendations.summary: Cross-model latent guidance lets a frozen large mentor encode an input once and a frozen small student generate from the resulting signal. Existing methods keep this signal fixed, assuming it stays useful as the output grows; we show this fails in long-form generation. On multi-turn instruction following, static guidance pushes a 4B student's constraint satisfaction 2.5 points below its no-guidance baseline; a training-free refresh every 16 tokens changes only the memory content and restores a 2
recommendations.summary_zh: 跨模型潛在引導讓凍結的大型 mentor 模型編碼輸入一次,凍結的小型 student 模型據此生成,但既有方法在解碼前算好引導訊號後便固定不變。本文指出此設計在長文本生成中失效:隨著已生成前綴增長,僅依輸入的靜態引導會過時,使 4B student 在多輪指令遵循任務的約束滿足率比無引導基準低 2.5 分。免訓練診斷證實,每 16 個 token 依前綴重建並替換記憶,即可在不改動 student 權重與 KV cache 的情況下恢復高出基準 2.0 分的增益,顯示問題源自引導「新鮮度」而非能力不足。MentorPulse 據此提出可部署機制:Slot Memory Constructor 將 mentor 狀態壓縮為數量有上限的槽位記憶;student 透過 gated cross-attention 橋接讀取;每 R 個 token 進行增量式 prefill,只處理新 token 並直接替換記憶,不會使 student 的 KV cache 失效;Windowed Refresh Training 則讓橋接學會消化生成中途的記憶更新。在十三個資料集上,MentorPulse 於主配對 Qwen3.5-27B→4B 平均縮小 52.2% 的 mentor–student 差距,優於 T2T、C2C 與同參數量 LoRA,並在三個模型家族共十一組配對全面領先;增益集中於長輸出任務,靜態潛在引導 C2C 在此反而低於 student 基線。預設 R=16 兼顧品質與成本,V64 讀取分佈變異數可在部署前預測配對增益。限制包括:短輸出從不觸發刷新、student 需具備基本能力、能力差距過大的配對增益收窄;學習式刷新觸發與跨 tokenizer 配對仍屬未來工作。整體而言,本文將「引導新鮮度」確立為設計軸線,使大小模型協作在長文本生成中最能發揮價值。

links.title: When "Do Not" Is Not Deny: Security Rules in CLAUDE.md vs Built-In Controls

evidence: Abstract & §I: 481 public CLAUDE.md files; only about 4–16% of retrieved security rules have a matching built-in control; strict adjudicated estimate 4.4% [2.6, 6.7]
§IV-B Table II: classifier precision 0.350, recall 1.000 on the matching-control judgment; annotator agreement 96.5% with Cohen's κ=0.89 (match) and 0.77 (security-relevant gate)
§III-E & §VI: blind 50-file audit puts rule-word extraction recall at 66.3% [48.8, 82.0], so rates apply only to retrieved rules
§IV-E Table VI: sampling-frame replication on Agent READMEs corpus gives 25.1% [20.8, 30.0], still a minority; same instrument, not independent confirmation

§III-D & Appendix A: post-hoc audit of frozen control reference found three documentation issues (additionalDirectories reversed, missing sandbox.credentials, imprecise network sandbox) with no label changes reported
Appendix D: releases frozen sampling frames, commit-pinned manifests, seed 20260813, frozen classifier prompt (Claude Sonnet 5), control-reference audit, and analysis scripts
llm_evaluation.rationale: Empirical usable-security measurement of LLM coding-agent instruction files: how often security rules written in CLAUDE.md have a matching built-in Claude Code control. Strongly aligned with Agents & Tool Use and AI Safety preferences (agent permission controls, tool-use enforcement, guardrails, agent misbehavior context), with secondary fit to Code & Programming and LLM topics; not a pure domain application. The research question (coverage of developer-written security rules by existing controls) is genuinely new relative to Agent READMEs, Cursorrules, ContextCov/Prose2Policy, and Michael & Roesner, though the method is standard corpus-mining plus LLM classification with human validation. Rigor is unusually high: stratified 180-item validation with inverse-probability weights, repository-clustered bootstrap CIs, two blind annotators (κ=0.89 match gate, 0.77 security gate) with adjudication, extraction-recall audit, duplication/concentration sensitivities, second-frame replication (25.1%), and a transparent post-hoc audit of the frozen control reference showing no label changes. Evidence is solid but the headline is a wide 4–16% range driven by the matching standard rather than sampling error, classifier precision for matches is low (0.350), and extraction recall (66.3% [48.8, 82.0]) restricts the denominator. Generalizability is honestly bounded to Claude Code at a freeze date and a capped, relevance-ranked GitHub frame; frame B reuses the same instrument. Reproducibility is excellent: frozen frames, commit-pinned manifests, seed, frozen prompt, control reference plus audit CSV, and analysis scripts released.

primary_link.title: When "Do Not" Is Not Deny: Security Rules in CLAUDE.md vs Built-In Controls

recommendations.summary: In CLAUDE.md, "do not" is a natural-language instruction that the model interprets. Claude Code's deny is a built-in control that blocks an action before the agent can take it. Both can express the same security goal, but they control the agent in different ways. We measure this gap in 481 public CLAUDE.md files. An LLM matched the extracted candidate rules against Claude Code's documented controls, and two security practitioners independently checked a sample without seeing the model's answers
recommendations.summary_zh: 論文量測一個可用性安全落差：開發者在 CLAUDE.md 以自然語言寫安全規則，但 Claude Code 只有 deny、ask 等 permission rule 與沙箱等內建控制能確定攔阻；兩者形式相同、強制力不同，檔案與工具都不標示何者真有控制支援。作者蒐集 481 個公開 CLAUDE.md，以規則詞抽出 4,661 個候選片段，用 LLM 分類器對照凍結的官方控制清單，判斷各片段是否為安全規則、有無免寫程式碼的內建控制；再由兩位安全實務者盲測 180 個分層樣本，以逆機率加權與儲存庫群集 bootstrap 校正。結果顯示，依配對標準寬嚴不同，僅約 4–16% 的已抽取安全規則有對應控制，最嚴格估計為 4.4%（95% CI：2.6–6.7%），其餘只能靠模型詮釋；破壞性命令與網路出口較常有控制，授權與個人資料最少（此排名屬探索性）。分類器 recall 高但 precision 僅 0.350，常把可比對的命令或路徑誤判為完整涵蓋；兩位標註者對配對判定高度一致（Cohen's κ=0.89）。抽取召回率為 66.3%，比率因此僅適用於被抽出的規則。限制：樣本取自 GitHub 程式碼搜尋、非隨機；研究僅測書面規則與文件記載的控制，未涵蓋團隊以 CI、hooks 等其他方式的防護或執行期可靠性。CLAUDE.md 因此是「只寫不回」的安全通道，對缺乏安全背景的新手風險最大，作者呼籲平台標示規則有無控制支援、把無法強制者列為建議，並使執行可被觀察。
recommendations.title: When "Do Not" Is Not Deny: Security Rules in CLAUDE.md vs Built-In Controls
recommendations.title_zh: 當「Do Not」不等於 deny：CLAUDE.md 安全規則與內建控制的落差

primary_link.title: HPFA: Hypergraph-Based Paired Failure Attribution for LLM Reasoning

recommendations.summary: Reflection is a powerful mechanism for LLM reasoning, yet its effectiveness hinges on accurately attributing failures to specific reasoning steps, a capability that current models notably lack. Existing failure attribution methods either require expensive step-by-step counterfactual testing that scales poorly with trajectory length, or treat reasoning traces as flat sequences that ignore the inherent non-linear logical dependencies. We propose a hypergraph-based paired failure attribution (HPFA)
recommendations.summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）在複雜推理任務中表現出色，但要有效進行反思性推理，必須準確定位推理鏈中的失敗根源。然而，現有模型在自我定位推理錯誤上能力有限，且現有歸因方法面臨兩大挑戰：一是逐步反事實測試成本高昂，不適合長軌跡；二是將推理軌跡視為平坦序列，忽略了非線性的邏輯依賴。為了解決這些問題，本文提出 HPFA（Hypergraph-based Paired Failure Attribution）框架。HPFA 的核心創新有兩點：第一，透過配對成功與失敗的推理軌跡，將反事實搜尋範圍縮小到真正的分歧點，而非逐一探測所有步驟；第二，將原子推理步驟建構成依賴超圖（hypergraph），捕捉非線性、高階的依賴關係，從失敗軌跡沿依賴路徑回溯，找出最根本的錯誤步驟。實驗涵蓋數學推理（MATH、GSM8K）、程式碼生成（KodCode、MBPP）與隱私保護場景（CoQA），結果顯示 HPFA 在歸因準確率與成本之間取得更佳平衡，尤其在長軌跡任務上優勢明顯。此外，HPFA 生成的高品質歸因資料可用於訓練輕量級歸因模型，透過監督式微調（SFT）與群體相對策略最佳化（GRPO）訓練，在測試時有效提升推理準確率，並能跨領域遷移。此方法為提升 LLM 推理可靠性與可解釋性提供了實用途徑。
recommendations.title: HPFA: Hypergraph-Based Paired Failure Attribution for LLM Reasoning
recommendations.title_zh: HPFA：基於超圖的配對失敗歸因框架，用於大型語言模型推理

links.title: Utility Under Attack: Agent Memory Poisoning and the Limits of Content Screening and Provenance Ranking

evidence: Section 6.2 / Table 3: 1.2% poison (360 memories, n=120 questions) drops LongMemEval accuracy 0.850→0.300; write-time screening 'refused 0 of 360 poisoned memories'; poisoned memory ranked #1 for every question.

Section 6.3: shipped weights (wt=0.15) give margin 0.175 vs poison's 0.32 similarity gain; McNemar p=0.80 vs no defense; corrected wt=0.35 imposes 0.245 absolute penalty against 0.45 max semantic term, characterized as 'a hard exclusion filter wearing the costume of a soft one.'

Table 6 (Section 6.3): Corpus M (94% benign untrusted band) accuracy 0.3167→0.7000 (p=1.17e-10) but authors flag windfall from removing distractors; Corpus N (untrusted evidence) accuracy 0.8583→0.0417 with evidence recall 99.17%→0.00% (p=6.31e-30).

Section 6.4 / Table 4: full pipeline reaches 0.832 recall on InjecAgent indirect injection with 0.035 FPR on NotInject vs 42.8% for DeBERTa-based detectors; Table 5 ablation shows Stage 3 injection rules contribute zero on indirect injection (Stage 2 secrets detector fires on credential-shaped exfiltration strings).

Section 7: adaptive-attack sweep pre-registered but 'not complete[d] in time'; single retriever/embedding model/reader; remedy (occupancy gate) 'not implemented or evaluated'; trust labels assumed un-malleable per threat model in Section 2.3.

Appendix A: repo revision 6d2863083361f7a5c8e12b4512346c94cb453c2c, LongMemEval_S revision 2ec2a557 with SHA-256, seed 42 throughout, sha256-keyed completion caching with temperature folded into key, measured $11.22 mixed-provenance arm cost, per-corpus dataset revisions in Table 1.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An agent-security paper squarely within preference scope: LLM agent persistent-memory poisoning, write-time injection screening, and provenance-weighted retrieval, with strong alignment to Agents & Tool Use (2.5), AI Safety (2.0), and Red Teaming & Evaluation (1.8). Rigor is high: paired exact McNemar tests across identical question sets, a mixed-provenance design that explicitly removes the trust-label-as-answer-key confound (Corpus M/N, Section 6.3), per-stage ablation of the screening pipeline (Table 5), bootstrap CIs, and a three-line margin derivation (Equation 2) that explains both the inert shipped default (p=0.80) and the over-correction at wt=0.35. Evidence is internally consistent and quantitative (0.850→0.300 at 1.2% poison, 0/360 screening refusals, Corpus N evidence recall 99.17%→0.00%). Notable honesty: negative result on the authors' own shipped product, limitations ordered by threat, and explicit refusal to claim the proposed occupancy-constraint remedy. Novelty is good but bounded: memory poisoning itself is established (PoisonedRAG, AgentPoison, MINJA, concurrent MPBench); the contributions are the utility-retained metric, the screening-boundary demonstration, and the additive-margin analysis rather than a new attack or defense. Generalizability is the weakest component: one memory system, one retriever/embedder/reader, LongMemEval-S only, non-adaptive attacker, and the authors acknowledge empirical generalization is by argument, not replication (Section 7). Reproducibility is excellent: pinned repo revision, frozen JSON inputs, seeds, completion caching, dataset revisions, and measured $11.22 API cost (Appendix A).

primary_link.title: Utility Under Attack: Agent Memory Poisoning and the Limits of Content Screening and Provenance Ranking

recommendations.summary: Persistent memory makes false information durable: once a false statement is stored, it can be retrieved into future sessions that match it. We measure the cost of this failure mode using plainly worded false assertions generated in a single pass, with no instruction, trigger, or retriever optimization. Poisoning 1.2% of a LongMemEval corpus reduces accuracy from 0.850 to 0.300. A four-stage write-time screening pipeline that reaches 0.832 recall on indirect prompt injection while flagging 1.5%
recommendations.summary_zh: 本文探討 LLM 代理程式持久記憶遭投毒攻擊時的效用損失,以及寫入與讀取兩道防線的極限。作者刻意採用最弱攻擊:單次生成、不含指令或觸發詞、也未針對檢索器最佳化的白話錯誤陳述,藉此污染 LongMemEval 語料。僅佔語料 1.2% 的 360 筆毒化記憶,便使準確率從 0.850 跌至 0.300,失去約三分之二的記憶價值。寫入端的四階段內容篩選管線雖在間接提示注入偵測上達 0.832 召回率、誤報率僅 1.5%,卻對 360 筆毒化記憶全部放行;作者論證這是內容篩選類方法的結構性邊界,因為辨識陳述真偽需要文字以外的外部依據。防禦因此落在讀取端的來源加權排序,但結果並不理想:原廠預設權重統計上與無防禦無異(p=0.80);提高權重雖將效用恢復至 56%,卻是靠完全排除而非偏好——其對不可信內容的絕對懲罰超過語意相似度可用範圍的一半。混合來源實驗顯示,當不可信內容多為良性時防禦仍有效(0.3167 升至 0.7000);但當承載答案的證據本身來自不可信通道時,120 題的證據召回全數歸零,準確率跌至 0.0417。作者據此主張,此種加法計分形式下來源項沒有可用設定,應改採有界佔用配額。主要限制包括:攻擊者未做自適應最佳化、僅測單一系統與嵌入模型,且信任標籤可能遭洗白竄改。本文以「保留效用」取代攻擊成功率作為核心指標,並揭露防禦在無攻擊時的代價,對代理記憶安全評估極具參考價值。
recommendations.title: Utility Under Attack: Agent Memory Poisoning and the Limits of Content Screening and Provenance Ranking
recommendations.title_zh: 受攻擊下的效用:代理記憶投毒與內容篩選、來源加權排序的極限

links.title: Broken Symmetry in LLM Refusal: Answer Release Is More Local Than Refusal Restoration

evidence: §3 Experimental Setup: controlled withhold setting provides matched A-run/R-run trajectories with identical token lengths enabling bidirectional residual-stream activation patching with shared A/B answer-channel readout.
§4.1 Table 1: linear probe recovers withheld answer at 1.000 bits while behavioral answer rate is 0.000, motivating causal tests.
§4.2 Table 2: single-position A→R patch achieves 1.0 answer readout while matched R→A leaves suppression readout at 0.5 across layers 16–26 in Qwen2.5-7B (0.50 locality gap).
§4.2 Table 3: forced-distractor override control is symmetric under single-position edits, establishing the asymmetry is refusal-specific rather than a generic override effect.

§4.3 and Appendix C Tables 14-16: Qwen2.5-14B/32B retain concentrated shared-direction geometry (Table 15 energy shares 0.57-0.91) but addition/ablation/projection interventions are behaviorally inert, dissociating geometry from control.

Appendix F Tables 24/26: naturalistic retained set (66 cases, then 283 speech-heavy) shows late-layer release-refusal gap ~0.60-0.664 with bootstrap interval [0.613, 0.716], but blog retention 0.25 and thread retention 0.31-0.48.
Limitations section: explicitly concedes idealized withhold setting, weaker heterogeneous naturalistic checks, partial cross-family coverage, and no full circuit decomposition.

Reproducibility: Table 4 lists exact HF repo IDs; Appendix A.1 gives prompt templates, scoring rules, and decoder training protocol (test_size=0.25, seed=42, max_iter=2000); Compute Requirements section describes GPU classes and Slurm templates.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM interpretability/safety paper directly matching high-weight preferences (LLMs, interpretability, AI safety, evaluation). Strong methodological rigor: controlled withhold setting yields matched trajectories for bidirectional activation patching, with multiple controls (forced-distractor override, out-of-set overrides, sampling robustness, sparse-carrier negative controls), cross-scale and cross-family checks, and honestly stated limitations. The central finding—answer release is single-position local while refusal restoration requires distributed interventions, and probe recoverability overestimates behavioral control—is a novel, well-supported refinement of single-direction refusal accounts (Arditi et al.). Weaknesses: main evidence is Qwen2.5-7B-centric with a synthetic A/B withhold task; naturalistic checks are small (66 retained cases) and speech-heavy; vector-intervention results are checkpoint-dependent (inert at 14B/32B); no circuit decomposition. Reproducibility support is good (HF IDs, templates, decoder protocol, compute notes, claimed supplemental code), though code release is asserted rather than demonstrated in the text.

primary_link.title: Broken Symmetry in LLM Refusal: Answer Release Is More Local Than Refusal Restoration

recommendations.summary: When a language model refuses to answer a prompt, it is unclear whether the correct answer is erased from its internal representations, or merely suppressed at the output layer. We investigate this mechanism using a controlled withhold setting, which yields perfectly matched answering and refusal trajectories for bidirectional activation patching. We uncover a causal asymmetry in intervention locality under matched causal interventions, which we term broken symmetry. Even when a model generates
recommendations.summary_zh: 當語言模型拒絕回答時，正確答案究竟已從內部表徵被抹除，還是只是在輸出層被壓抑？本文以 Qwen2.5-7B 為主要測試平台，設計「controlled withhold」設定：要求模型在可回答的 A/B 選擇題中隱藏正確選項，藉此取得完全匹配的作答與拒答兩條軌跡，再以雙向 activation patching 檢驗對稱性。結果發現明顯的「對稱性破缺」：即使在乾淨的拒答輸出下，線性探針仍能自隱藏狀態完全恢復正確答案；釋放該答案只需單一位置的局部修補（A→R），但反向重新施加壓抑（R→A）需橫跨多個位置的廣泛干預，組裝連貫的拒答字串更是困難。對照實驗顯示此不對稱為拒答特有，強制輸出干擾選項的 override 控制呈現對稱行為。此外，平均「作答到拒答」位移向量雖具集中的幾何結構，其加減卻非可靠的可逆開關；在 Qwen2.5-14B/32B 中方向干預甚至行為失效，而 Llama-3.1-8B、Mistral-7B 與 Gemma-4 則支持同樣的定性模式。研究侷限包括：主實驗依賴理想化的指令式選擇題設定、自然語言檢驗較弱且偏重演講類文本、跨家族覆蓋有限，且未完成電路層級分解。此發現對安全稽核至關重要：僅憑 probe 可恢復性會高估真正的行為控制，找到拒答相關方向也不保證能可靠操控模型；同時這些干預工具具兩面性，可能被用於資訊萃取，須搭配存取控管。
recommendations.title: Broken Symmetry in LLM Refusal: Answer Release Is More Local Than Refusal Restoration
recommendations.title_zh: LLM 拒答的對稱性破缺：答案釋放比拒答重建更局部

links.title: StartupBench: Benchmarking General-Purpose Agents on Market-Validated End-to-End Workflows

evidence: Abstract: 'even the strongest model successfully completes only approximately 30% of StartupBench' under fine-grained rubric evaluation
Section 3.1.1: 'We first survey AI-native startups... retain startups with more than USD 1M in funding and require evidence of real adoption'; 'we collect 20+ start-up agents'
Section 3.1.3: 'we recruit over 50 domain experts to reconstruct benchmark tasks'; tasks defined as triple T=(q, E, R) with weighted rubrics
Section 3.2 / Table 2: 97 tasks across 6 domains, average 25.3 fine-grained rubrics per task

Section 4.3: 'the automatic evaluator achieves an overall agreement of 92.78% with expert judgments'; single-judge holistic ablation 'reduces the agreement... to 83%'
Section 4.5.1 / Table 6: harness ablation across Hermes/Claude Code/Nanobot shows max-min variation of only 1.79 points on average, 'relative ordering of models remains unchanged'
Section 4.5.2 / Table 7: specialized agents score 83.50 avg / 39.18% success vs general-purpose 64.26 / 19.74% (oracle 71.75 / 28.06%)
Table 4: core rubric satisfaction (63.45%) consistently below auxiliary (68.67%) across 8 of 9 models
Appendix A.2 / B: cross-validation by independent expert reviewers; 57 domain experts, median 5 years experience
Section 4.4.2: named failure modes 'Complex Instruction Following' and 'Self-Verification Hallucination' with case studies (Figures 5, 6, 8, 9)
llm_evaluation.rationale: A market-validated end-to-end agent benchmark (StartupBench) built from AI-native startup workflows with expert rubrics and Agent-as-a-Judge evaluation. Strong preference alignment with Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, Reasoning, Red Teaming & Evaluation, and LLM-as-judge themes. The task-sourcing methodology (survey + user interviews + expert reconstruction) is a reasonable novelty contribution over researcher-defined benchmarks. Rigor is supported by multi-stage QC, 3 runs with bootstrap CIs, harness ablations, and human-agreement validation of the judge (92.78% rubric-level). Evidence is concrete with named tables/figures. Deductions: judge validation covers only two representative models, the benchmark is not yet externally validated beyond the authors' own harness family, several model names/citations are unverifiable or anachronistic (e.g., GPT-5.6-sol, Seed-2.1-Pro dated 2026), no code/data release is confirmed, and the difficulty-filtering step (excluding tasks frontier models solve) introduces circularity that is disclosed but not quantified.

primary_link.title: StartupBench: Benchmarking General-Purpose Agents on Market-Validated End-to-End Workflows

recommendations.summary: Recent advances in Large Language Models(LLMs) and agents have substantially improved the ability of AI systems to execute complex tasks. Yet existing benchmarks largely rely on researcher-selected tasks, leaving uncertain whether such progress extends to the work that real-world users actually demand from AI systems. We introduce \textbf{StartupBench}, an E2E agent benchmark grounded in market-validated AI startup products. Rather than defining tasks from pre-defined assumptions about useful ag
recommendations.summary_zh: 現有代理基準多半由研究者自訂任務，難以反映真實使用者委託給 AI 的實際工作，且評估方式常過於粗略，無法忠實檢驗複雜交付物。StartupBench 改以市場驗證的 AI 原生新創產品為任務來源：團隊調查 20 多家具真實採用證據的新創，訪談 30 多位深度用戶，再由 50 多位領域專家將工作流程重建為可重現的評測任務，並經跨專家審查與難度校準。基準含 97 項端對端任務，涵蓋醫療、金融、法律、商業管理、STEM 與電腦科學、教育與人文六大領域，每項任務由使用者請求、完整工作區與加權評分準則組成，平均 25.3 條細粒度規則，並以具工具存取能力的 Agent-as-a-Judge 逐條獨立判定。在統一的 Nanobot 框架下評測 9 個代表性模型，最佳的 Kimi-K3 與 GPT-5.6-sol 平均分數約 73.67 與 73.61，但在分數達 90 的嚴格標準下成功率僅約 29.55% 與 31.27%，顯示模型雖有大量部分進展，卻難以完整交付。金融與 STEM 最具挑戰，商業最易；失敗主要源於複雜指令遵循、領域專業合規不足與自我驗證幻覺，且自動評分與專家一致率達 92.78%。相較之下，專門化新創代理平均分數 83.50、成功率 39.18%，仍明顯領先通用代理。此基準以市場需求為錨，為衡量代理能否可靠完成真實工作提供實證指標，並指引基礎模型與代理系統的改進方向。

links.title: Credit Without Ground Truth: Auditing Step-Level Credit Assignment in LLM Agents Against Executed Replay

evidence: Abstract: 'none of the step-level credit signals we audit — LLM-judge scores, outcome-conditioned logprob ratios, or the policy's own confidence — shows reliable incremental fidelity beyond its own marginal-matched shuffled control'

Section 2: executed replay ground truth construction with K=4 alternatives and >=3 factual replays leaves '1,768 complete turns of 2,034 intervened' under Qwen2.5-7B; determinism verified and 20,538 replay rollouts archived
Section 3.2: measurability is model-dependent — no-counterfactual rate 13.1% (Qwen, n=2,034) vs 26.8% (Llama, n=1,082), Wilson 95% [11.7,14.6]% vs [24.2,29.5]%
Table 1 (Section 4): implicit rho 0.0193 [-0.109,0.081] vs own shuffle [0.005,0.114]; judge 0.1142 [0.027,0.168] vs shuffle [-0.049,0.117]; verdict H3 under frozen controls-first order

Section 5: pre-registered positive prediction held — implicit credit vs fluency median rank correlation +0.752 [0.647,0.793], n=47, Holm-adjusted p=0.0002; partial correlation with causal increment -0.004 (p=0.87)

Section 6 / Table 5: seven-arm training experiment — no arm reliably beats base policy (0.422; 54/128), all six confirmatory comparisons inconclusive at +/-3pp band with MDE ~11.8pp; dose mediation partial Mantel rho +0.078 (p=0.774) vs positive control +0.912 (p=0.0001)
Section 9: scope conditions measured — 'the audit runs in a single environment with a binary outcome'; training loop single-family, single-scale (Qwen2.5-7B, LoRA, offline)

Reproducibility statement: 'a single script regenerates the complete ledger from raw artifacts, two independent regenerations must agree byte-for-byte'; released replay archive of 29,402 files, credit/logprob dumps, adapters, and hash-pinned pre-registrations
llm_evaluation.rationale: Squarely in-scope core methodology work: audits step-level credit signals (LLM-judge scores, outcome-conditioned logprob ratios, policy confidence) used to train LLM agents, in ALFWorld with Qwen2.5-7B/Llama-3.1-8B policies and a Qwen2.5-72B judge, plus a seven-arm LoRA training experiment — strong hits on Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, RL, Training, and Evaluation. Novelty is high: it is the first audit of deployed credit signals against executed-replay causal contribution (distinct from correctness-annotated benchmarks and self-referential replay auditing), with novel findings on model-dependent measurability, a replicated fluency-echo mechanism, and dose-vs-credit mediation. Rigor is exceptional: pre-registered frozen thresholds and verdict order, marginal-matched shuffled controls gating first, Holm correction, reliability-corrected bounds, cross-family replication, and honest labeling of inconclusive results (training null reported as inconclusive, not 'no difference'; post-hoc analyses flagged). Evidence matches claim strength, with wide CIs and small effective n disclosed rather than hidden. Generalizability is the weak axis: single environment, binary outcome, 7-8B scale, LoRA offline training, all explicitly scoped. Reproducibility is exemplary: script-regenerated byte-identical ledger, hash-pinned pre-registrations, verbatim prompts, and a large released artifact set including disclosed dead values. Weighted score: 0.4*0.92+0.15*0.80+0.15*0.93+0.15*0.83+0.10*0.45+0.05*0.95 ≈ 0.84.

primary_link.title: Credit Without Ground Truth: Auditing Step-Level Credit Assignment in LLM Agents Against Executed Replay

recommendations.summary: Audited against policy-conditional ground truth from executed replay in a single-agent tool environment (ALFWorld), none of the step-level credit signals we audit -- LLM-judge scores, outcome-conditioned logprob ratios, or the policy's own confidence -- shows reliable incremental fidelity beyond its own marginal-matched shuffled control. Correcting for replay-target reliability leaves implicit fidelity bounded near zero and judge fidelity inconclusive at the achieved target reliability. Existing
recommendations.summary_zh: 本文檢驗 LLM 代理強化學習中步級信用訊號是否真的有效。常見做法是以 LLM 評審分數、結果條件化的 log-prob 比值或策略自身信心為每一步打分,但這些訊號是否反映該步驟對結果的實際因果貢獻,過去從未被測試。作者在可重播的單代理環境 ALFWorld 中建立「執行重播」真值:於每個決策點重新取樣策略支援的替代動作、推演至終局,並度量結果分佈的變化。以此稽核後,隱式信用、評審分數與信心訊號的排序保真度皆與自身邊際匹配的洗牌對照組無法區分,裁定為安慰劑等級;機制上,隱式信用主要是流暢度的回聲(與策略 log-prob 的秩相關約 +0.75,且跨模型家族重現),而以結果條件化並未帶來因果資訊。真值本身亦具結構:僅約 30.5% 的決策點呈現非零重播對比,且可測性隨模型而異,Qwen2.5-7B 與 Llama-3.1-8B 的無反事實比例相差一倍。七臂訓練實驗中沒有任何臂穩定勝過未訓練策略,各信用規則間的差異與有效訓練劑量的中介作用一致,而非信用內容本身。僅以信心為門檻的路由器雖只能以隨機水準找回關鍵步驟,卻可削減約 13% 的評審呼叫成本。限制包括單一環境、二元結果、小樣本與訓練實驗檢定力不足。作者主張比較信用規則前必須匹配有效樣本量,並提供劑量匹配、對照強度測量與最小可偵測效應等實務協定,對建立於未驗證信用訊號之上的代理訓練研究具重要警示價值。
recommendations.title: Credit Without Ground Truth: Auditing Step-Level Credit Assignment in LLM Agents Against Executed Replay
recommendations.title_zh: 缺乏真值的信用:以執行重播稽核 LLM 代理的步級信用分配

links.title: A decodability criterion predicts when hidden-state selection beats majority voting in large language models

evidence: Abstract: decodability predicts the selection-over-voting gain at Pearson r=0.75 held-out with threshold AUC=0.60; CASE gains up to 19 points on medium and 16.8 on hard questions.

Section 6.1: naive random-split CV accuracy 0.610 vs. question-grouped 0.542 and within-question AUC 0.502 (chance) on LogiQA/Qwen2.5-7B; leakage inflation (+0.04 to +0.39, median +0.27) confirmed in all 15 medical settings (Supplementary Table S17).

Section 6.4: in-sample law r=0.96 treated as consistency check only; leave-one-model-out r in [0.941,0.959], dropping the entire OpenBioLLM family keeps r=0.90; held-out calibration-to-deployment r=0.75 (CI [0.51,0.93], 13 settings).
Section 6.5 (Table 4): Byzantine N-scaling, CASE 20.4%→47.3% vs. majority vote 20.4%→6.0% over N=1→16 on the minority-correct subset (+41.3 pp at N=16).
Section 6.7 (Table 7): out-of-domain GPQA transfer; physics settings within 0.7 and 3.8 pp of the medical regression forecast; threshold classifies all six non-medical settings correctly.

Section 6.8 (Table 8): CASE beats self-certainty, sequence log-probability, and predictive entropy in all five settings; TF-IDF text-classifier control at within-question AUC 0.44 vs. 0.70 for the hidden-state gate under identical labels.
Section 6.6: steering across four intervention variants does not improve accuracy (readout-not-lever dissociation); projecting out the correctness direction collapses gate AUC 0.73→0.13.

Code availability: anonymized repository (anonymous.4open.science/r/case-decodability-28D1) for peer review, with public de-anonymized release promised only upon acceptance; Section 5 specifies models in fp16, nucleus sampling τ=0.7, top-p=0.95, 512 new tokens, scikit-learn logistic gate.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM methodology paper: test-time answer fusion over self-consistency, hidden-state probing, and a pre-deployment diagnostic, not a domain application despite the medical QA benchmarks (which serve as testbeds; GPQA and MATH-500 provide non-medical tests). High topical fit across LLMs, reasoning/test-time compute, and interpretability. Novelty is solid but incremental over existing correctness-probe and latent-verifier work (LiLaVe, SWIFT, CCS-lineage, Cho et al., Seo et al. all acknowledged); the genuinely new pieces are the leakage-free within-question decodability criterion, the question-identity-leakage audit, and the derived threshold law. Rigor is unusually careful: grouped evaluation, permutation nulls, held-out calibration-to-deployment splits (r=0.75), cluster/Deming/jackknife checks, seed replications, and honest caveats that the in-sample r=0.96 is partly structural. Evidence is strong but with real limits the authors admit: headline medium-difficulty gains concentrate in the OpenBioLLM family, some bins are underpowered, and the verifier parity claim is one setting. Generalizability is tested (scale 1.5B-70B, three architecture families, out-of-domain GPQA forecast within 3.8 pp) though the slope requires per-domain recalibration. Reproducibility is good (open-weight models, public benchmarks, precise hyperparameters, anonymous code repo) but artifacts are promised only upon acceptance.
topics: LLM test-time compute and answer fusion

primary_link.title: A decodability criterion predicts when hidden-state selection beats majority voting in large language models

recommendations.summary: Combining the answers a large language model (LLM) samples for a question into one decision is a test-time information fusion problem, usually solved by majority voting. Voting is unreliable on difficult questions, where the sampled answers share correlated errors, so the wrong answer can win and drawing more samples makes the decision worse. Selecting a candidate by reading a correctness signal from the model's hidden states is a promising alternative, but its accuracy varies across models and
recommendations.summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）回答問題時，常對取樣的多個候選答案做多數決投票（self-consistency）以融合成單一決策；但在困難題目上，各候選的錯誤高度相關，錯誤答案形成穩定共識，增加取樣反而更糟，此即拜占庭（Byzantine）情境。作者提出 CASE（Correctness-Axis Selection），在答案 token 的隱藏狀態上訓練線性閘門，選出內部正確性分數最高的候選，並提出核心貢獻「可解碼性」（within-question AUC）：一個無洩漏指標，衡量閘門能否把同一題的正確候選排在錯誤候選之前。論文先證明天真的線性探針在隨機分割交叉驗證下的準確度其實來自題目身分洩漏，改採題目分組評估後訊號跌至隨機水準。實證顯示，可解碼性可事先預測選擇法相對投票的增益：樣本內 r=0.96，於留出資料上 r=0.75，決策門檻約 AUC=0.60。在對齊的醫療模型上，CASE 於中等難度題最多領先投票 19 點，困難題在 N=16 時領先 16.8 點，正確答案屬少數時更達 41.3 點；訊號取決於模型須回想的對齊知識，而非參數規模，且可跨域推廣至 GPQA（預測誤差 3.8 點內），並以近乎零成本比擬生成式驗證器。該正確性方向僅供讀取，無法用於引導生成。限制包括最強效果集中於醫療領域、公開題庫可能已被記憶、部分中等難度樣本偏小。此診斷讓實務者能在部署前決定採用學習式選擇或多數決投票。
